-- after the MCB block module is built). That block is now deferred and runs right after F.BLOCKFACES
-- is created. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged.

        "................cVcccVVcccVcVVVVFFFFFJFJFJJJJJJF................",
        "................cVVccccdccVccVVcJJFJMMJMJMMMMMMM................",
        "................ccVccdddccVcddddJJFJJMJMMMMJMJJM................",
        "................ccVcVdddccccddddFJFJJMMMMMMJMMMM................",
        "................VVccVcddccVVccccFJJJJMMMMJMJMMMM................",
        "................jjVVVVVVVVjjjjjjJJJJMMMMMJMMMMMM................",
        "................WkjjjljjjjkWkjjkJJJJMJMMMJMMMMJM................",
        "................WWWkkjjkkWWWWkkWJFJFJJMJJMMJJMJJ................"
}
F.decodeRLE = function(s)
        local px, i = {}, 0
        for count, hex in s:gmatch("(%d+):([%x%-]+)") do
                local c = false
                if hex ~= "-" then
                        c = Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16))
                end
                for _ = 1, tonumber(count) do i += 1 px[i] = c end
        end
        return px
end
F.buildImage = function(img, s)
        if not img.px then img.px = F.decodeRLE(img.d) end
        local px, w, h = img.px, img.w, img.h
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * s, h * s)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        for y = 0, h - 1 do
                local x = 0
                while x < w do
                        local c = px[y * w + x + 1]
                        local run = 1
                        while x + run < w and px[y * w + x + run + 1] == c do run += 1 end
                        if c then
                                local p = Instance.new("Frame")
                                p.BorderSizePixel = 0
                                p.BackgroundColor3 = c
                                p.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * s, y * s)
                                p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(run * s, s)
                                p.Parent = f
                        end
                        x += run
                end
        end
        return f
end
local vp = camera.ViewportSize
S.GS = math.clamp(math.floor(math.min(vp.X / 200, vp.Y / 180)), 1, 4)
F.getPixel = function(x, y)
        return S.PALETTE[S.SKIN[y + 1]:sub(x + 1, x + 1)]
end
S.model = Instance.new("Model")
S.model.Name = "MinecraftSteve"
F.paintFace = function(part, face, u, v, w, h, flipX, flipY)
        local g = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        g.Face = face
        g.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
        g.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(w * 16, h * 16)
        g.LightInfluence = 0.7
        g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        g.Parent = part
        for row = 0, h - 1 do
                local ty = v + (flipY and (h - 1 - row) or row)
                local col = 0
                while col < w do
                        local function tx(c) return u + (flipX and (w - 1 - c) or c) end
                        local c = F.getPixel(tx(col), ty)
                        local run = 1
                        while col + run < w and F.getPixel(tx(col + run), ty) == c do run += 1 end
                        if c then
                                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                                f.BackgroundColor3 = c
                                f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(col / w, row / h)
                                f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(run / w, 1 / h)
                                f.Parent = g
                        end
                        col += run
                end
        end
end
F.paintBox = function(part, u, v, w, h, d)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Top, u + d, v, w, d, true, true)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, u + d + w, v, w, d)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Right, u, v + d, d, h)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Front, u + d, v + d, w, h)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Left, u + d + w, v + d, d, h)
        F.paintFace(part, Enum.NormalId.Back, u + 2 * d + w, v + d, w, h)
end
F.toRb = function(v) return Vector3.new(-v.X, -v.Y, v.Z) * PX end
S.limbs = {}
F.makeLimb = function(name, origin, size, pivot, u, v)
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = name
        part.Size = size * PX
        part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(176, 125, 96)
        part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
        part.CastShadow = true
        part.Parent = S.model
        F.paintBox(part, u, v, size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
        S.limbs[name] = { part = part, pivot = pivot, offset = CFrame.new(F.toRb(origin + size / 2)) }
end
F.makeLimb("head", Vector3.new(-4, -8, -4), Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 0, 0)
F.makeLimb("body", Vector3.new(-4, 0, -2), Vector3.new(8, 12, 4), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 16, 16)
F.makeLimb("rightArm", Vector3.new(-3, -2, -2), Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), Vector3.new(-5, 2, 0), 40, 16)
F.makeLimb("leftArm", Vector3.new(-1, -2, -2), Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), Vector3.new(5, 2, 0), 32, 48)
F.makeLimb("rightLeg", Vector3.new(-2, 0, -2), Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), Vector3.new(-1.9, 12, 0), 0, 16)
F.makeLimb("leftLeg", Vector3.new(-2, 0, -2), Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), Vector3.new(1.9, 12, 0), 16, 48)
F.placeLimb = function(l, root, pivot, rx, ry, rz)
        l.part.CFrame = root * CFrame.new(F.toRb(pivot)) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(-rx, -ry, rz) * l.offset
end
F.placeHead = function(root, pivot, pitch, relYaw)
        local head = S.limbs.head
        -- Use the same mirrored angle convention as every other Steve limb.
        -- Apply yaw and pitch separately so turning the head cannot roll/twist the neck.
        -- Head angles use the same direction as the camera: positive yaw turns right,
        -- and positive pitch looks upward. The previous negative signs inverted both axes.
        head.part.CFrame = root * CFrame.new(F.toRb(pivot))
                * CFrame.Angles(0, relYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0) * head.offset
end
F.poseSteve = function(root, pitch, relYaw, walkPos, walkSpeed, age, crouch, holdingItem, interpolatedSwing)
        local pi = math.pi
        local rArmX = math.cos(walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 2 * walkSpeed * 0.5
        local lArmX = math.cos(walkPos * 0.6662) * 2 * walkSpeed * 0.5
        local swingProgress = math.clamp(interpolatedSwing or F.swingProgress or 0, 0, 1)
        local eatBlend = math.clamp(F.eatAnimationBlend or (F.eating and 1 or 0), 0, 1)
        local eatElapsed = math.clamp(F.renderEatTime or F.eatTime or 0, 0, 32)
        local eatRemaining = 1 - eatElapsed / 32
        local eatPull = 1 - eatRemaining ^ 27
        local rArmY, lArmY, rArmSwingZ = 0, 0, 0
        local bodySwingYaw = 0

        -- ModelBiped's ITEM arm pose: a held item rests slightly forward instead of
        -- leaving the arm in the empty-hand walk pose.
        if holdingItem then rArmX = rArmX * 0.5 - pi / 10 end

        -- Minecraft 1.12 biped attack math. Use render-interpolated progress so this
        -- curve is smooth at 60 FPS even though the simulation advances at 20 TPS.
        if swingProgress > 0 then
                bodySwingYaw = math.sin(math.sqrt(swingProgress) * pi * 2) * 0.2
                local eased = 1 - swingProgress
                eased = 1 - eased * eased * eased * eased
                local f2 = math.sin(eased * pi)
                local f3 = math.sin(swingProgress * pi) * -(pitch - 0.7) * 0.75
                rArmX -= f2 * 1.2 + f3
                -- Main-hand arm receives body yaw plus the extra 2x ModelBiped swing term.
                rArmY += bodySwingYaw * 3
                lArmY += bodySwingYaw
                lArmX += bodySwingYaw
                rArmSwingZ = math.sin(swingProgress * pi) * -0.4
        end

        -- Keep eating as a held-input action, with the arm easing toward the mouth
        -- during the same 32-tick use window as Java 1.12.x.
        if eatBlend > 0.001 then
                rArmX -= eatBlend * eatPull * 0.48
        end

        local rLegX = math.cos(walkPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * walkSpeed
        local lLegX = math.cos(walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 1.4 * walkSpeed
        local headP, bodyP = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local rArmP = Vector3.new(-math.cos(bodySwingYaw) * 5, 2, math.sin(bodySwingYaw) * 5)
        local lArmP = Vector3.new(math.cos(bodySwingYaw) * 5, 2, -math.sin(bodySwingYaw) * 5)
        local rLegP, lLegP = Vector3.new(-1.9, 12, 0), Vector3.new(1.9, 12, 0)
        local bodyX = 0
        if crouch then
                bodyX = 0.5
                rArmX += 0.4 lArmX += 0.4
                rLegP += Vector3.new(0, 0, 4) lLegP += Vector3.new(0, 0, 4)
                headP += Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)
                bodyP += Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
                rArmP += Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0) lArmP += Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
        end
        local rBobZ = math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05
        local lBobZ = -rBobZ
        rArmX += math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05
        lArmX -= math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05
        F.placeHead(root, headP, pitch, relYaw)
        F.placeLimb(S.limbs.body, root, bodyP, bodyX, bodySwingYaw, 0)
        F.placeLimb(S.limbs.rightArm, root, rArmP, rArmX, rArmY, rBobZ + rArmSwingZ)
        F.placeLimb(S.limbs.leftArm, root, lArmP, lArmX, lArmY, lBobZ)
        F.placeLimb(S.limbs.rightLeg, root, rLegP, rLegX, 0.005, 0.005)
        F.placeLimb(S.limbs.leftLeg, root, lLegP, lLegX, -0.005, -0.005)
        return rArmP, rArmX, rBobZ, rArmY, rArmSwingZ
end

    for id, meta in pairs(blockMeta) do
        if ITEMS[id] then
            ITEMS[id].name = meta.name
            ITEMS[id].placeable = true
            ITEMS[id].category = ITEMS[id].category or "building"
        else
            local hex = meta.color
            local rr = tonumber(string.sub(hex,1,2),16) or 145
            local gg = tonumber(string.sub(hex,3,4),16) or 145
            local bb = tonumber(string.sub(hex,5,6),16) or 145
            ITEMS[id] = {name=meta.name, max=64, placeable=true, hardness=1.5, category="building", vanilla=true}
            -- Defensive init immediately before write; startup may re-enter with a partial state.
            S.BLOCK_COLORS = S.BLOCK_COLORS or {}
            S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] = Color3.fromRGB(rr,gg,bb)
        end
    end

-- v14: Wire embedded helper textures to actual block faces even when no external mod files are loaded.
-- v19 FIX: this used to be an inline do..end, but it ran BEFORE F.BLOCKFACES existed, so startup died
-- with "attempt to index nil with 'hay_block'" (hay_block was just the first key pairs() returned).
-- The body is now deferred and invoked right after F.BLOCKFACES = MCB.BLOCKFACES further down.
F.wireEmbeddedBlockFaces = function()
    local suffixRules = {
        {suffix="_top", face="top"}, {suffix="_bottom", face="bottom"},
        {suffix="_front", face="front"}, {suffix="_side", face="side"},
        {suffix="_sides", face="side"}
    }
    local aliases = {
        grass="grass_block", dirt_path="dirt_path", ct="crafting_table",
        log="oak_log", planks="oak_planks", cobble="cobblestone",
        ender_chest="ender_chest", trapped_chest="trapped_chest",
        sticky_piston="sticky_piston"
    }
    local grouped = {}
    for textureId in pairs(S.BTEX) do
        for _, rule in ipairs(suffixRules) do
            if #textureId > #rule.suffix and textureId:sub(-#rule.suffix) == rule.suffix then
                local base = textureId:sub(1, #textureId - #rule.suffix)
                local blockId = aliases[base] or base
                if ITEMS[blockId] and ITEMS[blockId].placeable then
                    grouped[blockId] = grouped[blockId] or {}
                    grouped[blockId][rule.face] = textureId
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end
    for blockId, faces in pairs(grouped) do
        local current, merged = F.BLOCKFACES[blockId] or {}, {}
        for k, v in pairs(current) do merged[k] = v end
        for k, v in pairs(faces) do merged[k] = v end
        if not merged.all then F.BLOCKFACES[blockId] = merged end
    end
    if ITEMS.grass_block and S.BTEX.grass_top and S.BTEX.grass_side then
        F.BLOCKFACES.grass_block = {top="grass_top", bottom="dirt", side="grass_side"}
    end
    if ITEMS.crafting_table and S.BTEX.ct_top then
        F.BLOCKFACES.crafting_table = {top="ct_top", bottom=S.BTEX.planks and "planks" or "ct_top", front=S.BTEX.ct_front and "ct_front" or "ct_top", side=S.BTEX.ct_side and "ct_side" or "ct_top"}
    end
    for id, item in pairs(ITEMS) do
        if item.placeable and S.BTEX[id] and not F.BLOCKFACES[id] then
            F.BLOCKFACES[id] = {all=id}
        end
    end
end

-- Expanded vanilla-style registry. This is a client-side simulation registry, not
-- Mojang's full block/item registry; blocks share the same voxel placement engine.
-- v15 hotfix: the Bedrock registry adds entries such as pointed_dripstone_down_tip.
-- Ensure this color map exists before those entries are registered (v14 crashed here).
S.BLOCK_COLORS = S.BLOCK_COLORS or {}
F.EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS = F.EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS or {}
F.MOD_TEXTURES = F.MOD_TEXTURES or {}
F.MODS_LOADED = F.MODS_LOADED or {}
F.MOD_FILES_LOADED = F.MOD_FILES_LOADED or {}
F.MOD_RECIPES = F.MOD_RECIPES or {}
F.MOD_MOB_DEFS = F.MOD_MOB_DEFS or {}
F.localMobTypes = F.localMobTypes or {}
do
local EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS = F.EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS
local localMobTypes = F.localMobTypes
local function hexColor(value, fallback)
    if typeof(value) == "Color3" then return value end
    local h = tostring(value or ""):gsub("#", "")
    if #h == 3 then h = h:sub(1,1)..h:sub(1,1)..h:sub(2,1)..h:sub(2,1)..h:sub(3,1)..h:sub(3,1) end
    if #h == 6 and h:match("^%x+$") then
        return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(h:sub(1,2),16), tonumber(h:sub(3,4),16), tonumber(h:sub(5,6),16))
    end
    return fallback or Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145)
end
local function prettyId(id)
    return tostring(id):gsub("_", " "):gsub("(%a)([%w]*)", function(a,b) return a:upper() .. b end)
end
F.prettyId = prettyId
F.hexColor = hexColor
local function addMCBlock(id, name, hex, category, hardness)
    if ITEMS[id] == nil then
        ITEMS[id] = { name = name or prettyId(id), max = 64, placeable = true, hardness = hardness or 1.5, category = category or "building", vanilla = true }
    else
        ITEMS[id].category = ITEMS[id].category or category or "building"
        ITEMS[id].placeable = true
    end
    EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS[id] = hexColor(hex, EXTRA_BLOCK_COLORS[id])
end
local function addMCItem(id, name, category, maxStack, extras)
    local info = ITEMS[id] or {}
    info.name = name or info.name or prettyId(id)
    info.category = category or info.category or "ingredients"
    info.max = maxStack or info.max or 64
    info.vanilla = true
    if extras then for k,v in pairs(extras) do info[k] = v end end
    ITEMS[id] = info
end

for row in BLOCK_ROWS:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
    local id, name, hex, category, hardness = row:match("^([^|]+)|([^|]+)|([^|]+)|([^|]+)|([^|]+)$")
    if id then
        id = id:gsub("%s+", "")
        addMCBlock(id, name, hex, category, tonumber(hardness) or 1.5)
    end
end
for _, wood in ipairs({"oak","spruce","birch","jungle","acacia","dark_oak","mangrove","cherry","bamboo","crimson","warped","poplar"}) do
    local isNether = wood == "crimson" or wood == "warped"
    local palette = wood == "poplar" and "C3A274" or (isNether and (wood == "crimson" and "82404B" or "286B67") or "A17A4B")
    addMCBlock(wood.."_planks", prettyId(wood).." Planks", palette, "building", 2.0)
    if wood ~= "bamboo" then
        addMCBlock(wood.."_log", prettyId(wood).." Log", isNether and palette or "886342", "natural", 2.0)
        addMCBlock(wood.."_wood", prettyId(wood).." Wood", isNether and palette or "886342", "building", 2.0)
    end
    addMCBlock(wood.."_leaves", prettyId(wood).." Leaves", wood == "poplar" and "D98B43" or "548448", "natural", 0.2)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_stairs", prettyId(wood).." Stairs", palette, "building", 2.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_slab", prettyId(wood).." Slab", palette, "building", 2.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_fence", prettyId(wood).." Fence", palette, "building", 2.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_fence_gate", prettyId(wood).." Fence Gate", palette, "building", 2.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_door", prettyId(wood).." Door", palette, "functional", 3.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_trapdoor", prettyId(wood).." Trapdoor", palette, "functional", 3.0)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_button", prettyId(wood).." Button", palette, "redstone", 0.5)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_pressure_plate", prettyId(wood).." Pressure Plate", palette, "redstone", 0.5)
    addMCBlock(wood.."_sign", prettyId(wood).." Sign", palette, "functional", 1.0)
end

    local c, hx = fam[1], fam[2]
    for _, variant in ipairs({"wool","carpet","concrete","concrete_powder","terracotta","glazed_terracotta","stained_glass","stained_glass_pane","banner","bed","candle"}) do
        local id = c.."_"..variant
        addMCBlock(id, prettyId(c).." "..prettyId(variant), hx, "colored", variant == "carpet" and 0.1 or 0.8)
    end
end

    end

local slots = {}
local carried = nil
F.maxOf = function(id) return (ITEMS[id] and ITEMS[id].max) or 64 end
F.canPlace = function(idx, st)
        if idx == 0 or st == nil or ITEMS[st.id] == nil then return false end
        if idx >= 5 and idx <= 8 then return ITEMS[st.id].armorSlot == idx end
        return true
end
F.insertStack = function(st, a, b)
        if F.maxOf(st.id) > 1 then
                for i = a, b do
                        local s = slots[i]
                        if s and s.id == st.id and s.n < F.maxOf(s.id) then
                                local mv = math.min(F.maxOf(s.id) - s.n, st.n)
                                s.n += mv st.n -= mv
                                if st.n <= 0 then return true end
                        end
                end
        end
        for i = a, b do
                if not slots[i] and F.canPlace(i, st) then
                        slots[i] = { id = st.id, n = st.n }
                        st.n = 0
                        return true
                end
        end
        return st.n <= 0
end
F.canFit = function(id, n, a, b)
        local room = 0
        for i = a, b do
                local s = slots[i]
                if s == nil then room += F.maxOf(id) elseif s.id == id then room += F.maxOf(id) - s.n end
        end
        return room >= n
end
F.give = function(id, n, a, b)
        local st = { id = id, n = n }
        F.insertStack(st, a or 9, b or 44)
end
F.updateCraft = function()
        local g = {}
        local count = 0
        for i = 1, 4 do g[i] = slots[i] and slots[i].id or nil if g[i] then count += 1 end end
        local r = nil
        if count == 1 then
                for i = 1, 4 do if g[i] == "oak_log" then r = { id = "oak_planks", n = 4 } end end
        elseif count == 2 then
                if (g[1] == "oak_planks" and g[3] == "oak_planks") or (g[2] == "oak_planks" and g[4] == "oak_planks") then
                        r = { id = "stick", n = 4 }
                elseif (g[1] == "coal" and g[3] == "stick") or (g[2] == "coal" and g[4] == "stick") then
                        r = { id = "torch", n = 4 }
                end
        elseif count == 4 then
                if g[1] == "oak_planks" and g[2] == "oak_planks" and g[3] == "oak_planks" and g[4] == "oak_planks" then
                        r = { id = "crafting_table", n = 1 }
                end
        end
    -- Expanded native 2x2 crafting recipes; these are intentionally limited
    -- to recipes that fit the existing 2x2 inventory grid.
    if not r then
        if count == 1 then
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local item = g[i]
                if item and item:find("_planks$") then
                    r = { id = item:gsub("_planks$", "_button"), n = 1 }
                    if not ITEMS[r.id] then r = nil end
                elseif item == "stone" or item == "polished_blackstone" then
                    r = { id = item == "stone" and "stone_button" or "polished_blackstone_button", n = 1 }
                    if not ITEMS[r.id] then r = nil end
                end
            end
        elseif count == 2 then
            local a,b,c,d = g[1],g[2],g[3],g[4]
            if a and a == b and a:find("_planks$") or c and c == d and c:find("_planks$") then
                local plank = (a and a == b and a:find("_planks$")) and a or c
                r = { id = plank:gsub("_planks$", "_pressure_plate"), n = 1 }
                if not ITEMS[r.id] then r = nil end
            elseif a == "stone" and b == "stone" or c == "stone" and d == "stone" then
                r = { id = "stone_pressure_plate", n = 1 }
            elseif (a and a:find("_planks$") and c == a) or (b and b:find("_planks$") and d == b) then
                r = { id = "stick", n = 4 }
            end
        end
    end
        slots[0] = r
end
F.consumeCraft = function()
        for i = 1, 4 do
                local s = slots[i]
                if s then s.n -= 1 if s.n <= 0 then slots[i] = nil end end
        end
        F.updateCraft()
end

F.setGameMode = function(mode)
    if mode == true then mode = "creative" elseif mode == false then mode = "survival" end
    mode = tostring(mode or "survival"):lower()
    if mode ~= "creative" and mode ~= "survival" and mode ~= "adventure" then return false end
    S.gameModeName = mode
    creative = mode == "creative"
    S.adventureMode = mode == "adventure"
    abilities.mayfly = creative
    abilities.instabuild = creative
    abilities.invulnerable = creative
    abilities.flying = creative and abilities.flying or false
    abilities.mayBuild = not S.adventureMode
    S.inventoryPage = creative and "creative" or "survival"
    if F.updateInventoryPage then F.updateInventoryPage() end
    return true
end

end
