F.isMCBlock = function(part)
        return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") ~= nil
end
-- Any raycastable world BasePart can be selected and broken. Generated dropped items
-- are excluded so aiming at an item does not accidentally destroy the pickup.
F.isBreakableTarget = function(part)
        if not (part ~= nil and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent ~= nil) then return false end
        if dropFolder and part:IsDescendantOf(dropFolder) then return false end
        -- A part beneath a Model with a Humanoid is an entity, not a block/CSG target.
        if F.getEntityTarget and F.getEntityTarget(part) then return false end
        return true
end
local MCB = (function()
local blocks = {}
local bulkBuild = false
local painted = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function cellKey(center)
        return math.floor(center.X / BLOCK + 0.5) .. ":" .. math.floor(center.Y / BLOCK + 0.5) .. ":" .. math.floor(center.Z / BLOCK + 0.5)
end
local function getBlockAt(center) return blocks[cellKey(center)] end
local BLOCKFACES = {
        stone = { all = "stone" },
        dirt = { all = "dirt" },
        cobblestone = { all = "cobble" },
        oak_planks = { all = "planks" },
        oak_log = { top = "log_top", bottom = "log_top", side = "log" },
        grass_block = { top = "grass_top", bottom = "dirt", side = "grass_side" },
        crafting_table = { top = "ct_top", bottom = "planks", front = "ct_front", side = "ct_side" },
}
local FACES = {
        { Enum.NormalId.Top, Vector3.yAxis }, { Enum.NormalId.Bottom, -Vector3.yAxis },
        { Enum.NormalId.Front, -Vector3.zAxis }, { Enum.NormalId.Back, Vector3.zAxis },
        { Enum.NormalId.Right, Vector3.xAxis }, { Enum.NormalId.Left, -Vector3.xAxis },
}
local function faceTexKey(id, nid)
        local F = BLOCKFACES[id]
        if not F then return nil end
        if F.all then return F.all end
        if nid == Enum.NormalId.Top then return F.top end
        if nid == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then return F.bottom or F.top end
        if F.front and (nid == Enum.NormalId.Front or nid == Enum.NormalId.Left) then return F.front end
        return F.side
end
local function rectsOf(px, w, h)
        local used, out = {}, {}
        for y = 0, h - 1 do
                for x = 0, w - 1 do
                        local i = y * w + x + 1
                        local c = px[i]
                        if c and not used[i] then
                                local rw = 1
                                while x + rw < w and px[i + rw] == c and not used[i + rw] do rw += 1 end
                                local rh, ok = 1, true
                                while ok and y + rh < h do
                                        for dx = 0, rw - 1 do
                                                local j = (y + rh) * w + x + dx + 1
                                                if px[j] ~= c or used[j] then ok = false break end
                                        end
                                        if ok then rh += 1 end
                                end
                                for dy = 0, rh - 1 do for dx = 0, rw - 1 do used[(y + dy) * w + x + dx + 1] = true end end
                                out[#out + 1] = { x = x, y = y, w = rw, h = rh, c = c }
                        end
                end
        end
        return out
end
local faceTpl = {}
local function faceTemplate(texKey, nid)
        local ck = texKey .. nid.Name
        local g = faceTpl[ck]
        if g then return g end
        local tex = S.BTEX[texKey]
        if not tex then return nil end
        if not tex.px then tex.px = F.decodeRLE(tex.d) end
        g = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        g.Face = nid
        g.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
        g.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(64, 64)
        g.LightInfluence = 0.5
        g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        for _, r in ipairs(rectsOf(tex.px, 16, 16)) do
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.BackgroundColor3 = r.c
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x * 4, r.y * 4)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.w * 4, r.h * 4)
                f.Parent = g
        end
        faceTpl[ck] = g
        return g
end
local function paintFaceOf(part, nid, id)
        local key = faceTexKey(id, nid)
        local tpl = key and faceTemplate(key, nid)
        if tpl then tpl:Clone().Parent = part end
end
local function refreshFaces(part)
        if bulkBuild or not part.Parent then return end
        local id = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
        if not id or id == "ladder" then return end
        local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or part.Position
        local p = painted[part]
        if not p then p = {} painted[part] = p end
        for _, f in ipairs(FACES) do
                if not p[f[1]] then
                        local nb = getBlockAt(cell + f[2] * BLOCK)
                        if not nb or nb:GetAttribute("MCClimb") then
                                p[f[1]] = true
                                paintFaceOf(part, f[1], id)
                        end
                end
        end
end
local function buildLadderVisual(part, center, n)
        local tex = S.ICON.ladder
        if not tex.px then tex.px = F.decodeRLE(tex.d) end
        local right = (-n):Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        for _, r in ipairs(rectsOf(tex.px, 16, 16)) do
                local v = Instance.new("Part")
                v.Size = Vector3.new(r.w, r.h, 1) * PX
                v.Color = r.c
                v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                v.Anchored, v.CanCollide, v.CanQuery, v.CanTouch, v.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                local p = center - n * (BLOCK / 2) + n * (1.3 * PX) + right * ((r.x + r.w / 2 - 8) * PX) + Vector3.yAxis * ((8 - r.y - r.h / 2) * PX)
                v.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(p, right, Vector3.yAxis, n)
                v.Parent = part
        end
end
local function createBlock(id, center, face)
        center = F.snapToGrid(center)
        if getBlockAt(center) then return nil end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = id
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        part:SetAttribute("MCBlockId", id)
        part:SetAttribute("MCCell", center)
        if id == "ladder" then
                local n = (face and math.abs(face.Y) < 0.5) and face or Vector3.zAxis
                local t = 2 / 16 * BLOCK
                local alongX = math.abs(n.X) > 0.5
                part.Size = alongX and Vector3.new(t, BLOCK, BLOCK) or Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, t)
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(center - n * (BLOCK / 2 - t / 2))
                part.Transparency = 1
                part.CanCollide = false
                part.CanQuery = true
                part.CastShadow = false
                part:SetAttribute("MCClimb", true)
                part:SetAttribute("MCLadderN", n)
                F.ladderSet = F.ladderSet or {}
                F.ladderSet[part] = true
                buildLadderVisual(part, center, n)
        else
        -- Lightweight collision/shape profiles. These are physical approximations,
        -- while MCCell remains the full-grid coordinate used by placement and lookup.
        local actualCenter = center
        local size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, BLOCK)
        local lowerId = string.lower(id)
        if lowerId:find("_stairs$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.5, BLOCK)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.25, 0)
            part:SetAttribute("MCShape", "stairs")
        elseif lowerId:find("_slab$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.5, BLOCK)
            actualCenter += Vector3.new(0, (face and face.Y < -0.5) and BLOCK * 0.25 or -BLOCK * 0.25, 0)
        elseif lowerId:find("_carpet$") or lowerId == "carpet" or lowerId == "leaf_litter" then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.08, BLOCK)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.46, 0)
        elseif lowerId:find("_pressure_plate$") or lowerId == "stone_pressure_plate" or lowerId == "heavy_weighted_pressure_plate" or lowerId == "light_weighted_pressure_plate" then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.82, BLOCK * 0.08, BLOCK * 0.82)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.46, 0)
        elseif lowerId:find("_button$") or lowerId == "stone_button" then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.25, BLOCK * 0.18, BLOCK * 0.12)
            part.CanCollide = false
        elseif lowerId:find("_door$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.12, BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.92)
            part:SetAttribute("MCInteractKind", "door")
        elseif lowerId:find("_trapdoor$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.12, BLOCK)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.44, 0)
            part:SetAttribute("MCInteractKind", "trapdoor")
        elseif lowerId:find("_fence_gate$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.12, BLOCK * 0.7, BLOCK * 0.9)
            part:SetAttribute("MCInteractKind", "gate")
        elseif lowerId == "cushion" or lowerId == "straw_bed" or lowerId:find("_bed$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.25, BLOCK)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.375, 0)
            part:SetAttribute("MCInteractKind", "rest")
        elseif lowerId == "redstone_torch" or lowerId == "soul_torch" or lowerId == "torch" then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.18, BLOCK * 0.65, BLOCK * 0.18)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.17, 0)
            part.CanCollide = false
        elseif lowerId == "candle" or lowerId:find("_candle$") then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.18, BLOCK * 0.28, BLOCK * 0.18)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.36, 0)
        elseif lowerId == "shelf_mushroom" or lowerId == "red_shrub" or lowerId == "poplar_sapling" then
            size = Vector3.new(BLOCK * 0.45, BLOCK * 0.6, BLOCK * 0.45)
            actualCenter -= Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.2, 0)
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
        part.Size = size
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(actualCenter)
        if part.CanCollide == nil then part.CanCollide = true end
        part.CanQuery = true
        part.CastShadow = true
        part.Color = S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
        part:SetAttribute("MCBaseCFrame", part.CFrame)
        part:SetAttribute("MCBaseSize", size)
        if lowerId:find("_stairs$") then
            local upper = Instance.new("Part")
            upper.Name = id .. "_upper_step"
            upper.Anchored = true
            upper.CanTouch = false
            upper.CanQuery = true
            upper.CanCollide = true
            upper.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            upper.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            upper.Material = part.Material
            upper.Color = part.Color
            upper.Size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK * 0.5, BLOCK * 0.5)
            upper.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.25, BLOCK * 0.25))
            upper:SetAttribute("MCParentShape", id)
            upper.Parent = part
        end
        end
        blocks[cellKey(center)] = part
        part.Parent = blockFolder
        refreshFaces(part)
        return part
end
local function removeBlock(part)
        local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or part.Position
        blocks[cellKey(cell)] = nil
        painted[part] = nil
        part:Destroy()
        for _, f in ipairs(FACES) do
                local nb = getBlockAt(cell + f[2] * BLOCK)
                if nb then refreshFaces(nb) end
        end
end
return {
        get = getBlockAt, create = createBlock, remove = removeBlock, refresh = refreshFaces,
        paintFace = paintFaceOf, rects = rectsOf, FACES = FACES, BLOCKFACES = BLOCKFACES, blocks = blocks,
        setBulk = function(v) bulkBuild = v end,
}
end)()
F.BLOCKFACES = MCB.BLOCKFACES -- shared live table; mod loader is declared before the later local alias
-- v19 FIX: run the deferred embedded-texture wiring now that F.BLOCKFACES exists (it previously ran
-- inline before MCB was built and crashed startup at line ~3543).
if type(F.wireEmbeddedBlockFaces) == "function" then
    local okWire, wireErr = pcall(F.wireEmbeddedBlockFaces)
    if not okWire then
        warn("[Minecraft Replica v19] embedded block-face wiring failed: " .. tostring(wireErr))
    end
end

local getBlockAt, createBlock, removeBlock = MCB.get, MCB.create, MCB.remove

-- All world geometry stays as its existing geometry. No baseplate chunking,
-- voxelization, or replacement with generated block Parts is performed.
-- A target cell is identified on the same world grid used by placed MC blocks.
F.getGridCellCenter = function(part, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if F.isMCBlock(part) then
                return part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or F.snapToGrid(part.Position)
        end
        if not hitPos then
                return F.snapToGrid(part and part.Position or Vector3.zero)
        end
        local n = hitNormal or Vector3.yAxis
        local ax, ay, az = math.abs(n.X), math.abs(n.Y), math.abs(n.Z)
        local face
        if ay >= ax and ay >= az then
                face = Vector3.new(0, n.Y >= 0 and 1 or -1, 0)
        elseif ax >= az then
                face = Vector3.new(n.X >= 0 and 1 or -1, 0, 0)
        else
                face = Vector3.new(0, 0, n.Z >= 0 and 1 or -1)
        end
        return F.snapToGrid(hitPos - face * (BLOCK * 0.5))
end

-- Cut exactly one grid-sized cube out of the world geometry in the selected cell.
-- Every part that overlaps the cell is cut on its own, so each keeps its own
-- material, color and transparency (for example a visible grass part and an
-- invisible anti-cheat hitbox are never merged into one union). Roblox's CSG
-- result is a UnionOperation; it is not expanded into a collection of Parts.
F.cutGridCellWithUnion = function(source, cellCenter)
        if not (source and source.Parent and source:IsA("BasePart") and cellCenter) then
                return false
        end
        if source:IsDescendantOf(dropFolder) or source.Name == "MCSelectionGridProxy" then
                return false
        end
        if F.isMCBlock(source) then
                removeBlock(source)
                return true
        end

        local GeometryService = game:GetService("GeometryService")
        local half = BLOCK * 0.5
        local cellCFrame = CFrame.new(cellCenter)

        -- Collect every eligible world part whose bounds intersect the selected cell.
        local excluded = { dropFolder, blockFolder, S.model }
        if char then table.insert(excluded, char) end
        local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
        overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
        overlap.RespectCanCollide = false
        overlap.MaxParts = 0

        local targets, seen = {}, {}
        local function addTarget(part)
                if not (part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
                if seen[part] or part:IsDescendantOf(dropFolder) or part:IsDescendantOf(blockFolder) then return end
                if part.Name == "MCSelectionGridProxy" then return end
                if F.getEntityTarget and F.getEntityTarget(part) then return end
                local playerModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                if playerModel and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(playerModel) then return end
                seen[part] = true
                table.insert(targets, part)
        end
        addTarget(source)
        local overlapOK, overlapping = pcall(function()
                return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cellCFrame, Vector3.one * BLOCK, overlap)
        end)
        if overlapOK and type(overlapping) == "table" then
                for _, part in ipairs(overlapping) do addTarget(part) end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then return false end

        local function partInsideCell(part)
                for sx = -1, 1, 2 do
                        for sy = -1, 1, 2 do
                                for sz = -1, 1, 2 do
                                        local corner = part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
                                                part.Size.X * 0.5 * sx,
                                                part.Size.Y * 0.5 * sy,
                                                part.Size.Z * 0.5 * sz
                                        ))
                                        local localCorner = cellCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(corner)
                                        if math.abs(localCorner.X) > half + 0.01
                                                or math.abs(localCorner.Y) > half + 0.01
                                                or math.abs(localCorner.Z) > half + 0.01 then
                                                return false
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                end
                return true
        end

        local options = {
                CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Default,
                RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic,
                SplitApart = false,
        }

        local function cutOnePart(target)
                if not (target and target.Parent) then return false end
                local targetParent = target.Parent
                local targetCFrame = target.CFrame
                local targetName = target.Name
                local targetAttributes = target:GetAttributes()

                local cutter = Instance.new("Part")
                cutter.Name = "MCUnionCutCutter"
                cutter.Size = Vector3.one * BLOCK
                cutter.CFrame = cellCFrame
                cutter.Anchored = true
                cutter.CanCollide = false
                cutter.CanTouch = false
                cutter.CanQuery = false
                cutter.CastShadow = false
                cutter.Transparency = 1
                local cutOK, cutRaw = pcall(function()
                        return GeometryService:SubtractAsync(target, { cutter }, options)
                end)
                cutter:Destroy()

                local results = {}
                if cutOK and type(cutRaw) == "table" then
                        for _, item in ipairs(cutRaw) do
                                if typeof(item) == "Instance" and item:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(results, item) end
                        end
                end
                local function destroyResults()
                        for _, item in ipairs(results) do
                                if item then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
                        end
                end

                if not cutOK or type(cutRaw) ~= "table" then
                        destroyResults()
                        if partInsideCell(target) then
                                pcall(function() target:Destroy() end)
                                return true
                        end
                        warn("[PI3] Union cell cut failed for " .. targetName .. "; it was left unchanged.")
                        return false
                end

                -- An empty successful result means this part was entirely inside the cell.
                if #results == 0 then
                        pcall(function() target:Destroy() end)
                        return true
                end

                for index, result in ipairs(results) do
                        -- Each cut piece keeps the properties of the part it came from.
                        pcall(function() result.CFrame = targetCFrame end)
                        result.Name = index == 1 and targetName or (targetName .. "_CutPart" .. tostring(index))
                        pcall(function() result.Color = target.Color end)
                        pcall(function() result.Material = target.Material end)
                        pcall(function() result.MaterialVariant = target.MaterialVariant end)
                        pcall(function() result.Reflectance = target.Reflectance end)
                        pcall(function() result.Transparency = target.Transparency end)
                        pcall(function() result.LocalTransparencyModifier = target.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
                        pcall(function() result.Anchored = target.Anchored end)
                        pcall(function() result.CanCollide = target.CanCollide end)
                        pcall(function() result.CanQuery = target.CanQuery end)
                        pcall(function() result.CanTouch = target.CanTouch end)
                        pcall(function() result.CastShadow = target.CastShadow end)
                        pcall(function() result.CollisionGroup = target.CollisionGroup end)
                        pcall(function() result.CustomPhysicalProperties = target.CustomPhysicalProperties end)
                        pcall(function()
                                if result:IsA("PartOperation") and target:IsA("PartOperation") then
                                        result.UsePartColor = target.UsePartColor
                                end
                        end)
                        for name, value in pairs(targetAttributes) do
                                pcall(function() result:SetAttribute(name, value) end)
                        end
                        result:SetAttribute("MCClientUnionReplacement", true)
                        result.Parent = targetParent
                end

                -- Keep textures, decals, surface GUIs and attachments from the original.
                local firstResult = results[1]
                for _, child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
                        if not child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:IsA("Model") and child.Parent == target then
                                pcall(function() child.Parent = firstResult end)
                        end
                end
                pcall(function() target:Destroy() end)
                return true
        end

        local changed = false
        for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                if cutOnePart(target) then changed = true end
        end
        return changed
end

-- Resolving a target is deliberately read-only. The same hit cell is used for
-- highlighting, breaking, and placement; no world geometry is changed here.
F.resolveBreakTarget = function(part, hitPos, hitNormal)
        return part, hitPos, hitNormal
end

S.selectBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
S.selectBox.Color3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
S.selectBox.LineThickness = 0.012
S.selectBox.Transparency = 0.3
S.selectBox.Name = "MCSelectBox"
S.selectionProxy = Instance.new("Part")
S.selectionProxy.Name = "MCSelectionGridProxy"
S.selectionProxy.Size = Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, BLOCK)
S.selectionProxy.Anchored = true
S.selectionProxy.CanCollide = false
S.selectionProxy.CanTouch = false
S.selectionProxy.CanQuery = false
S.selectionProxy.CastShadow = false
S.selectionProxy.Transparency = 1
S.selectionProxy.Parent = workspace
S.crackOverlay = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
S.crackOverlay.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
S.crackOverlay.LineThickness = 0.025
S.crackOverlay.Transparency = 1
S.crackOverlay.Name = "MCCrackOverlay"
F.setDestroyStage = function(stage)
        if stage < 0 or not S.destroyPart then
                S.crackOverlay.Adornee = nil
                S.crackOverlay.Transparency = 1
        else
                -- Crack feedback follows the same single-cell proxy used for selection.
                S.crackOverlay.Adornee = (S.destroyPart:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") == "ladder") and S.destroyPart or S.selectionProxy
                S.crackOverlay.Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(stage / 9, 0, 1) * 0.85
        end
end
F.getDestroyStage = function()
        return S.destroyProgress > 0 and math.floor(S.destroyProgress * 10) or -1
end
F.getDestroyProgressFor = function(id)
        local h = (id == "baseplate") and 0.6 or ((ITEMS[id] and ITEMS[id].hardness) or 1.0)
        if h <= 0 then return 1 end
        return 1 / (h * 30)
end
F.stopDestroyBlock = function()
        if S.isDestroying then
                S.isDestroying = false
                S.destroyProgress = 0
                S.destroyTicks = 0
                F.setDestroyStage(-1)
                S.destroyPart = nil
                S.destroyBlockPos = nil
                S.destroyingItemId = nil
        end
end
F.destroyBlock = function(part, cellCenter)
        if not F.isBreakableTarget(part) then return false end
        local id = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
        cellCenter = cellCenter or F.getGridCellCenter(part, nil, nil)
        local removed = F.cutGridCellWithUnion(part, cellCenter)
        if removed then F.checkLadders() end
        if removed and not abilities.instabuild and id and ITEMS[id] then
                F.spawnBlockDrop(id, cellCenter)
        end
        return removed
end
F.sameDestroyTarget = function(part, cellCenter)
        if not part or not S.destroyPart then return false end
        local held = slots[36 + selected]
        local sid = held and held.id or nil
        return part == S.destroyPart and cellCenter == S.destroyBlockPos and sid == S.destroyingItemId
end
F.startDestroyBlock = function(part, _direction, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if not abilities.mayBuild then return false end
        if F.heldIsTool and F.heldIsTool() then return false end
        if not F.isBreakableTarget(part) then return false end
        local cellCenter = F.getGridCellCenter(part, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if abilities.instabuild then
                F.destroyBlock(part, cellCenter)
                S.destroyDelay = S.DESTROY_DELAY_CREATIVE
                return true
        end
        if not S.isDestroying or not F.sameDestroyTarget(part, cellCenter) then
                if S.isDestroying then F.stopDestroyBlock() end
                local id = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
                local prog = F.getDestroyProgressFor(id)
                if prog >= 1 then
                        F.destroyBlock(part, cellCenter)
                else
                        S.isDestroying = true
                        S.destroyPart = part
                        S.destroyBlockPos = cellCenter
                        local held = slots[36 + selected]
                        S.destroyingItemId = held and held.id or nil
                        S.destroyProgress = 0
                        S.destroyTicks = 0
                        F.setDestroyStage(0)
                end
        end
        return true
end
F.continueDestroyBlock = function(part, _direction, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if S.destroyDelay > 0 then
                S.destroyDelay -= 1
                return true
        end
        if not F.isBreakableTarget(part) then return false end
        local cellCenter = F.getGridCellCenter(part, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if abilities.instabuild then
                S.destroyDelay = S.DESTROY_DELAY_CREATIVE
                F.destroyBlock(part, cellCenter)
                return true
        end
        if F.sameDestroyTarget(part, cellCenter) then
                if not part.Parent then
                        S.isDestroying = false
                        return false
                end
                local id = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
                S.destroyProgress += F.getDestroyProgressFor(id)
                S.destroyTicks += 1
                F.setDestroyStage(F.getDestroyStage())
                if S.destroyProgress >= 1 then
                        S.isDestroying = false
                        F.destroyBlock(part, cellCenter)
                        S.destroyProgress = 0
                        S.destroyTicks = 0
                        S.destroyDelay = S.DESTROY_DELAY_CREATIVE
                        F.setDestroyStage(-1)
                        S.destroyPart = nil
                end
                return true
        else
                return F.startDestroyBlock(part, _direction, hitPos, hitNormal)
        end
end
F.pickBlock = function()
        local reach = (abilities and abilities.instabuild) and S.REACH_CREATIVE or S.REACH_SURVIVAL
        local p = pos or Vector3.zero
        local eh = eyeH or 1.62
        local y = yaw or 0
        local pi = pitch or 0
        local eye = p + Vector3.new(0, eh * BLOCK, 0)
        local look = (CFrame.Angles(0, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pi, 0, 0)).LookVector
        local dir = look * (reach * BLOCK)
        if not rp then return nil, nil, nil end
        -- Non-collidable block parts (the ladder plate) must be targetable too; other non-collidable
        -- parts fall back to the normal collidable-only ray.
        local r = workspace:Raycast(eye, dir, F.rpPick)
        if r and not r.Instance.CanCollide and not F.isMCBlock(r.Instance) then
                r = workspace:Raycast(eye, dir, rp)
        end
        -- If the normal ray already hit a collidable limb, return it without extra work.
        if r and F.getEntityTarget then
                local alreadyEntity = F.getEntityTarget(r.Instance)
                if alreadyEntity then return r.Instance, r.Position, r.Normal end
        end
        -- Standard block targeting intentionally ignores non-collidable BaseParts. This
        -- second ray lets Humanoid limbs/accessories count as entities without changing
        -- which ordinary world parts are eligible for union-cut block breaking.
        local excluded = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(rp.FilterDescendantsInstances or {}) do excluded[#excluded + 1] = item end
        if dropFolder then excluded[#excluded + 1] = dropFolder end
        S.entityRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
        local blockDistance = r and (r.Position - eye).Magnitude or math.huge
        for _ = 1, 16 do
                local candidate = workspace:Raycast(eye, dir, S.entityRayParams)
                if not candidate then break end
                local entity, entityHumanoid
                if F.getEntityTarget then entity, entityHumanoid = F.getEntityTarget(candidate.Instance) end
                if entity and entityHumanoid then
                        local entityDistance = (candidate.Position - eye).Magnitude
                        if entityDistance < blockDistance then
                                return candidate.Instance, candidate.Position, candidate.Normal
                        end
                        break
                end
                -- Skip non-collidable decorative parts only. A collidable obstacle blocks the
                -- entity ray here, matching the normal block ray's line-of-sight behavior.
                if candidate.Instance.CanCollide then break end
                excluded[#excluded + 1] = candidate.Instance
                S.entityRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
        end
        if not r then return nil, nil, nil end
        return r.Instance, r.Position, r.Normal
end
F.faceFromNormal = function(n)
        if typeof(n) ~= "Vector3" or n.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return Vector3.yAxis end
        local ax, ay, az = math.abs(n.X), math.abs(n.Y), math.abs(n.Z)
        if ay >= ax and ay >= az then
                return n.Y > 0 and Vector3.yAxis or -Vector3.yAxis
        elseif ax >= az then
                return n.X > 0 and Vector3.xAxis or -Vector3.xAxis
        else
                return n.Z > 0 and Vector3.zAxis or -Vector3.zAxis
        end
end
F.placeBlock = function(handId, hitPart, hitPos, hitNormal)
        if not abilities.mayBuild then return false end
        if not handId or not ITEMS[handId] or not ITEMS[handId].placeable then return false end
        if not hitPos or not hitNormal then return false end
        local face = F.faceFromNormal(hitNormal)
        local base
        if F.isMCBlock(hitPart) then
                base = hitPart:GetAttribute("MCCell") or hitPart.Position
        else
                base = F.snapToGrid(hitPos - face * (BLOCK * 0.5))
        end
        local center = F.snapToGrid(base + face * BLOCK)
        local ladderN
        if handId == "ladder" then
                -- Ladder attaches to a wall: prefer the clicked wall, otherwise the wall closest to where you look.
                local dirs = {}
                if math.abs(face.Y) < 0.5 then dirs[1] = -face end
                local lk = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0).LookVector
                local h = { Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis }
                table.sort(h, function(a, b) return a:Dot(lk) > b:Dot(lk) end)
                for _, d in ipairs(h) do dirs[#dirs + 1] = d end
                for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                        if workspace:Raycast(center, d * (BLOCK * 0.6), rp) then ladderN = -d break end
                end
                if not ladderN then return false end
        end
        local halfW = 0.6 * BLOCK / 2 * 0.9
        local feet = pos
        local playerMin = feet - Vector3.new(halfW, 0.05, halfW)
        local playerMax = feet + Vector3.new(halfW, 1.8 * BLOCK - 0.05, halfW)
        local bmin = center - Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, BLOCK) * 0.5
        local bmax = center + Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, BLOCK) * 0.5
        if handId ~= "ladder" and playerMin.X < bmax.X and playerMax.X > bmin.X
                and playerMin.Y < bmax.Y and playerMax.Y > bmin.Y
                and playerMin.Z < bmax.Z and playerMax.Z > bmin.Z then
                return false
        end
        local part = createBlock(handId, center, ladderN or face)
        if not part then return false end
        if not abilities.instabuild then
                local s = slots[36 + selected]
                if s and s.id == handId then
                        s.n -= 1
                        if s.n <= 0 then slots[36 + selected] = nil end
                        refresh()
                end
        end
        return true
end
S.attackHeld = false
S.useHeld = false
S.swingTime = 0
S.swinging = false
S.swingQueued = false
F.startSwing = function()
        if not S.swinging then
                S.swingTime = 0
                S.swingQueued = false
                S.swinging = true
        elseif S.swingTime >= 4 then
                -- Queue a follow-up swing rather than resetting the current one mid-arc.
                S.swingQueued = true
        end
end
F.startAttack = function()
        if invOpen or F.playerDead then return false end
        F.startSwing()
        if S.missTime > 0 then return false end
        local part, hitPos, normal = F.pickBlock()
        local entity, entityHumanoid
        if F.getEntityTarget then entity, entityHumanoid = F.getEntityTarget(part) end
        if entity and entityHumanoid then
                F.stopDestroyBlock()
                F.attackEntity(entity, entityHumanoid)
                return true
        end
        part, hitPos, normal = F.resolveBreakTarget(part, hitPos, normal)
        if F.isBreakableTarget(part) then
                F.startDestroyBlock(part, normal, hitPos, normal)
                F.startSwing()
                return true
        end
        F.stopDestroyBlock()
        if abilities.instabuild then
                S.missTime = 0
        else
                S.missTime = 10
        end
        return false
end
F.continueAttack = function(down)
        if F.playerDead then return end
        if not down then
                S.missTime = 0
                F.stopDestroyBlock()
                return
        end
        if S.missTime > 0 or invOpen then return end
        local part, hitPos, normal = F.pickBlock()
        local entity, entityHumanoid
        if F.getEntityTarget then entity, entityHumanoid = F.getEntityTarget(part) end
        if entity and entityHumanoid then
                F.stopDestroyBlock()
                if F.attackEntity(entity, entityHumanoid) then F.startSwing() end
                return
        end
        part, hitPos, normal = F.resolveBreakTarget(part, hitPos, normal)
        if F.isBreakableTarget(part) then
                if F.continueDestroyBlock(part, normal, hitPos, normal) then F.startSwing() end
        else
                F.stopDestroyBlock()
        end
end
-- Client-local container storage and block interaction. This intentionally keeps
-- contents in this running client only; it is not server-authoritative multiplayer.
F.localContainerData = F.localContainerData or {}
S.containerGui = nil
S.containerCell = nil
S.containerButtons = {}
function S.closeContainer()
    if S.containerGui then S.containerGui:Destroy(); S.containerGui = nil end
    S.containerCell = nil
    table.clear(S.containerButtons)
end
function S.openContainer(part)
    local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or F.snapToGrid(part.Position)
    local key = tostring(math.floor(cell.X / BLOCK + 0.5)) .. ":" .. tostring(math.floor(cell.Y / BLOCK + 0.5)) .. ":" .. tostring(math.floor(cell.Z / BLOCK + 0.5))
    local data = F.localContainerData[key]
    if not data then data = {}; F.localContainerData[key] = data end
    S.closeContainer()
    S.containerCell = key
    S.containerGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    S.containerGui.Name = "MCContainerGui"
    S.containerGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    S.containerGui.DisplayOrder = 90
    S.containerGui.Parent = playerGui
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Container"
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48)
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 226)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 39, 31)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = S.containerGui
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 30)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    title.TextSize = 18
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    title.Text = (part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") == "ender_chest") and "Ender Chest (local)" or "Chest"
    title.Parent = frame
    local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
    close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 26)
    close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 3)
    close.Text = "X"
    close.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    close.TextSize = 16
    close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 55, 45)
    close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    close.Parent = frame
    close.Activated:Connect(S.closeContainer)
    local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22)
    hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 30)
    hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hint.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    hint.TextSize = 12
    hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 200)
    hint.Text = "Tap a slot to store / take the selected hotbar stack"
    hint.Parent = frame
    local function redraw()
        if not S.containerGui or not S.containerGui.Parent then return end
        for i, b in ipairs(S.containerButtons) do
            local st = data[i]
            b.Text = st and ((ITEMS[st.id] and ITEMS[st.id].name or st.id) .. "\n" .. tostring(st.n)) or "—"
        end
    end
    for i = 1, 27 do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Name = "Slot" .. i
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 44)
        local col = (i - 1) % 9
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 9)
        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10 + col * 38, 62 + row * 48)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(89, 73, 58)
        b.BorderSizePixel = 1
        b.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        b.TextSize = 11
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        b.TextWrapped = true
        b.Parent = frame
        S.containerButtons[i] = b
        b.Activated:Connect(function()
            if S.containerCell ~= key then return end
            local chestStack = data[i]
            local hot = slots[36 + selected]
            if chestStack then
                local moving = { id = chestStack.id, n = chestStack.n }
                F.insertStack(moving, 9, 44)
                if moving.n <= 0 then data[i] = nil else chestStack.n = moving.n end
            elseif hot then
                data[i] = { id = hot.id, n = hot.n }
                slots[36 + selected] = nil
            end
            if refresh then refresh() end
            redraw()
        end)
    end
    redraw()
end
F.closeContainer = S.closeContainer
-- Pressure plates use the custom player's simulated feet position. This is a
-- small local trigger system, not Minecraft's complete redstone signal graph.
S.platePoll = 0
F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    S.platePoll += dt
    if S.platePoll < 0.1 then return end
    S.platePoll = 0
    for _, plate in pairs(MCB.blocks) do
        if plate and plate.Parent then
            local id = plate:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") or ""
            if id:find("_pressure_plate$") or id == "stone_pressure_plate" or id == "heavy_weighted_pressure_plate" or id == "light_weighted_pressure_plate" then
                local cell = plate:GetAttribute("MCCell") or plate.Position
                local active = math.abs(pos.X - cell.X) < BLOCK * 0.42 and math.abs(pos.Z - cell.Z) < BLOCK * 0.42 and math.abs(pos.Y - (cell.Y - BLOCK * 0.5)) < BLOCK * 0.32
                if plate:GetAttribute("MCPressed") ~= active then
                    plate:SetAttribute("MCPressed", active)
                    local baseSize = plate:GetAttribute("MCBaseSize")
                    if typeof(baseSize) == "Vector3" then plate.Size = active and Vector3.new(baseSize.X, baseSize.Y * 0.55, baseSize.Z) or baseSize end
                    for _, offset in ipairs({Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis}) do
                        local neighbor = getBlockAt(cell + offset * BLOCK)
                        if neighbor and neighbor:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") == "redstone_lamp" then
                            neighbor:SetAttribute("MCLit", active)
                            neighbor.Color = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 120) or (S.BLOCK_COLORS.redstone_lamp or Color3.fromRGB(125, 90, 60))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end))

do
-- V8 furnace/smoker/blast-furnace processing. This is a client-local simulation:
-- fuel, progress, and output are stored as attributes/data in this executor session.
F.localFurnaceData = F.localFurnaceData or {}
local furnaceGui, furnaceKey, furnaceButtons = nil, nil, {}
local function furnaceCellKey(part)
    local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or F.snapToGrid(part.Position)
    return tostring(math.floor(cell.X / BLOCK + 0.5)) .. ":" ..
        tostring(math.floor(cell.Y / BLOCK + 0.5)) .. ":" ..
        tostring(math.floor(cell.Z / BLOCK + 0.5))
end
local function closeFurnace()
    if furnaceGui then furnaceGui:Destroy(); furnaceGui = nil end
    furnaceKey = nil
    table.clear(furnaceButtons)
end
local function smeltRecipe(blockId, inputId)
    local recipes = {
        raw_iron = "iron_ingot", raw_gold = "gold_ingot", raw_copper = "copper_ingot",
        iron_ore = "iron_ingot", deepslate_iron_ore = "iron_ingot",
        gold_ore = "gold_ingot", deepslate_gold_ore = "gold_ingot",
        copper_ore = "copper_ingot", deepslate_copper_ore = "copper_ingot",
        ancient_debris = "netherite_scrap", sand = "glass", red_sand = "glass",
        cobblestone = "stone", stone = "smooth_stone", clay_ball = "brick",
        wet_sponge = "sponge", netherrack = "nether_brick",
        potato = "baked_potato", raw_beef = "cooked_beef", beef = "cooked_beef",
        porkchop = "cooked_porkchop", raw_porkchop = "cooked_porkchop",
        chicken = "cooked_chicken", raw_chicken = "cooked_chicken",
        mutton = "cooked_mutton", rabbit = "cooked_rabbit",
        cod = "cooked_cod", raw_cod = "cooked_cod", salmon = "cooked_salmon",
        raw_salmon = "cooked_salmon", kelp = "dried_kelp"
    }
    if blockId == "smoker" then
        local foods = { raw_beef=true, beef=true, porkchop=true, raw_porkchop=true,
            chicken=true, raw_chicken=true, mutton=true, rabbit=true, cod=true,
            raw_cod=true, salmon=true, raw_salmon=true, potato=true }
        if not foods[inputId] then return nil end
    elseif blockId == "blast_furnace" then
        local ores = { raw_iron=true, raw_gold=true, raw_copper=true, iron_ore=true,
            deepslate_iron_ore=true, gold_ore=true, deepslate_gold_ore=true,
            copper_ore=true, deepslate_copper_ore=true, ancient_debris=true }
        if not ores[inputId] then return nil end
    end
    return recipes[inputId]
end
local function furnaceFuelTicks(id)
    if id == "lava_bucket" then return 2000 end
    if id == "coal_block" then return 16000 end
    if id == "coal" or id == "charcoal" then return 1600 end
    if id == "blaze_rod" then return 2400 end
    if id == "dried_kelp_block" then return 200 end
    if id == "oak_planks" or id == "stick" or id:find("_planks$") then return id == "stick" and 100 or 300 end
    if id:find("_log$") or id:find("_wood$") then return 300 end
    return 0
end
local function furnaceSlotTransfer(data, which)
    local hotIndex = 36 + selected
    local hot = slots[hotIndex]
    local station = data[which]
    if station then
        local moving = { id = station.id, n = station.n }
        F.insertStack(moving, 9, 44)
        if moving.n <= 0 then data[which] = nil else station.n = moving.n end
    elseif hot then
        if which == "out" then return end
        data[which] = { id = hot.id, n = hot.n }
        slots[hotIndex] = nil
    end
    if refresh then refresh() end
end
F.openFurnace = function(part)
    closeFurnace()
    local key = furnaceCellKey(part)
    local data = F.localFurnaceData[key] or { progress = 0, burn = 0, fuel = 0 }
    F.localFurnaceData[key] = data
    furnaceKey = key
    furnaceGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    furnaceGui.Name = "MCFurnaceGui"
    furnaceGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    furnaceGui.DisplayOrder = 91
    furnaceGui.Parent = playerGui
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48)
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 204)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(49, 43, 38)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = furnaceGui
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 28)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    title.TextSize = 17
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    title.Text = (part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") or "furnace"):gsub("_", " ")
    title.Parent = frame
    local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
    close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 25)
    close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 4)
    close.Text = "X"; close.Font = Enum.Font.Code; close.TextSize = 15
    close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 55, 45)
    close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); close.Parent = frame
    close.Activated:Connect(closeFurnace)
    local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 24)
    hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 34)
    hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hint.Font = Enum.Font.Code; hint.TextSize = 11
    hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 200)
    hint.Text = "Tap a slot to exchange with selected hotbar stack"
    hint.Parent = frame
    local function makeSlot(name, label, x, y, which)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Name = name
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 54)
        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(91, 77, 64)
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        b.Font = Enum.Font.Code; b.TextSize = 12; b.TextWrapped = true
        b.Parent = frame
        b.Activated:Connect(function()
            if furnaceKey == key then
                if which == "out" and data.out then
                    local moving = { id=data.out.id, n=data.out.n }
                    F.insertStack(moving, 9, 44)
                    if moving.n <= 0 then data.out = nil else data.out.n = moving.n end
                    if refresh then refresh() end
                else
                    furnaceSlotTransfer(data, which)
                end
            end
        end)
        furnaceButtons[#furnaceButtons+1] = {button=b, label=label, slot=which}
    end
    makeSlot("Input", "Input", 16, 72, "input")
    makeSlot("Fuel", "Fuel", 16, 132, "fuel")
    makeSlot("Output", "Output", 218, 96, "out")
    local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    status.Name = "Progress"
    status.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(105, 54)
    status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 98)
    status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    status.Font = Enum.Font.Code; status.TextSize = 12
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)
    status.TextWrapped = true; status.Parent = frame
    local function redraw()
        if not furnaceGui or not furnaceGui.Parent then return end
        for _, entry in ipairs(furnaceButtons) do
            local st = data[entry.slot]
            entry.button.Text = entry.label .. "\n" .. (st and ((ITEMS[st.id] and ITEMS[st.id].name or st.id) .. " x" .. st.n) or "—")
        end
        status.Text = string.format("Burn: %ds\nSmelt: %d%%", math.ceil((data.burn or 0)/20), math.floor((data.progress or 0)*100))
    end
    data.redraw = redraw
    redraw()
end
F.closeFurnace = closeFurnace
F.isFurnaceOpen = function() return furnaceGui ~= nil end
local furnacePoll = 0
F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    furnacePoll += dt
    if furnacePoll < 0.1 then return end
    dt = furnacePoll
    furnacePoll = 0
    for key, data in pairs(F.localFurnaceData) do
        local part
        for _, candidate in pairs(MCB.blocks) do
            if candidate and candidate.Parent and furnaceCellKey(candidate) == key then part = candidate break end
        end
        if part then
            local blockId = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") or "furnace"
            local outputId = data.input and smeltRecipe(blockId, data.input.id)
            local canOutput = outputId and ITEMS[outputId] and
                (not data.out or (data.out.id == outputId and data.out.n < F.maxOf(outputId)))
            if outputId and ITEMS[outputId] and canOutput then
                if (data.burn or 0) <= 0 and data.fuel and furnaceFuelTicks(data.fuel.id) > 0 then
                    data.burn = furnaceFuelTicks(data.fuel.id)
                    data.fuel.n -= 1
                    if data.fuel.n <= 0 then data.fuel = nil end
                end
                if (data.burn or 0) > 0 then
                    data.burn = math.max(0, data.burn - dt*20)
                    data.progress = (data.progress or 0) + dt/10
                    part:SetAttribute("MCLit", true)
                    part:SetAttribute("MCStatus", "lit")
                    if data.progress >= 1 then
                        data.progress -= 1
                        data.input.n -= 1
                        if data.input.n <= 0 then data.input = nil end
                        if data.out then data.out.n += 1 else data.out = {id=outputId,n=1} end
                    end
                else
                    part:SetAttribute("MCLit", false)
                    part:SetAttribute("MCStatus", "unlit")
                end
            else
                data.progress = 0
                if (data.burn or 0) <= 0 then
                    part:SetAttribute("MCLit", false)
                    part:SetAttribute("MCStatus", "unlit")
                end
            end
            local lit = part:GetAttribute("MCLit")
            part.Color = lit and Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 35) or (S.BLOCK_COLORS[blockId] or Color3.fromRGB(130,100,75))
            if data.redraw then data.redraw() end
        end
    end
end))
end -- furnace helper scope


-- Client-local 3x3 crafting-table grid, kept separate from inventory slot indices.
F.craftingTableSlots = F.craftingTableSlots or {}
local tableGui, tableCellKey, tableGridButtons = nil, nil, {}
function S.craftingKey(part)
    local c=part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or F.snapToGrid(part.Position)
    return string.format("%d:%d:%d",math.floor(c.X/BLOCK+0.5),math.floor(c.Y/BLOCK+0.5),math.floor(c.Z/BLOCK+0.5))
end
function S.closeCraftingTable()
    if tableGui then tableGui:Destroy(); tableGui=nil end
    if tableCellKey then
        local grid=F.craftingTableSlots[tableCellKey]
        if grid then
            for i=1,9 do
                if grid[i] then
                    local moving={id=grid[i].id,n=grid[i].n}
                    F.insertStack(moving,9,44)
                    if moving.n<=0 then grid[i]=nil else grid[i].n=moving.n end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    tableCellKey=nil; tableGridButtons={}
    if refresh then refresh() end
end
function S.tableRecipe(grid)
    local occupied={}
    local minX,minY,maxX,maxY,count=4,4,0,0,0
    for i=1,9 do
        if grid[i] then
            local x=(i-1)%3+1; local y=math.floor((i-1)/3)+1
            occupied[#occupied+1]={x=x,y=y,id=grid[i].id}
            minX=math.min(minX,x); minY=math.min(minY,y); maxX=math.max(maxX,x); maxY=math.max(maxY,y); count+=1
        end
    end
    if count==0 then return nil end
    local w,h=maxX-minX+1,maxY-minY+1
    local pattern={}
    for y=minY,maxY do for x=minX,maxX do
        local st=grid[(y-1)*3+x]; pattern[#pattern+1]=st and st.id or ""
    end end
    local function same(a)
        if #a~=#pattern then return false end
        for i=1,#a do if (a[i] or "")~=pattern[i] then return false end end
        return true
    end
    if count==1 then
        local id=occupied[1].id
        if id:find("_log$") then local out=id:gsub("_log$","_planks"); if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=4} end end
        if id:find("_wood$") then local out=id:gsub("_wood$","_planks"); if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=4} end end
        if id:find("_planks$") then local out=id:gsub("_planks$","_button"); if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=1} end end
        if id=="stone" then return {id="stone_button",n=1} end
    end
    if count==2 and w==1 and h==2 and pattern[1]==pattern[2] and pattern[1]:find("_planks$") then return {id="stick",n=4} end
    if count==2 and w==2 and h==1 and pattern[1]==pattern[2] and pattern[1]:find("_planks$") then
        local out=pattern[1]:gsub("_planks$","_pressure_plate"); if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=1} end
    end
    if count==4 and w==2 and h==2 and pattern[1]==pattern[2] and pattern[1]==pattern[3] and pattern[1]==pattern[4] and pattern[1]:find("_planks$") then return {id="crafting_table",n=1} end
    if count==3 and w==3 and h==1 and pattern[1]==pattern[2] and pattern[1]==pattern[3] and pattern[1]:find("_planks$") then
        local out=pattern[1]:gsub("_planks$","_slab"); if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=6} end
    end
    if count==3 and w==3 and h==1 and pattern[1]=="stone" and pattern[2]=="stone" and pattern[3]=="stone" and ITEMS.stone_slab then return {id="stone_slab",n=6} end
    if count==6 and w==3 and h==3 and pattern[1] and pattern[1]:find("_planks$") then
        local shaped = pattern[1]==pattern[2] and pattern[2]==pattern[3]
            and pattern[4]=="" and pattern[5]==pattern[1] and pattern[6]==pattern[1]
            and pattern[7]=="" and pattern[8]=="" and pattern[9]==pattern[1]
        if shaped then
            local out=pattern[1]:gsub("_planks$","_stairs")
            if ITEMS[out] then return {id=out,n=4} end
        end
    end
    if F.MOD_RECIPES then
        for _,r in pairs(F.MOD_RECIPES) do
            if type(r)=="table" and type(r.pattern)=="table" and r.output and #r.pattern==#pattern and same(r.pattern) and ITEMS[r.output] then
                return {id=r.output,n=tonumber(r.count) or 1}
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function S.tableCraft(grid)
    local result=S.tableRecipe(grid)
    if not result or not ITEMS[result.id] or not F.canFit(result.id,result.n,9,44) then return end
    for i=1,9 do if grid[i] then grid[i].n-=1; if grid[i].n<=0 then grid[i]=nil end end end
    F.give(result.id,result.n,9,44)
    if refresh then refresh() end
end
function S.openCraftingTable(part)
    S.closeCraftingTable()
    local key=S.craftingKey(part); local grid=F.craftingTableSlots[key] or {}; F.craftingTableSlots[key]=grid; tableCellKey=key
    tableGui=Instance.new("ScreenGui"); tableGui.Name="MCCraftingTableGui"; tableGui.ResetOnSpawn=false; tableGui.DisplayOrder=92; tableGui.Parent=playerGui
    local frame=Instance.new("Frame"); frame.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); frame.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.48); frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,282)
    frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(48,43,37); frame.BorderSizePixel=0; frame.Parent=tableGui
    local title=Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-44,0,28); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,4); title.BackgroundTransparency=1
    title.Font=Enum.Font.Code; title.TextSize=17; title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); title.Text="Crafting"; title.Parent=frame
    local close=Instance.new("TextButton"); close.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,25); close.Position=UDim2.new(1,-32,0,4); close.Text="X"; close.Font=Enum.Font.Code
    close.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,55,45); close.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); close.Parent=frame; close.Activated:Connect(S.closeCraftingTable)
    local hint=Instance.new("TextLabel"); hint.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,22); hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,32); hint.BackgroundTransparency=1
    hint.Font=Enum.Font.Code; hint.TextSize=10; hint.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,220,200); hint.Text="Tap grid slot to place one selected hotbar item"; hint.Parent=frame
    local function redraw()
        if not tableGui or not tableGui.Parent then return end
        for _,e in ipairs(tableGridButtons) do local st=grid[e.index]; e.button.Text=st and ((ITEMS[st.id] and ITEMS[st.id].name or st.id).."\nx"..st.n) or "—" end
        local result=S.tableRecipe(grid); tableGridButtons.output.Text=result and ((ITEMS[result.id] and ITEMS[result.id].name or result.id).."\nx"..result.n) or "Output"
    end
    for i=1,9 do
        local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); local x=(i-1)%3; local y=math.floor((i-1)/3)
        b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(55,48); b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18+x*59,66+y*52); b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(91,77,64)
        b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); b.Font=Enum.Font.Code; b.TextSize=10; b.TextWrapped=true; b.Parent=frame
        tableGridButtons[#tableGridButtons+1]={button=b,index=i}
        b.Activated:Connect(function()
            if tableCellKey~=key then return end
            local st=grid[i]; local hotIndex=36+selected; local hot=slots[hotIndex]
            if st then local moving={id=st.id,n=st.n}; F.insertStack(moving,9,44); if moving.n<=0 then grid[i]=nil else st.n=moving.n end
            elseif hot then grid[i]={id=hot.id,n=1}; hot.n-=1; if hot.n<=0 then slots[hotIndex]=nil end end
            redraw(); if refresh then refresh() end
        end)
    end
    local arrow=Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(35,35); arrow.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(205,112); arrow.BackgroundTransparency=1
    arrow.Font=Enum.Font.Code; arrow.TextSize=24; arrow.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); arrow.Text="→"; arrow.Parent=frame
    local out=Instance.new("TextButton"); out.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(74,60); out.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(247,102); out.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(103,86,61)
    out.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); out.Font=Enum.Font.Code; out.TextSize=11; out.TextWrapped=true; out.Parent=frame; tableGridButtons.output=out
    out.Activated:Connect(function() if tableCellKey==key then S.tableCraft(grid); redraw() end end)
    local note=Instance.new("TextLabel"); note.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28); note.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,236); note.BackgroundTransparency=1
    note.Font=Enum.Font.Code; note.TextSize=10; note.TextWrapped=true; note.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,205,180); note.Text="Partial recipe set; unmatched patterns cannot craft."; note.Parent=frame
    redraw()
end
F.closeCraftingTable=S.closeCraftingTable

F.interactBlock = function(part)
    if not F.isMCBlock(part) then return false end
    local id = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") or ""
    local kind = part:GetAttribute("MCInteractKind")
    if id == "chest" or id == "trapped_chest" or id == "barrel" or id == "ender_chest" or id:find("shulker_box$") then
        S.openContainer(part)
        return true
    end
    if id == "crafting_table" then
        S.openCraftingTable(part)
        return true
    end
    if id == "furnace" or id == "blast_furnace" or id == "smoker" then
        F.openFurnace(part)
        return true
    elseif id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire" then
        local lit = not part:GetAttribute("MCLit")
        part:SetAttribute("MCLit", lit)
        part.Color = lit and Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 35) or (S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] or Color3.fromRGB(130, 100, 75))
        part:SetAttribute("MCStatus", lit and "lit" or "unlit")
        return true
    end
    if kind == "door" or kind == "trapdoor" or kind == "gate" or id == "lever" or id == "stone_button" or id:find("_button$") then
        local open = not part:GetAttribute("MCOpen")
        part:SetAttribute("MCOpen", open)
        local baseCf = part:GetAttribute("MCBaseCFrame")
        if typeof(baseCf) == "CFrame" then
            if kind == "door" then
                part.CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.Angles(0, open and math.rad(90) or 0, 0)
            elseif kind == "trapdoor" then
                part.CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.Angles(open and math.rad(90) or 0, 0, 0)
            else
                part.CFrame = baseCf
            end
        end
        if kind == "gate" then part.CanCollide = not open; part.Transparency = open and 0.45 or 0
        elseif id == "lever" or id == "stone_button" or id:find("_button$") then
            part.Color = open and Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 75) or (S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] or Color3.fromRGB(125,125,125))
        end
        -- A simple adjacent-lamp response provides local feedback, not full redstone simulation.
        local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell") or part.Position
        for _, offset in ipairs({Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis}) do
            local neighbor = getBlockAt(cell + offset * BLOCK)
            if neighbor and neighbor:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") == "redstone_lamp" then
                neighbor:SetAttribute("MCLit", open)
                neighbor.Color = open and Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 120) or (S.BLOCK_COLORS.redstone_lamp or Color3.fromRGB(125, 90, 60))
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    if kind == "rest" or id == "cushion" or id == "straw_bed" or id:find("_bed$") then
        part:SetAttribute("MCUsedAt", os.clock())
        part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 175, 115)
        return true
    end
    return false
end
F.startUseItem = function()
        if F.playerDead or invOpen or F.eating then return end
        if S.rightClickDelay > 0 then return end
        local held = slots[36 + selected]
        local id = held and held.id or nil
        local targetPart, targetHitPos, targetNormal = F.pickBlock()

        -- Spawn eggs have two ID conventions in this replica: the inventory uses
        -- spawn_egg_<mob>, while some generated/mod items use <mob>_spawn_egg.
        -- Resolve both formats explicitly instead of relying only on ITEMS[id].mobSpawn.
        local mobSpawnId = id and ITEMS[id] and ITEMS[id].mobSpawn or nil
        if not mobSpawnId and type(id) == "string" then
                mobSpawnId = id:match("^spawn_egg_(.+)$") or id:match("^(.+)_spawn_egg$")
        end
        if mobSpawnId then
                local aliases = {tropicalfish = "tropical_fish", zombie_pigman = "zombified_piglin"}
                mobSpawnId = aliases[mobSpawnId] or mobSpawnId
                local spawnPosition = nil
                if targetHitPos then
                        local normal = targetNormal or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                        spawnPosition = targetHitPos + normal * (BLOCK * 0.65)
                end
                local ok, spawned = pcall(F.spawnLocalMob, mobSpawnId, spawnPosition)
                S.rightClickDelay = 4
                if ok and spawned then
                        if not creative and held then
                                held.n = (tonumber(held.n) or 1) - 1
                                if held.n <= 0 then slots[36 + selected] = nil end
                                if refresh then refresh() end
                        end
                        F.startSwing()
                elseif not ok then
                        warn("[Minecraft Replica] Spawn egg failed (" .. tostring(id) .. "): " .. tostring(spawned))
                        if F.appendChatLine then F.appendChatLine("Spawn egg failed: " .. tostring(spawned):sub(1, 120)) end
                end
                S.useHeld = false
                return
        end

        if targetPart and F.interactBlock(targetPart) then
                S.rightClickDelay = 4
                S.useHeld = false -- block interactions are edge-triggered, not repeated while held
                F.startSwing()
                return
        end
        if id and ITEMS[id] and ITEMS[id].food then
                F.eating = true
                F.eatTime = 0
                F.eatTimePrev = 0
                F.eatItemId = id
                S.rightClickDelay = 32
                return
        end
        S.rightClickDelay = 4
    local part, hitPos, normal = targetPart, targetHitPos, targetNormal
        -- Placement uses the hit face and shared grid directly; it must not replace
        -- the target part with voxel chunks as a side effect of placing a block.
        if not normal then return end
        if id and ITEMS[id] and ITEMS[id].placeable then
                F.placeBlock(id, part, hitPos, normal)
                F.startSwing()
        end
end
F.stopUseItem = function()
        S.useHeld = false
        if F.eating then
                -- Freeze the elapsed phase and let the render-smoothed blend fade out.
                -- Resetting eatTime here made the item/arm jump back to frame zero.
                F.eating = false
                F.eatItemId = nil
                S.rightClickDelay = 0
        end
end

gui.Name = "MinecraftGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 50
gui.Parent = playerGui

S.iconTpl = {}
