F.buildToolIcon = function(info)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * S.GS, 16 * S.GS)
        if info.image and info.image ~= "" then
                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                img.Image = info.image
                img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                img.Parent = f
        else
                local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                t.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
                t.TextScaled = true
                t.TextWrapped = true
                t.Text = info.name
                t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
                t.Parent = f
        end
        return f
end
F.cloneIcon = function(id)
        if not S.iconTpl[id] then
                if F.toolInfo[id] then
                        S.iconTpl[id] = F.buildToolIcon(F.toolInfo[id])
                else
                        S.iconTpl[id] = F.buildImage(S.ICON[id], S.GS)
                end
        end
        return S.iconTpl[id]:Clone()
end

-- Safe local TXT mod loader: each .txt is JSON data (never loadstring/executable Lua).
-- Place files directly in the executor's workspace folder or workspace/MinecraftMods.
do
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local function validModId(id)
    return type(id) == "string" and #id >= 1 and #id <= 64 and id:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") ~= nil
end
local function resolveModAsset(rawPath, modPath)
    if type(rawPath) ~= "string" or rawPath == "" then return nil end
    local path = rawPath
    if not path:find("[/\\]") then
        local prefix = modPath:match("^(.*[/])") or ""
        path = prefix .. path
    end
    local uri
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then uri = result end
    end
    if not uri and type(getsynasset) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(getsynasset, path)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then uri = result end
    end
    return uri
end
local function inlineTexture(row)
    -- v14: textures can be embedded as run-length pixel data {w=16,h=16,d="count:hex;count:-;..."} (see png2mc.py)
    local t = row.pixels or row.texture or row.icon or row.image
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local w, h, d = math.floor(tonumber(t.w) or 0), math.floor(tonumber(t.h) or 0), t.d
    if w < 1 or h < 1 or w > 32 or h > 32 or type(d) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local total = 0
    for count, hex in d:gmatch("(%d+):([%x%-]+)") do
        if hex ~= "-" and #hex ~= 6 then return nil end
        total += tonumber(count)
    end
    if total ~= w * h then return nil end
    return { w = w, h = h, d = d }
end
local function modArray(value)
    return type(value) == "table" and value or {}
end
F.loadModFile = function(path)
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return false, "Executor readfile() is unavailable." end
    if F.MOD_FILES_LOADED[path] then return false, "Already loaded: " .. tostring(path) end
    local okRead, raw = pcall(readfile, path)
    if not okRead or type(raw) ~= "string" then return false, "Could not read " .. tostring(path) end
    local okJson, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" then return false, "Invalid JSON in " .. tostring(path) end
    local modName = tostring(data.name or path:match("([^/\\\\]+)%.txt$") or "Local Mod")
    local addedBlocks, addedItems, addedMobs = 0, 0, 0

    -- Accept {blocks:[...]} and texture packs such as {textures:{stone:{w,h,d}}}.
    local blockRows = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(modArray(data.blocks)) do blockRows[#blockRows + 1] = row end
    if type(data.textures) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(data.textures) do
            if type(value) == "table" then
                local row = {}
                for k, v in pairs(value) do row[k] = v end
                if type(key) == "string" then row.id = row.id or key end
                row.pixels = row.pixels or ((row.w and row.h and row.d) and {w=row.w,h=row.h,d=row.d} or nil)
                row.hidden = row.hidden ~= false
                if ITEMS[row.id] then
                    row.hidden = false
                    row.faces = row.faces or {all = row.id}
                end
                blockRows[#blockRows + 1] = row
            end
        end
    end
    -- Data-only entity definitions plug into the existing renderer/AI; mod files never execute code.
    local mobRows = data.mobs or data.entities
    if type(mobRows) == "table" then
        for key, row in pairs(mobRows) do
            if type(row) == "table" then
                local id = tostring(row.id or key):lower():gsub("[^%w_]", "")
                if id:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") then
                    row.id = id
                    F.MOD_MOB_DEFS[id] = row
                    F.localMobTypes[id] = true
                    addedMobs += 1
                    local tx = inlineTexture(row)
                    if tx then
                        S.ICON["mob_" .. id] = tx
                        if tx.w == 16 and tx.h == 16 then S.BTEX["mob_" .. id] = tx end
                    elseif type(row.texture) == "string" and S.BTEX[row.texture] then
                        S.BTEX["mob_" .. id] = S.BTEX[row.texture]
                    elseif type(row.texture_id) == "string" and S.BTEX[row.texture_id] then
                        S.BTEX["mob_" .. id] = S.BTEX[row.texture_id]
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Inline pixel textures can override built-in blocks and items as well as add new IDs.
    for _, row in ipairs(blockRows) do
        if type(row) == "table" and validModId(row.id) then
            local inline = inlineTexture(row)
            if inline then
                S.ICON[row.id] = inline
                if inline.w == 16 and inline.h == 16 then S.BTEX[row.id] = inline end
            end
            if not ITEMS[row.id] and row.hidden ~= true then
                local name = tostring(row.name or F.prettyId(row.id))
                local color = F.hexColor(row.color or row.hex, Color3.fromRGB(145,145,145))
                local cat = tostring(row.category or "building")
                if cat ~= "building" and cat ~= "colored" and cat ~= "natural" and cat ~= "functional" and cat ~= "redstone" and cat ~= "operator" then cat = "building" end
                local hardness = math.clamp(tonumber(row.hardness) or 1.5, 0, 100)
                ITEMS[row.id] = { name = name, max = 64, placeable = true, hardness = hardness, category = cat, mod = true }
                S.BLOCK_COLORS[row.id] = color
                if inline and inline.w == 16 and inline.h == 16 then F.BLOCKFACES[row.id] = { all = row.id } end
                local texture = resolveModAsset(row.texture or row.image or row.icon, path)
                if texture then F.MOD_TEXTURES[row.id] = texture end
                addedBlocks += 1
            elseif ITEMS[row.id] and row.hidden ~= true then
                -- retexture an existing built-in: refresh its base colour if one is supplied
                if row.color or row.hex then S.BLOCK_COLORS[row.id] = F.hexColor(row.color or row.hex, S.BLOCK_COLORS[row.id]) end
                -- existing blocks had no BLOCKFACES entry: make the new art actually paint faces
                -- (blocks with built-in per-face mappings keep them unless a faces row overrides below)
                if inline and inline.w == 16 and inline.h == 16 and not F.BLOCKFACES[row.id] then
                    F.BLOCKFACES[row.id] = { all = row.id }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- second pass: per-face overrides once every aux texture is registered
    for _, row in ipairs(blockRows) do
        if type(row) == "table" and validModId(row.id) and type(row.faces) == "table" and S.BTEX[row.id] and not F.BLOCKFACES[row.id .. "_locked"] then
            local bf, ok = {}, true
            for _, k in ipairs({ "all", "top", "bottom", "front", "side" }) do
                local key = row.faces[k]
                if key ~= nil then
                    if type(key) == "string" and S.BTEX[key] then bf[k] = key else ok = false break end
                end
            end
            if ok and next(bf) then F.BLOCKFACES[row.id] = bf end
        end
    end
    -- Bedrock texture exports use helper IDs such as grass_top, furnace_front,
    -- sandstone_bottom, etc. Register those helpers as faces on the actual block IDs.
    -- This is what makes the uploaded "Bedrock Textures (Blocks)" JSON show in-world,
    -- rather than merely appearing as isolated icon textures.
    do
        local faceSuffixes = {
            { suffix = "_top", face = "top" },
            { suffix = "_bottom", face = "bottom" },
            { suffix = "_front", face = "front" },
            { suffix = "_side", face = "side" },
            { suffix = "_sides", face = "side" },
        }
        local aliases = {
            grass = "grass_block",
            dirt_path = "dirt_path",
            ct = "crafting_table",
            log = "oak_log",
            planks = "oak_planks",
            cobble = "cobblestone",
            ender_chest = "ender_chest",
            trapped_chest = "trapped_chest",
            sticky_piston = "sticky_piston",
        }
        local grouped = {}
        for textureId in pairs(S.BTEX) do
            for _, rule in ipairs(faceSuffixes) do
                if #textureId > #rule.suffix and textureId:sub(-#rule.suffix) == rule.suffix then
                    local base = textureId:sub(1, #textureId - #rule.suffix)
                    local blockId = aliases[base] or base
                    if ITEMS[blockId] and ITEMS[blockId].placeable then
                        grouped[blockId] = grouped[blockId] or {}
                        grouped[blockId][rule.face] = textureId
                    end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        -- Prefer the exported vanilla-style faces, while preserving existing mappings
        -- for faces that the pack did not provide.
        for blockId, faces in pairs(grouped) do
            local current = F.BLOCKFACES[blockId] or {}
            local merged = {}
            for k, v in pairs(current) do merged[k] = v end
            for k, v in pairs(faces) do merged[k] = v end
            if not merged.all then F.BLOCKFACES[blockId] = merged end
        end
        -- The export uses "grass_top"/"grass_side", while the in-game ID is grass_block.
        if ITEMS.grass_block and S.BTEX.grass_top and S.BTEX.grass_side then
            F.BLOCKFACES.grass_block = { top = "grass_top", bottom = "dirt", side = "grass_side" }
        end
        if ITEMS.crafting_table and S.BTEX.ct_top then
            F.BLOCKFACES.crafting_table = {
                top = "ct_top", bottom = S.BTEX.planks and "planks" or "ct_top",
                front = S.BTEX.ct_front and "ct_front" or "ct_top",
                side = S.BTEX.ct_side and "ct_side" or "ct_top"
            }
        end
    end

    for _, row in ipairs(modArray(data.items)) do
        if type(row) == "table" and validModId(row.id) then
            local inline = inlineTexture(row)
            if inline then S.ICON[row.id] = inline end
            if not ITEMS[row.id] then
                local cat = tostring(row.category or "ingredients")
                local cats = {building=true,colored=true,natural=true,functional=true,redstone=true,tools=true,combat=true,food=true,ingredients=true,spawn=true,operator=true}
                if not cats[cat] then cat = "ingredients" end
                local maxStack = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(row.maxStack or row.max) or 64), 1, 64)
                local food = tonumber(row.food)
                ITEMS[row.id] = { name = tostring(row.name or F.prettyId(row.id)), max = maxStack, category = cat, mod = true, food = food and math.clamp(food, 0, 20) or nil }
                local texture = resolveModAsset(row.texture or row.image or row.icon, path)
                if texture then F.MOD_TEXTURES[row.id] = texture end
                addedItems += 1
            end
        end
    end
    for _, recipe in ipairs(modArray(data.recipes)) do
        if type(recipe) == "table" and type(recipe.output) == "string" and ITEMS[recipe.output] and type(recipe.ingredients) == "table" and #recipe.ingredients == 4 then
            local clean = {}
            local valid = true
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local ingredient = recipe.ingredients[i]
                if ingredient ~= nil and ingredient ~= "" and (type(ingredient) ~= "string" or not ITEMS[ingredient]) then valid = false end
                clean[i] = ingredient or ""
            end
            if valid then F.MOD_RECIPES[#F.MOD_RECIPES + 1] = { ingredients = clean, output = recipe.output, count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(recipe.count) or 1), 1, 64) } end
        end
    end
    F.MOD_FILES_LOADED[path] = true
    F.MODS_LOADED[#F.MODS_LOADED + 1] = { name = modName, path = path, blocks = addedBlocks, items = addedItems, mobs = addedMobs }
    for id, item in pairs(ITEMS) do
        if not F.toolInfo[id] and not S.ICON[id] then F.toolInfo[id] = { name = string.sub(tostring(item.name or id), 1, 2):upper() } end
        if F.MOD_TEXTURES[id] then F.toolInfo[id] = { name = string.sub(tostring(item.name or id), 1, 2):upper(), image = F.MOD_TEXTURES[id] } end
        if F.clearIconCache then F.clearIconCache(id) end
    end
    return true, string.format("Loaded %s (+%d blocks, +%d items, +%d mobs)", modName, addedBlocks, addedItems, addedMobs)
end
F.scanModFiles = function()
    local seenPaths, paths = {}, {}
    if type(listfiles) == "function" then
        for _, folderPath in ipairs({"workspace", "workspace/MinecraftMods", "workspace\\MinecraftMods"}) do
            local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, folderPath)
            if okList and type(files) == "table" then
                for _, path in ipairs(files) do
                    if type(path) == "string" then
                        if path:lower():match("%.txt$") and not seenPaths[path] then
                            seenPaths[path] = true
                            paths[#paths + 1] = path
                        elseif type(listfiles) == "function" and not path:lower():match("%.txt$") then
                            -- One directory level is enough for common workspace/Textures and workspace/Mobs layouts.
                            local okNested, nested = pcall(listfiles, path)
                            if okNested and type(nested) == "table" then
                                for _, nestedPath in ipairs(nested) do
                                    if type(nestedPath) == "string" and nestedPath:lower():match("%.txt$") and not seenPaths[nestedPath] then
                                        seenPaths[nestedPath] = true
                                        paths[#paths + 1] = nestedPath
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local loaded, errors = 0, {}
    table.sort(paths)
    for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
        local ok, msg = F.loadModFile(path)
        if ok then loaded += 1 elseif not F.MOD_FILES_LOADED[path] then errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(msg) end
    end
    return loaded, #paths, errors
end
-- Load workspace mods before the creative catalogue is built.
F.scanModFiles()
for id, item in pairs(ITEMS) do
    if not F.toolInfo[id] and not S.ICON[id] then F.toolInfo[id] = { name = string.sub(tostring(item.name or id), 1, 2):upper() } end
    if F.MOD_TEXTURES[id] then F.toolInfo[id] = { name = string.sub(tostring(item.name or id), 1, 2):upper(), image = F.MOD_TEXTURES[id] } end
end
local function decorateModBlock(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return end
    local blockId = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
    local texture = blockId and F.MOD_TEXTURES[blockId]
    if not texture or part:GetAttribute("MCModTextureApplied") then return end
    part:SetAttribute("MCModTextureApplied", true)
    for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
        local surface = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        surface.Name = "LocalModTexture"
        surface.Face = face
        surface.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
        surface.PixelsPerStud = 16
        surface.LightInfluence = 0.5
        surface.Parent = part
        local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        image.Image = texture
        image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
        image.TileSize = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        image.Parent = surface
    end
end
F.decorateModBlock = decorateModBlock
F.track(blockFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    task.defer(function() decorateModBlock(child) end)
end))
local originalUpdateCraft = F.updateCraft
F.updateCraft = function()
    originalUpdateCraft()
    if slots[0] then return end
    for _, recipe in ipairs(F.MOD_RECIPES) do
        local matched = true
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local current = slots[i] and slots[i].id or ""
            if current ~= recipe.ingredients[i] then matched = false break end
        end
        if matched then slots[0] = { id = recipe.output, n = recipe.count }; return end
    end
end
end -- local mod-loader helpers

        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        t.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
        t.TextSize = size
        t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        t.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
        t.ZIndex = z
        t.Text = ""
        t.Parent = parent
        return t
end
F.newView = function(parent, x, y, z)
        local v = {}
        v.holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        v.holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        v.holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * S.GS, 16 * S.GS)
        v.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * S.GS, y * S.GS)
        v.holder.ZIndex = z
        v.holder.Parent = parent
        v.shadow = F.textLabel(v.holder, 8 * S.GS, z + 2)
        v.shadow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(62, 62, 62)
        v.shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17 * S.GS, 17 * S.GS)
        v.shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(S.GS, S.GS)
        v.count = F.textLabel(v.holder, 8 * S.GS, z + 3)
        v.count.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        v.count.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17 * S.GS, 17 * S.GS)
        return v
end
F.setView = function(v, st)
        if st then
                if v.id ~= st.id then
                        if v.icon then v.icon:Destroy() end
                        v.icon = F.cloneIcon(st.id)
                        v.icon.ZIndex = v.holder.ZIndex + 1
                        v.icon.Parent = v.holder
                        v.id = st.id
                end
                local t = st.n > 1 and tostring(st.n) or ""
                v.count.Text = t
                v.shadow.Text = t
        else
                if v.icon then v.icon:Destroy() v.icon = nil end
                v.id = nil
                v.count.Text = ""
                v.shadow.Text = ""
        end
end

    end))

        if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            F.selectHotbar(slotIndex)
        end
    end))
end

refresh = function()
        for i = 0, 45 do
                if S.views[i] then F.setView(S.views[i], slots[i]) end
                if F.cViews[i] then F.setView(F.cViews[i], slots[i]) end
        end
        if F.updateGhosts then F.updateGhosts() end
        for i = 0, 8 do
        if S.hudViews[i] then F.setView(S.hudViews[i], slots[36 + i]) end
    end
        F.setView(S.carriedView, carried)
        S.carriedView.holder.Visible = invOpen and carried ~= nil
        if S.hover ~= nil and slots[S.hover] and not carried then
                S.tooltip.Text = ITEMS[slots[S.hover].id].name
                S.tooltip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((#S.tooltip.Text * 6 + 8) * S.GS, 12 * S.GS)
                S.tooltip.Visible = invOpen
        else
                S.tooltip.Visible = false
        end
end
F.quickMove = function(idx)
        local s = slots[idx]
        if not s then return end
        if (idx >= 1 and idx <= 4) or idx == 45 then
                F.insertStack(s, 9, 44)
        elseif idx >= 9 and idx <= 35 then
                F.insertStack(s, 36, 44)
        elseif idx >= 36 and idx <= 44 then
                F.insertStack(s, 9, 35)
        end
        if s and s.n <= 0 then slots[idx] = nil end
        F.updateCraft()
end
F.resultClick = function(shift)
        local r = slots[0]
        if not r then return end
        if shift then
                for _ = 1, 64 do
                        r = slots[0]
                        if not r then break end
                        if not F.canFit(r.id, r.n, 9, 44) then break end
                        F.insertStack({ id = r.id, n = r.n }, 9, 44)
                        F.consumeCraft()
                end
        else
                if carried == nil then
                        carried = { id = r.id, n = r.n }
                        F.consumeCraft()
                elseif carried.id == r.id and carried.n + r.n <= F.maxOf(r.id) then
                        carried.n += r.n
                        F.consumeCraft()
                end
        end
end
F.clickSlot = function(idx, button, shift)
        if idx == 0 then F.resultClick(shift) refresh() return end
        if shift then F.quickMove(idx) refresh() return end
        local s = slots[idx]
        if button == 1 then
                if carried == nil then
                        if s then carried = s slots[idx] = nil end
                elseif s == nil then
                        if F.canPlace(idx, carried) then slots[idx] = carried carried = nil end
                elseif s.id == carried.id and F.maxOf(s.id) > 1 then
                        local mv = math.min(F.maxOf(s.id) - s.n, carried.n)
                        s.n += mv carried.n -= mv
                        if carried.n <= 0 then carried = nil end
                elseif F.canPlace(idx, carried) then
                        slots[idx], carried = carried, s
                end
        else
                if carried == nil then
                        if s then
                                local take = math.ceil(s.n / 2)
                                carried = { id = s.id, n = take }
                                s.n -= take
                                if s.n <= 0 then slots[idx] = nil end
                        end
                elseif s == nil then
                        if F.canPlace(idx, carried) then
                                slots[idx] = { id = carried.id, n = 1 }
                                carried.n -= 1
                        end
                elseif s.id == carried.id and s.n < F.maxOf(s.id) then
                        s.n += 1 carried.n -= 1
                elseif F.canPlace(idx, carried) then
                        slots[idx], carried = carried, s
                end
                if carried and carried.n <= 0 then carried = nil end
        end
        F.updateCraft()
        refresh()
end
F.cButtons, F.cCatalogButtons = {}, {}
-- True when a GuiObject and every ancestor are visible (a hidden parent keeps the child's own Visible true).
F.guiShown = function(obj)
        while obj and obj:IsA("GuiObject") do
                if not obj.Visible then return false end
                obj = obj.Parent
        end
        return obj ~= nil
end
F.pointOnButton = function(btn, pos)
        if not (btn and F.guiShown(btn)) then return false end
        local ap, as = btn.AbsolutePosition, btn.AbsoluteSize
        return pos.X >= ap.X and pos.X <= ap.X + as.X and pos.Y >= ap.Y and pos.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
end
F.findTouchTarget = function(pos)
        for _, b in ipairs(F.cCatalogButtons) do
                if F.pointOnButton(b, pos) then return nil, true end
        end
        for targetIdx, targetButton in pairs(F.cButtons) do
                if F.pointOnButton(targetButton, pos) then return targetIdx, false end
        end
        for targetIdx, targetButton in pairs(S.slotButtons) do
                if F.pointOnButton(targetButton, pos) then return targetIdx, false end
        end
        return nil, false
end
-- Builds the item view + click/touch button for one inventory slot on any panel.
F.bindSlot = function(idx, p, parentView, parentBtn, viewStore, btnStore, hl)
        viewStore[idx] = F.newView(parentView, p[1], p[2], 33)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.Text = ""
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18 * S.GS, 18 * S.GS)
        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((p[1] - 1) * S.GS, (p[2] - 1) * S.GS)
        b.ZIndex = 42
        b.Parent = parentBtn
        btnStore[idx] = b
        local touchStart = 0
        F.track(b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                S.hover = idx
                hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p[1] * S.GS, p[2] * S.GS)
                hl.Visible = true
                refresh()
        end))
        F.track(b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if S.hover == idx then S.hover = nil hl.Visible = false refresh() end
        end))
        F.track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        F.clickSlot(idx, 1, UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift))
                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        F.clickSlot(idx, 2, false)
                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        touchStart = os.clock()
                        F.activeTouchSlot = idx
                        F.touchDragStartPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                        F.touchDragStartTime = touchStart
                        F.touchDragCanPick = carried == nil and slots[idx] ~= nil
                        F.touchDragging = false
                        S.hover = idx
                        hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p[1] * S.GS, p[2] * S.GS)
                        hl.Visible = true
                end
        end))
        F.track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and touchStart > 0 then
                        local long = os.clock() - touchStart > 0.35
                        local endPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                        if F.touchDragging then
                                local hitDelete = F.pointOnButton(F.deleteButton, endPos) or F.pointOnButton(F.cDeleteButton, endPos)
                                if hitDelete then
                                        carried = nil
                                        refresh()
                                else
                                        local targetSlot, onCatalog = F.findTouchTarget(endPos)
                                        if onCatalog then
                                                carried = nil
                                                refresh()
                                        elseif targetSlot ~= nil then
                                                F.clickSlot(targetSlot, 1, false)
                                        end
                                end
                        else
                                F.clickSlot(idx, long and 2 or 1, false)
                        end
                        touchStart = 0
                        F.activeTouchSlot = nil
                        F.touchDragStartPos = nil
                        F.touchDragCanPick = false
                        F.touchDragging = false
                        S.hover = nil
                        hl.Visible = false
                        refresh()
                end
        end))
end
for idx, p in pairs(layout) do
        F.bindSlot(idx, p, S.panel, S.panel, S.views, S.slotButtons, S.highlight)
end
F.track(S.invDim.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not invOpen or carried == nil then return end
        local t = input.UserInputType
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                carried = nil refresh()
        elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                carried.n -= 1
                if carried.n <= 0 then carried = nil end
                refresh()
        end
end))
F.setInventory = function(open)
        if F.playerDead and open then return end
        if open == invOpen then return end
        invOpen = open
        if F.applyCameraMode then F.applyCameraMode() end
        S.invDim.Visible = open
        S.attackHeld = false
        S.useHeld = false
        if F.stopUseItem then F.stopUseItem() end
        touchJumpHeld = false
        F.stopDestroyBlock()
        if not open then
                for i = 1, 4 do
                        if slots[i] then F.insertStack(slots[i], 9, 44) slots[i] = nil end
                end
                if carried then F.insertStack(carried, 9, 44) carried = nil end
                F.updateCraft()
                S.hover = nil
                S.highlight.Visible = false
        end
        if F.updateInventoryPage then F.updateInventoryPage() end
        S.crosshair.Visible = not open
        refresh()
end
S.touchButtons = {}
local sprintToggle, sneakToggle = false, false
F.makeButton = function(label, order, cb, opts)
        opts = opts or {}
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Text = label
        b.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
        b.TextSize = opts.textSize or 14
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.Size = opts.size or UDim2.fromOffset(74, 34)
        if opts.pos then
                b.Position = opts.pos
        else
                b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0.18, order * 42)
        end
        b.AnchorPoint = opts.anchor or Vector2.new(0, 0)
        b.ZIndex = 12
        b.Parent = S.controlsGui
        if opts.hold then
                F.track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                                cb(b, true)
                        end
                end))
                F.track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                                cb(b, false)
                        end
                end))
        else
                F.track(b.Activated:Connect(function() cb(b) end))
        end
        S.touchButtons[#S.touchButtons + 1] = b
        return b
end
F.paintToggle = function(b, _on) b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18; b.BorderSizePixel = 0 end

        local CW, CH = 195, 136
        local C_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(198, 198, 198)
        local C_FILL = Color3.fromRGB(139, 139, 139)
        local C_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
        local C_SHADOW = Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 85)
        local C_WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local C_BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

        local function rect(parent, x, y, w, h, color, z, transparency)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.BackgroundColor3 = color
                if transparency then f.BackgroundTransparency = transparency end
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * S.GS, y * S.GS)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * S.GS, h * S.GS)
                f.ZIndex = z or 1
                f.Parent = parent
                return f
        end
        local function holder(parent, name, x, y, w, h, z)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.Name = name
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * S.GS, y * S.GS)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * S.GS, h * S.GS)
                f.ZIndex = z or 1
                f.Parent = parent
                return f
        end
        -- Draws run-length-merged pixel rectangles ("x,y,w,h,rrggbb;...").
        local function paint(parent, data, ox, oy, z)
                for x, y, w, h, hex in string.gmatch(data, "(%d+),(%d+),(%d+),(%d+),(%x+);") do
                        rect(parent, ox + tonumber(x), oy + tonumber(y), tonumber(w), tonumber(h),
                                Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16)), z)
                end
        end
        -- One big gray rectangle plus a few long dark/white lines (not one Frame per pixel).
        local function slotGrid(parent, name, x, y, cols, rows, z)
                local g = holder(parent, name, x, y, cols * 18, rows * 18, z)
                rect(g, 0, 0, cols * 18, rows * 18, C_FILL, 1)
                for c = 0, cols - 1 do rect(g, c * 18 + 17, 0, 1, rows * 18, C_WHITE, 2) end
                for r = 0, rows - 1 do rect(g, 0, r * 18 + 17, cols * 18, 1, C_WHITE, 2) end
                for c = 0, cols - 1 do rect(g, c * 18, 0, 1, rows * 18, C_DARK, 3) end
                for r = 0, rows - 1 do rect(g, 0, r * 18, cols * 18, 1, C_DARK, 3) end
                return g
        end
        local function recess(parent, name, x, y, w, h, z)
                local g = holder(parent, name, x, y, w, h, z)
                rect(g, 0, 0, w, h, C_FILL, 1)
                rect(g, w - 1, 0, 1, h, C_WHITE, 2)
                rect(g, 0, h - 1, w, 1, C_WHITE, 2)
                rect(g, 0, 0, 1, h, C_DARK, 3)
                rect(g, 0, 0, w, 1, C_DARK, 3)
                return g
        end
        -- Tab shape (26 wide). Top tabs hang above the panel, bottom tabs below it.
        -- A "selected" tab is drawn light and extends over the panel edge.
        local function buildTab(parent, name, x, y, bottom, selected, z)
                local H = selected and 32 or 28
                local g = holder(parent, name, x, y, 26, H, z)
                local fill = selected and C_PANEL or C_FILL
                if not bottom then
                        local last = selected and 25 or (H - 1)
                        rect(g, 1, 0, 24, 1, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 0, 1, 1, last, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 25, 1, 1, last, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 1, 1, 24, 2, C_WHITE, 2)
                        rect(g, 1, 1, 2, last, C_WHITE, 2)
                        rect(g, 3, 3, 20, last - 2, fill, 3)
                        rect(g, 23, 3, 2, last - 2, selected and fill or C_SHADOW, 3)
                        if selected then rect(g, 1, 26, 24, 6, C_PANEL, 5) end
                else
                        local first = selected and 6 or 0
                        rect(g, 1, H - 1, 24, 1, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 0, first, 1, H - first, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 25, first, 1, H - first, C_BLACK, 1)
                        rect(g, 1, first, 2, H - 1 - first, C_WHITE, 2)
                        rect(g, 3, first, 20, H - 3 - first, fill, 3)
                        rect(g, 23, first, 2, H - 3 - first, selected and fill or C_SHADOW, 3)
                        rect(g, 3, H - 3, 22, 2, selected and fill or C_SHADOW, 3)
                        if selected then rect(g, 1, 0, 24, 6, C_PANEL, 5) end
                end
                return g
        end

        -- Image + text button skin (the supplied gray button texture).
        F.skinImageButton = function(b, tint, onLoaded)
                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                img.Name = "ButtonImage"
                img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                img.Image = BUTTON_IMAGE
                img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
                img.ImageColor3 = tint or C_WHITE
                img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                img.ZIndex = 1
                img.Parent = b
                local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                label.Name = "ButtonText"
                label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                label.Font = b.Font
                label.Text = b.Text
                label.TextColor3 = b.TextColor3
                label.TextSize = b.TextSize
                label.TextScaled = b.TextScaled
                label.TextTransparency = b.TextTransparency
                label.ZIndex = 2
                label.Parent = b
                b.Text = ""
                -- The texture already has its own outline, so the button has no background/border/stroke.
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                return img, label
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Window + the four layers
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local win = Instance.new("Frame")
        win.Name = "CreativeInventoryWindow"
        win.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        win.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CW * S.GS, CH * S.GS)
        win.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        win.BorderSizePixel = 0
        win.Active = true
        win.ZIndex = 30
        win.Visible = false
        win.Parent = S.invDim
        local winScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        winScale.Scale = 0.55
        winScale.Parent = win
        F.cWin = win

        local function newLayer(name, z)
                local g = Instance.new("Frame")
                g.Name = name
                g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                g.BorderSizePixel = 0
                g.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                g.ZIndex = z
                g.Parent = win
                return g
        end
        local gBg = newLayer("Creative background ui", 1)
        local gSel = newLayer("Selection Gui", 2)
        local gStatic = newLayer("Static Gui", 3)
        local gItems = newLayer("Placeholder Items", 4)
        local gViews = newLayer("InventorySlotViews", 5)
        local gButtons = newLayer("InventorySlotButtons", 6)

        local TABS = {
                { id = "building", x = 0, bottom = false },
                { id = "colored", x = 27, bottom = false },
                { id = "natural", x = 54, bottom = false },
                { id = "functional", x = 81, bottom = false },
                { id = "redstone", x = 108, bottom = false },
                { id = "hotbars", x = 142, bottom = false },
                { id = "search", x = 169, bottom = false },
                { id = "tools", x = 0, bottom = true },
                { id = "combat", x = 27, bottom = true },
                { id = "food", x = 54, bottom = true },
                { id = "ingredients", x = 81, bottom = true },
                { id = "spawn", x = 108, bottom = true },
                { id = "operator", x = 142, bottom = true },
                { id = "survival", x = 169, bottom = true },
        }
        local SEARCH_TAB, SURVIVAL_TAB = 7, 14
        local function tabY(t, selected)
                if not t.bottom then return -26 end
                return selected and 130 or 134
        end
        local state = { tab = SEARCH_TAB, row = 0 }
        F.CI = { state = state }

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- LAYER 1: Creative background ui
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
                buildTab(gBg, "TabBackground_" .. t.id, t.x, tabY(t, false), t.bottom, false, 1)
        end
        local panelGroup = holder(gBg, "PanelBackground", 0, 0, CW, CH, 2)
        local fallback = holder(panelGroup, "FlatFallback", 0, 0, CW, CH, 1)
        rect(fallback, 0, 0, CW, CH, C_BLACK, 1)
        rect(fallback, 1, 1, CW - 2, CH - 2, C_SHADOW, 2)
        rect(fallback, 1, 1, CW - 4, CH - 4, C_WHITE, 3)
        rect(fallback, 3, 3, CW - 6, CH - 6, C_PANEL, 4)
        local panelImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        panelImage.Name = "PanelImage"
        panelImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        panelImage.Image = PANEL_IMAGE
        panelImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
        panelImage.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_IMAGE_POS.X * S.GS, PANEL_IMAGE_POS.Y * S.GS)
        panelImage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.X * S.GS, PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.Y * S.GS)
        panelImage.ZIndex = 2
        panelImage.Parent = panelGroup
        F.CI.setPanelImage = function(nx, ny, w, h)
                PANEL_IMAGE_POS = Vector2.new(nx, ny)
                PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE = Vector2.new(w or PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.X, h or PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.Y)
                panelImage.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_IMAGE_POS.X * S.GS, PANEL_IMAGE_POS.Y * S.GS)
                panelImage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.X * S.GS, PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE.Y * S.GS)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - t0 < 8 do
                        if panelImage.IsLoaded then fallback.Visible = false return end
                        task.wait(0.25)
                end
        end)

        -- Catalog-only background (hidden on the survival tab).
        local catalogBg = holder(gBg, "CatalogBackground", 0, 0, CW, CH, 3)
        slotGrid(catalogBg, "CatalogSlots", 8, 17, 9, 5, 1)
        recess(catalogBg, "ScrollTrack", 176, 17, 14, 114, 1)
        local searchHeader = holder(catalogBg, "SearchHeader", 0, 0, CW, 20, 2)
        recess(searchHeader, "SearchBoxBackground", 81, 4, 91, 12, 1)
        -- The title shows the name of the selected category (the search tab also has the textbox).
        local titleFrames = {}
        for id, data in pairs(PX.titles) do
                local tf = holder(catalogBg, "CategoryTitle_" .. id, 8, 6, 90, 9, 2)
                paint(tf, data, 0, 0, 1)
                tf.Visible = false
                titleFrames[id] = tf
        end

        -- Survival tab background (armor, offhand, player box, main inventory, X).
        local survivalBg = holder(gBg, "SurvivalBackground", 0, 0, CW, CH, 3)
        rect(survivalBg, 73, 6, 32, 43, C_BLACK, 1)
        local ARMOR = {
                { idx = 5, x = 54, y = 6, ghost = "helmet" },
                { idx = 6, x = 54, y = 33, ghost = "chest" },
                { idx = 7, x = 108, y = 6, ghost = "legs" },
                { idx = 8, x = 108, y = 33, ghost = "boots" },
                { idx = 45, x = 35, y = 20, ghost = "shield" },
        }
        local ghosts = {}
        for _, a in ipairs(ARMOR) do
                slotGrid(survivalBg, "Slot_" .. a.ghost, a.x - 1, a.y - 1, 1, 1, 2)
                local gh = holder(survivalBg, "Ghost_" .. a.ghost, a.x, a.y, 16, 16, 3)
                paint(gh, PX.ghosts[a.ghost], 0, 0, 1)
                ghosts[a.idx] = gh
        end
        slotGrid(survivalBg, "MainInventorySlots", 8, 53, 9, 3, 2)
        local xArt = holder(survivalBg, "DeleteSlotArt", 172, 111, 18, 18, 2)
        paint(xArt, PX.xslot, 0, 0, 1)

        -- Main hotbar slots: identical on every tab.
        slotGrid(gBg, "MainHotbarSlots", 8, 111, 9, 1, 4)

        F.updateGhosts = function()
                for idx, gh in pairs(ghosts) do gh.Visible = slots[idx] == nil end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- LAYER 2: Selection Gui
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local selTabs = {}
        for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
                local sel = buildTab(gSel, "SelectedTab_" .. t.id, t.x, tabY(t, true), t.bottom, true, 1)
                sel.Visible = (i == state.tab)
                selTabs[i] = sel
        end
        local catalogSel = {}
        for r = 0, 4 do
                for c = 0, 8 do
                        local k = r * 9 + c + 1
                        local o = rect(gSel, 9 + c * 18, 18 + r * 18, 16, 16, C_WHITE, 2, 0.45)
                        o.Name = "CatalogSlotSelect_" .. k
                        o.Visible = false
                        catalogSel[k] = o
                end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- LAYER 3: Static Gui
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
                if t.id == "natural" and S.ICON.grass_block then
                        -- Reuse the script's own grass block icon (clean, correctly colored).
                        local ic = F.cloneIcon("grass_block")
                        ic.Name = "Icon_natural"
                        ic.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((t.x + 5) * S.GS, (tabY(t, false) + 7) * S.GS)
                        ic.Parent = gStatic
                else
                        local ic = holder(gStatic, "Icon_" .. t.id, t.x + 5, tabY(t, false) + 7, 16, 16, 1)
                        paint(ic, PX.icons[t.id], 0, 0, 1)
                end
        end
        local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
        searchBox.Name = "SearchTextBox"
        searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
        searchBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(83 * S.GS, 5 * S.GS)
        searchBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88 * S.GS, 10 * S.GS)
        searchBox.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
        searchBox.TextSize = 8 * S.GS
        searchBox.TextColor3 = C_WHITE
        searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        searchBox.Text = ""
        searchBox.PlaceholderText = ""
        searchBox.ZIndex = 2
        searchBox.Parent = gStatic
        local knob = holder(gStatic, "ScrollButton", 177, 18, 12, 15, 3)
        rect(knob, 0, 0, 12, 15, C_PANEL, 1)
        rect(knob, 0, 0, 12, 1, C_WHITE, 2)
        rect(knob, 0, 0, 1, 15, C_WHITE, 2)
        rect(knob, 11, 1, 1, 14, C_SHADOW, 2)
        rect(knob, 1, 14, 11, 1, C_SHADOW, 2)
        for _, ry in ipairs({ 5, 7, 9 }) do rect(knob, 2, ry, 8, 1, C_FILL, 3) end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- LAYER 4: placeholder items per category
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local CATALOG = {
                building = { "oak_log", "oak_planks", "stone", "cobblestone" },
                colored = {},
                natural = { "grass_block", "dirt", "stone", "cobblestone", "oak_log" },
                functional = { "torch", "crafting_table", "ladder" },
                redstone = {},
                hotbars = {},
                tools = { "diamond_pickaxe", "diamond_axe", "diamond_shovel", "bucket" },
                combat = { "diamond_sword", "iron_helmet", "iron_chestplate", "iron_leggings", "iron_boots" },
                food = { "apple", "bread", "cooked_beef" },
                ingredients = { "coal", "iron_ingot", "diamond", "stick" },
                spawn = {},
                operator = {},
        }
        -- Populate every available registry entry; categories are data-driven so imported TXT mods appear here too.
        for itemId, itemInfo in pairs(ITEMS) do
                local cat = itemInfo.category or (itemInfo.placeable and "building" or "ingredients")
                if CATALOG[cat] and cat ~= "hotbars" and cat ~= "search" then
                        local exists = false
                        for _, existingId in ipairs(CATALOG[cat]) do if existingId == itemId then exists = true break end end
                        if not exists then CATALOG[cat][#CATALOG[cat] + 1] = itemId end
                end
        end
        local searchList, seen = {}, {}
        for _, id in ipairs({ "building", "colored", "natural", "functional", "redstone", "tools", "combat", "food", "ingredients", "spawn", "operator" }) do
                for _, item in ipairs(CATALOG[id]) do
                        if not seen[item] then seen[item] = true; table.insert(searchList, item) end
                end
        end
        CATALOG.search = searchList
        -- Placeholder row counts so every category can scroll until more items are added.
        local PLACEHOLDER_ROWS = {
                building = 12, colored = 8, natural = 10, functional = 10, redstone = 7, hotbars = 5,
                search = 12, tools = 8, combat = 8, food = 7, ingredients = 8, spawn = 9, operator = 6,
        }
        local function itemName(id)
                if ITEMS[id] then return ITEMS[id].name end
                return (id:gsub("_", " "):gsub("(%a)([%w]*)", function(a, b) return a:upper() .. b end))
        end
        local viewport = holder(gItems, "CatalogViewport", 9, 18, 162, 90, 1)
        viewport.ClipsDescendants = true
        local rowFrames, rowCount, shown = {}, {}, {}
        local searchQuery = ""
        local function fillRows(id)
                local rf = rowFrames[id]
                for _, ch in ipairs(rf:GetChildren()) do ch:Destroy() end
                local list = shown[id]
                local minRows = (id == "search" and searchQuery ~= "") and 5 or (PLACEHOLDER_ROWS[id] or 5)
                local rows = math.max(minRows, math.ceil(#list / 9))
                rowCount[id] = rows
                rf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(162 * S.GS, rows * 18 * S.GS)
                for n, itemId in ipairs(list) do
                        local col, row = (n - 1) % 9, math.floor((n - 1) / 9)
                        if S.ICON[itemId] or F.toolInfo[itemId] then
                                local icon = F.cloneIcon(itemId)
                                icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(col * 18 * S.GS, row * 18 * S.GS)
                                icon.Parent = rf
                        end
                end
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do
                if CATALOG[t.id] then
                        shown[t.id] = CATALOG[t.id]
                        local rf = holder(viewport, "Placeholder_" .. t.id, 0, 0, 162, 18, 1)
                        rf.Visible = false
                        rowFrames[t.id] = rf
                        fillRows(t.id)
                end
        end

        local function maxRowFor(tabIndex)
                local id = TABS[tabIndex].id
                return math.max(0, (rowCount[id] or 5) - 5)
        end
        F.setCatalogScroll = function(row)
                local maxRow = maxRowFor(state.tab)
                row = math.clamp(math.floor(row + 0.5), 0, maxRow)
                state.row = row
                local rf = rowFrames[TABS[state.tab].id]
                if rf then rf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -row * 18 * S.GS) end
                local ky = 18 + (maxRow > 0 and math.floor(row / maxRow * 97 + 0.5) or 0)
                knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(177 * S.GS, ky * S.GS)
        end

        -- Search: shows every item whose name contains the typed text (e.g. "o" -> Oak Log, Cobblestone ...).
        local function refreshSearch()
                local q = string.lower(searchBox.Text)
                q = q:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                searchQuery = q
                local list = {}
                for _, id in ipairs(CATALOG.search) do
                        local idText = id:gsub("_", " ")
                        if q == "" or string.find(string.lower(itemName(id)), q, 1, true) or string.find(idText, q, 1, true) then
                                table.insert(list, id)
                        end
                end
                shown.search = list
                fillRows("search")
                if TABS[state.tab].id == "search" then
                        state.row = 0
                        F.setCatalogScroll(0)
                end
        end
        F.refreshCatalogFromItems = function()
                for itemId, itemInfo in pairs(ITEMS) do
                        local cat = itemInfo.category or (itemInfo.placeable and "building" or "ingredients")
                        if CATALOG[cat] and cat ~= "hotbars" and cat ~= "search" then
                                local exists = false
                                for _, existingId in ipairs(CATALOG[cat]) do if existingId == itemId then exists = true break end end
                                if not exists then CATALOG[cat][#CATALOG[cat] + 1] = itemId end
                        end
                end
                local rebuilt, known = {}, {}
                for _, categoryId in ipairs({"building","colored","natural","functional","redstone","tools","combat","food","ingredients","spawn","operator"}) do
                        for _, itemId in ipairs(CATALOG[categoryId] or {}) do if not known[itemId] then known[itemId] = true; rebuilt[#rebuilt + 1] = itemId end end
                end
                CATALOG.search = rebuilt
                for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do
                        if CATALOG[tab.id] then shown[tab.id] = CATALOG[tab.id]; fillRows(tab.id) end
                end
                refreshSearch()
        end
        F.track(searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refreshSearch))
        F.refreshCatalogFromItems()

        -- Grabbing items from the catalog (Java creative rules):
        --   left click: pick up 1 (click again to add more up to a full stack)
        --   right click: pick up 1 (click again puts it back)
        --   shift+click: put a full stack into the hotbar (falls back to the inventory)
        --   middle click: pick up a full stack; number key: put a full stack in that hotbar slot
        --   clicking with a different item held, or on an empty slot, deletes the held item
        local function catalogItemAt(k)
                local r, c = math.floor((k - 1) / 9), (k - 1) % 9
                local list = shown[TABS[state.tab].id]
                return list and list[(state.row + r) * 9 + c + 1] or nil
        end
        local function shiftDown()
                return UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
        end
        local function grabFromCatalog(itemId, kind)
                if itemId == nil or not ITEMS[itemId] then
                        -- Empty slot or a display-only placeholder: the held item just disappears.
                        if carried ~= nil then carried = nil refresh() end
                        return
                end
                local maxN = F.maxOf(itemId)
                if kind == "shift" then
                        local st = { id = itemId, n = maxN }
                        F.insertStack(st, 36, 44)
                        if st.n > 0 then F.insertStack(st, 9, 35) end
                elseif kind == "full" then
                        carried = { id = itemId, n = maxN }
                elseif carried ~= nil then
                        if kind == "left" and carried.id == itemId then
                                carried.n = math.min(maxN, carried.n + 1)
                        else
                                carried = nil
                        end
                else
                        carried = { id = itemId, n = 1 }
                end
                F.updateCraft()
                refresh()
        end
        local hoverCatalog = nil
        local NUMBER_KEYS = {
                [Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1, [Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2, [Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3,
                [Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4, [Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5, [Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6,
                [Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7, [Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8, [Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = 9,
        }
        F.track(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                local n = NUMBER_KEYS[input.KeyCode]
                if n and hoverCatalog and invOpen and creative and state.tab ~= SURVIVAL_TAB and UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
                        local itemId = catalogItemAt(hoverCatalog)
                        if itemId and ITEMS[itemId] then
                                slots[35 + n] = { id = itemId, n = F.maxOf(itemId) }
                                F.updateCraft()
                                refresh()
                        end
                end
        end))

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Slot views / buttons (main inventory is identical on every tab)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local cHighlight = Instance.new("Frame")
        cHighlight.Name = "SlotHighlight"
        cHighlight.BackgroundColor3 = C_WHITE
        cHighlight.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        cHighlight.BorderSizePixel = 0
        cHighlight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * S.GS, 16 * S.GS)
        cHighlight.ZIndex = 38
        cHighlight.Visible = false
        cHighlight.Parent = gViews
        F.cHighlight = cHighlight
        for c = 0, 8 do
                F.bindSlot(36 + c, { 9 + c * 18, 112 }, gViews, gButtons, F.cViews, F.cButtons, cHighlight)
        end
        for _, a in ipairs(ARMOR) do
                F.bindSlot(a.idx, { a.x, a.y }, gViews, gButtons, F.cViews, F.cButtons, cHighlight)
        end
        for r = 0, 2 do
                for c = 0, 8 do
                        F.bindSlot(9 + c + r * 9, { 9 + c * 18, 54 + r * 18 }, gViews, gButtons, F.cViews, F.cButtons, cHighlight)
                end
        end

        -- Catalog slot buttons: hover highlight (not a toggle) + grabbing items.
        for r = 0, 4 do
                for c = 0, 8 do
                        local k = r * 9 + c + 1
                        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        b.Name = "CatalogSlot_" .. k
                        b.Text = ""
                        b.AutoButtonColor = false
                        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((8 + c * 18) * S.GS, (17 + r * 18) * S.GS)
                        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18 * S.GS, 18 * S.GS)
                        b.ZIndex = 1
                        b.Parent = gButtons
                        local touchStart = 0
                        F.track(b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() catalogSel[k].Visible = true hoverCatalog = k end))
                        F.track(b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                                catalogSel[k].Visible = false
                                if hoverCatalog == k then hoverCatalog = nil end
                        end))
                        F.track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                                local t = input.UserInputType
                                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                                        grabFromCatalog(catalogItemAt(k), shiftDown() and "shift" or "left")
                                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                                        grabFromCatalog(catalogItemAt(k), "right")
                                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                                        grabFromCatalog(catalogItemAt(k), "full")
                                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                        touchStart = os.clock()
                                        catalogSel[k].Visible = true
                                end
                        end))
                        F.track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                        catalogSel[k].Visible = false
                                        if touchStart > 0 then
                                                -- tap = pick up 1, long press = full stack into the hotbar (touch version of shift-click)
                                                local long = os.clock() - touchStart > 0.35
                                                touchStart = 0
                                                grabFromCatalog(catalogItemAt(k), long and "shift" or "left")
                                        end
                                end
                        end))
                        table.insert(F.cCatalogButtons, b)
                end
        end

        -- Scroll button: drag / click the track, snaps to one slot row at a time.
        local scrollHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
        scrollHit.Name = "ScrollTrackHit"
        scrollHit.Text = ""
        scrollHit.AutoButtonColor = false
        scrollHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scrollHit.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scrollHit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(177 * S.GS, 18 * S.GS)
        scrollHit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12 * S.GS, 112 * S.GS)
        scrollHit.ZIndex = 1
        scrollHit.Parent = gButtons
        local dragging = false
        local function dragTo(py)
                local maxRow = maxRowFor(state.tab)
                if maxRow <= 0 then return end
                local unit = win.AbsoluteSize.X / CW
                local top = win.AbsolutePosition.Y + (18 + 7.5) * unit
                local frac = math.clamp((py - top) / (97 * unit), 0, 1)
                F.setCatalogScroll(frac * maxRow)
        end
        F.track(scrollHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true
                        dragTo(input.Position.Y)
                end
        end))
        F.track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if dragging and (t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        dragTo(input.Position.Y)
                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and invOpen and creative and state.tab ~= SURVIVAL_TAB then
                        local dir = math.sign(input.Position.Z)
                        if dir ~= 0 then F.setCatalogScroll(state.row - dir) end
                end
        end))
        F.track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
        end))

        -- X ("Destroy Item") slot, like Java creative:
        --   click with a stack held: deletes it; right-click: deletes one item of it
        --   shift+click: clears the whole inventory (touch: long press)
        local xButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        xButton.Name = "DeleteAllItemsButton"
        xButton.Text = ""
        xButton.AutoButtonColor = false
        xButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        xButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
        xButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(172 * S.GS, 111 * S.GS)
        xButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18 * S.GS, 18 * S.GS)
        xButton.ZIndex = 2
        xButton.Parent = gButtons
        F.cDeleteButton = xButton
        local function clearInventory()
                for i = 1, 45 do slots[i] = nil end
                carried = nil
                F.updateCraft()
                refresh()
        end
        local xTouchStart = 0
        F.track(xButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        if shiftDown() then
                                clearInventory()
                        elseif carried ~= nil then
                                carried = nil
                                refresh()
                        end
                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        if carried ~= nil then
                                carried.n -= 1
                                if carried.n <= 0 then carried = nil end
                                refresh()
                        end
                elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        xTouchStart = os.clock()
                end
        end))
        F.track(xButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and xTouchStart > 0 then
                        local long = os.clock() - xTouchStart > 0.6
                        xTouchStart = 0
                        if long then
                                clearInventory()
                        elseif carried ~= nil then
                                carried = nil
                                refresh()
                        end
                end
        end))

        -- Category tabs.
        local tabButtons = {}
        for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Tab_" .. t.id
                b.Text = ""
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(t.x * S.GS, (t.bottom and 136 or -26) * S.GS)
                b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26 * S.GS, 26 * S.GS)
                b.ZIndex = 1
                b.Parent = gButtons
                tabButtons[i] = b
                F.track(b.Activated:Connect(function()
                        if invOpen and creative then F.selectCreativeTab(i) end
                end))
        end

        F.selectCreativeTab = function(i)
                if not TABS[i] then return end
                state.tab = i
                state.row = 0
                S.inventoryPage = (i == SURVIVAL_TAB) and "survival" or "creative"
                S.hover = nil
                cHighlight.Visible = false
                for _, o in ipairs(catalogSel) do o.Visible = false end
                F.updateInventoryPage()
                refresh()
        end

        F.CI.applyState = function()
                local isSurvival = state.tab == SURVIVAL_TAB
                local showSearch = (not isSurvival) and state.tab == SEARCH_TAB
                catalogBg.Visible = not isSurvival
                searchHeader.Visible = showSearch
                searchBox.Visible = showSearch
                if not showSearch and searchBox:IsFocused() then searchBox:ReleaseFocus() end
                survivalBg.Visible = isSurvival
                knob.Visible = not isSurvival
                scrollHit.Visible = not isSurvival
                viewport.Visible = not isSurvival
                for i, sel in ipairs(selTabs) do sel.Visible = (i == state.tab) end
                for id, rf in pairs(rowFrames) do rf.Visible = (not isSurvival) and id == TABS[state.tab].id end
                for id, tf in pairs(titleFrames) do tf.Visible = (not isSurvival) and id == TABS[state.tab].id end
                for _, b in ipairs(F.cCatalogButtons) do b.Visible = not isSurvival end
                -- Armor / offhand / main-inventory item views only belong to the survival tab.
                for idx, v in pairs(F.cViews) do v.holder.Visible = (idx >= 36 and idx <= 44) or isSurvival end
                for idx, b in pairs(F.cButtons) do b.Visible = (idx >= 36 and idx <= 44) or isSurvival end
                xButton.Visible = isSurvival
                if isSurvival then
                        dragging = false
                        for _, o in ipairs(catalogSel) do o.Visible = false end
                end
                F.setCatalogScroll(state.row)
                F.updateGhosts()
        end

        F.updateInventoryPage = function()
                local showLegacy = invOpen and not creative
                local showCreative = invOpen and creative
                if creative then
                        if S.inventoryPage == "creative" and state.tab == SURVIVAL_TAB then state.tab = SEARCH_TAB end
                        if S.inventoryPage == "survival" then state.tab = SURVIVAL_TAB end
                end
                S.panel.Visible = showLegacy
                if F.deleteButton then F.deleteButton.Visible = showLegacy end
                S.creativePlaceholderOpen = showCreative
                win.Visible = showCreative
                if showCreative then F.CI.applyState() end
                if F.updateHudVisibility then F.updateHudVisibility() end
        end
        F.setInventoryPage = function(page)
                if page ~= "creative" and page ~= "survival" then return end
                if page == "creative" and not creative then return end
                S.inventoryPage = page
                if creative then
                        if page == "survival" then state.tab = SURVIVAL_TAB
                        elseif state.tab == SURVIVAL_TAB then state.tab = SEARCH_TAB end
                end
                S.hover = nil
                S.highlight.Visible = false
                cHighlight.Visible = false
                F.updateInventoryPage()
                refresh()
        end
        F.CI.applyState()
end

S.debugEnabled = false
F.updateHudVisibility = function()
        hud.Visible = hudVisible
        if debugPanel then debugPanel.Visible = hudVisible and S.debugEnabled end
        if S.topToolbar then
                -- Touch controls sit underneath inventory/chat overlays and never cover the inventory window.
                S.topToolbar.Visible = UIS.TouchEnabled
                for _, entry in ipairs(S.pojavButtons) do
                        entry.button.Visible = (entry.always or hudVisible)
                end
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(S.touchButtons) do b.Visible = hudVisible end
        if S.mobileDpad then S.mobileDpad.Visible = hudVisible and UIS.TouchEnabled end
        if S.dropInventoryButton then S.dropInventoryButton.Visible = hudVisible end
        if chatPanel then
                chatPanel.Visible = hudVisible
                if chatInput then chatInput.Visible = hudVisible and chatOpen end
        end
end

        S.debugEnabled = not S.debugEnabled

end
