S.chatEntries = {}
function S.escapeRichText(value)
        return tostring(value):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"):gsub('"', "&quot;"):gsub("'", "&apos;")
end
function S.renderChatEntries()
        for _, child in ipairs(chatRowsFrame:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("TextLabel") then child:Destroy() end
        end
        for index, entry in ipairs(S.chatEntries) do
                local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                row.Name = "ChatLine" .. tostring(index)
                row.LayoutOrder = index
                row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
                row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
                row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                row.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
                row.TextSize = 10
                row.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                row.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.60
                row:SetAttribute("MCChatCreatedAt", entry.time or os.clock())
                row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                row.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
                row.TextWrapped = true
                row.RichText = true
                row.Text = entry.color and ('<font color="' .. entry.color .. '">' .. S.escapeRichText(entry.text) .. '</font>') or S.escapeRichText(entry.text)
                row.ZIndex = 91
                row.Parent = chatRowsFrame
        end
end
F.appendChatLine = function(line, color)
        line = tostring(line or "")
        if not color and (line:match(" joined the game$") or line:match(" left the game$")) then
                color = "#FFFF55" -- Java formatting code §e (yellow).
        end
        table.insert(S.chatEntries, { text = line, color = color, time = os.clock() })
        while #S.chatEntries > 8 do table.remove(S.chatEntries, 1) end
        S.renderChatEntries()
end
S.chatFadeAccumulator = 0
F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        S.chatFadeAccumulator += dt
        if S.chatFadeAccumulator < 0.1 then return end
        S.chatFadeAccumulator = 0
        if not chatRowsFrame or not chatRowsFrame.Parent then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        for _, row in ipairs(chatRowsFrame:GetChildren()) do
                if row:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local createdAt = row:GetAttribute("MCChatCreatedAt") or now
                        local age = math.max(0, now - createdAt)
                        if chatOpen then
                                row.Visible = true
                                row.TextTransparency = 0
                                row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
            else
                local fresh = age < 10
                row.Visible = fresh
                if fresh then
                    row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                    local fade = age <= 8 and 1 or math.clamp((10 - age) / 2, 0, 1)
                    row.TextTransparency = 1 - fade
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.44 * fade
                else
                    row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                    row.TextTransparency = 1
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                end
            end
                end
        end
end))
-- Announce the players already in this server, then watch future join/leave events.
for _, existingPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if existingPlayer ~= lp then
                F.appendChatLine(tostring(existingPlayer.DisplayName or existingPlayer.Name) .. " joined the game")
        end
end
F.track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(joiningPlayer)
        if joiningPlayer ~= lp then
                F.appendChatLine(tostring(joiningPlayer.DisplayName or joiningPlayer.Name) .. " joined the game")
        end
end))
F.track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlayer)
        if leavingPlayer ~= lp then
                F.appendChatLine(tostring(leavingPlayer.DisplayName or leavingPlayer.Name) .. " left the game")
        end
end))
F.setChatOpen = function(open, focus)
        chatOpen = open == true
        S.renderChatEntries()
        chatPanel.Visible = hudVisible
        chatInput.Visible = hudVisible and chatOpen
        if F.applyCameraMode then F.applyCameraMode() end
        if open and focus then chatInput:CaptureFocus() else chatInput:ReleaseFocus() end
        if open then
                S.attackHeld, S.useHeld, touchJumpHeld = false, false, false
                if F.stopUseItem then F.stopUseItem() end
                F.stopDestroyBlock()
        end
end
F.executeLocalCommand = function(raw)
        local message = tostring(raw or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if message == "" then return end
        chatInput.Text = ""
        if message:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then F.appendChatLine("<" .. tostring(lp.DisplayName or lp.Name) .. "> " .. message) return end
        local args = {}
        for word in message:gmatch("%S+") do args[#args + 1] = word end
        local cmd = (args[1] or ""):lower()
        if cmd == "/help" then
                F.appendChatLine("/help /fly /gamemode creative|survival|adventure /give id [count] /spawn mob /mobs /killmobs /mods /tp x y z /time set day|night /weather clear|rain /panelnudge x y [w h]")
        elseif cmd == "/panelnudge" then
                local nx, ny = tonumber(args[2]), tonumber(args[3])
                if nx and ny and F.CI and F.CI.setPanelImage then
                        F.CI.setPanelImage(nx, ny, tonumber(args[4]), tonumber(args[5]))
                        F.appendChatLine("Panel image position set to " .. nx .. ", " .. ny .. " (GUI units; pixels = units x GS).")
                else
                        F.appendChatLine("Usage: /panelnudge x y [width height]  (GUI units; pixels = units x GS)")
                end
        elseif cmd == "/fly" then
                if abilities.mayfly then abilities.flying = not abilities.flying F.appendChatLine("Flight: " .. (abilities.flying and "enabled" or "disabled")) else F.appendChatLine("Flight is Creative-only.") end
        elseif cmd == "/gamemode" then
                local mode = (args[2] or ""):lower()
                if mode == "creative" or mode == "survival" or mode == "adventure" then F.setGameMode(mode) else F.appendChatLine("Usage: /gamemode creative|survival|adventure") end
                if creativeBtn then F.paintToggle(creativeBtn, creative); creativeBtn.Text = S.gameModeName:upper() end
                if flyBtn then flyBtn.Visible = creative; F.paintToggle(flyBtn, abilities.flying) end
                F.appendChatLine("Gamemode: " .. S.gameModeName:sub(1,1):upper() .. S.gameModeName:sub(2))
        elseif cmd == "/give" then
                local id = tostring(args[2] or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w_]", "")
                local count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(args[3]) or 1), 1, 64)
                if ITEMS[id] then F.give(id, count); refresh(); F.appendChatLine("Gave " .. count .. " " .. ITEMS[id].name .. ".") else F.appendChatLine("Unknown item id: " .. id) end
        elseif cmd == "/spawn" then
                local mobId = tostring(args[2] or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w_]", "")
                if not F.spawnLocalMob or not mobId:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") then
                        F.appendChatLine("Usage: /spawn zombie (or /spawn pig, skeleton, creeper, etc.)")
                else
                        local ok, result = pcall(F.spawnLocalMob, mobId)
                        if not ok then
                                warn("[Minecraft Replica] Mob spawn failed for " .. mobId .. ": " .. tostring(result))
                                F.appendChatLine("Mob spawn failed: " .. tostring(result):sub(1, 140))
                        elseif result then
                                -- spawnLocalMob already reports successful spawns; do not print a false success.
                        else
                                F.appendChatLine("Mob was not spawned. Check the mob limit or error above.")
                        end
                end
        elseif cmd == "/mobs" then
                local count = 0
                for i = #(F.localMobs or {}), 1, -1 do
                        local mob = F.localMobs[i]
                        if mob and mob.model and mob.model.Parent then count = count + 1 end
                end
                F.appendChatLine("Local mobs: " .. count .. "/" .. (UIS.TouchEnabled and 12 or 24) .. ". Use /killmobs to clear them.")
        elseif cmd == "/killmobs" then
                local list = F.localMobs or {}
                local removed = 0
                for i = #list, 1, -1 do
                        local mob = list[i]
                        if mob and mob.model then pcall(function() mob.model:Destroy() end); removed = removed + 1 end
                        table.remove(list, i)
                end
                if F.localMobsFolder then
                        for _, child in ipairs(F.localMobsFolder:GetChildren()) do pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) end
                end
                F.appendChatLine("Removed " .. removed .. " local mobs. You can spawn again.")
        elseif cmd == "/mods" then
                F.appendChatLine("Loaded local mods: " .. tostring(#F.MODS_LOADED) .. ". Use the MODS button to inspect them.")
        elseif cmd == "/weather" then
                local w = (args[2] or ""):lower()
                if w == "clear" then Lighting.Brightness = 2; Lighting.FogEnd = 100000; F.appendChatLine("Local weather set to clear.")
                elseif w == "rain" then Lighting.Brightness = 1.5; Lighting.FogEnd = 500; F.appendChatLine("Local fog/weather mood set to rain (visual approximation).")
                else F.appendChatLine("Usage: /weather clear|rain") end
        elseif cmd == "/tp" or cmd == "/teleport" then
                local x, y, z = tonumber(args[2]), tonumber(args[3]), tonumber(args[4])
                if x and y and z then
                        pos = Vector3.new(x * BLOCK, y * BLOCK, z * BLOCK)
                        prevPos = pos
                        vel = Vector3.zero
                        F.appendChatLine(string.format("Teleported to %.1f %.1f %.1f", x, y, z))
                else F.appendChatLine("Usage: /tp x y z") end
        elseif cmd == "/time" and (args[2] or ""):lower() == "set" then
                local value = (args[3] or ""):lower()
                if value == "day" then Lighting.ClockTime = 12; F.appendChatLine("Set local time to day.")
                elseif value == "night" then Lighting.ClockTime = 0; F.appendChatLine("Set local time to night.")
                else F.appendChatLine("Usage: /time set day|night") end
        else
                F.appendChatLine("Unknown command. Use /help.")
        end
end
F.track(chatInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
        if enterPressed then F.executeLocalCommand(chatInput.Text); F.setChatOpen(false, false) end
end))

-- Place directional buttons at bottom-left; these provide movement while touch
-- camera look remains on the right side of the screen.
if UIS.TouchEnabled then
        S.mobileDpad = Instance.new("Frame")
        S.mobileDpad.Name = "PojavDirectionalPad"
        S.mobileDpad.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        S.mobileDpad.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(114, 114)
        S.mobileDpad.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -184)
        S.mobileDpad.ZIndex = 10
        S.mobileDpad.Parent = S.controlsGui
        local function makeDpadButton(name, symbol, x, y, direction)
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Move_" .. name
                b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 249, 252)
                b.TextSize = 19
        b.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        b.Text = symbol
                b.ZIndex = 11
                b.Parent = S.mobileDpad
                local function begin()
                        if direction == "Forward" then
                                local now = os.clock()
                                if now - S.lastMobileForwardTap <= 0.34 then S.sprintLatch = true end
                                S.lastMobileForwardTap = now
                        end
                        S.mobileHeldDirections[direction] = true
                        S.recalcTouchMove()
                end
                local function finish()
                        S.mobileHeldDirections[direction] = false
                        S.recalcTouchMove()
                end
                F.track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then begin() end
                end))
                F.track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then finish() end
                end))
                return b
        end
        makeDpadButton("Forward", "▲", 39, 0, "Forward")
        makeDpadButton("Left", "◀", 0, 39, "Left")
        makeDpadButton("Back", "▼", 39, 78, "Back")
        makeDpadButton("Right", "▶", 78, 39, "Right")

        local function makeDpadAction(name, label, x, y, color, callback, hold)
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Action_" .. name
                b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                b.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                b.Text = label
                b.TextWrapped = true
                b.TextScaled = true
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.ZIndex = 11
                b.Parent = S.mobileDpad
                if hold then
                        F.track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                                        callback(true)
                                end
                        end))
                        F.track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                                        callback(false)
                                end
                        end))
                else
                        F.track(b.Activated:Connect(function() callback() end))
                end
                return b
        end

        -- The 3x3 D-pad grid: actions occupy corners and the center without
        -- overlapping the four directional buttons.
        local mobileSneakButton
        mobileSneakButton = makeDpadAction("Sneak", "◇", 39, 39, Color3.fromRGB(98, 115, 135), function()
                sneakToggle = not sneakToggle
                if mobileSneakButton then
                        mobileSneakButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                end
        end, false)
        makeDpadAction("PrimaryBreak", "PRI\n(BREAK)", 0, 0, Color3.fromRGB(160, 70, 70), function(down)
                if invOpen then return end
                if down then S.attackHeld = true; F.startAttack()
                else S.attackHeld = false; F.stopDestroyBlock() end
        end, true)
        makeDpadAction("SecondaryPlace", "SEC\n(PLACE)", 78, 0, Color3.fromRGB(70, 120, 70), function(down)
                if invOpen then return end
                if down then S.useHeld = true; F.startUseItem()
                else F.stopUseItem() end
        end, true)
        makeDpadAction("Inventory", "INV", 0, 78, Color3.fromRGB(95, 95, 115), function()
                F.setInventory(not invOpen)
        end, false)
end
