F.hideDeathScreen = function()
        F.playerDead = false
        F.pendingPlayerDeathMessage = nil
        F.deathStartedAt = nil
        F.deathModelPivot = nil
        F.deathModelHeight = nil
        S.deathGui.Enabled = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_DeathCamera") end)
        if F.deathCameraOriginalFOV and workspace.CurrentCamera then
                workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = F.deathCameraOriginalFOV
        end
        F.deathCameraOriginalFOV = nil
        F.deathCameraBaseCFrame = nil
end
F.beginPlayerDeath = function(message)
        if F.playerDead then return end
        F.playerDead = true
        F.deathStartedAt = os.clock()
        F.pendingPlayerDeathMessage = nil
        message = tostring(message or (tostring(lp.Name) .. " was killed"))
        S.deathCauseLabel.Text = message
        S.deathTitle.Text = "You died!"
        S.deathScoreLabel.Text = "Score: 0"
        S.deathGui.Enabled = true
        S.attackHeld, S.useHeld, touchJumpHeld = false, false, false
        if F.stopDestroyBlock then F.stopDestroyBlock() end
        if F.stopUseItem then F.stopUseItem() end
        pcall(function() F.deathModelPivot = S.model:GetPivot(); F.deathModelHeight = S.model:GetExtentsSize().Y end)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
                F.deathCameraOriginalFOV = cam.FieldOfView
                F.deathCameraBaseCFrame = cam.CFrame
        end
        F.appendChatLine(message)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_DeathCamera") end)
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_DeathCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 4, function()
                if not F.playerDead then return end
                local activeCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not activeCamera then return end
                local progress = math.clamp((os.clock() - (F.deathStartedAt or os.clock())) / 0.55, 0, 1)
                if F.deathCameraOriginalFOV then activeCamera.FieldOfView = F.deathCameraOriginalFOV + 8 * progress end
                if F.deathCameraBaseCFrame then
                        activeCamera.CFrame = F.deathCameraBaseCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90 * progress))
                end
        end)
end
F.getEntityTarget = function(part)
        if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil, nil end
        local node = part.Parent
        while node and node ~= workspace do
                if node:IsA("Model") then
                        local targetHumanoid = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if targetHumanoid and node ~= char and node ~= S.model
                                and not (dropFolder and node:IsDescendantOf(dropFolder)) then
                                return node, targetHumanoid
                        end
                end
                node = node.Parent
        end
        return nil, nil
end
F.getEntityName = function(entity, targetHumanoid)
        local targetPlayer = entity and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(entity)
        if targetPlayer then return tostring(targetPlayer.Name) end
        if targetHumanoid then
                local ok, displayName = pcall(function() return targetHumanoid.DisplayName end)
                if ok and type(displayName) == "string" and displayName ~= "" and displayName ~= "Humanoid" then
                        return displayName
                end
        end
        return entity and entity.Name or "Entity"
end
F.writeEntityHealth = function(entity, targetHumanoid, state)
        local hp = math.floor(math.max(0, state.health) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
        local maxHp = math.floor(math.max(0, state.maxHealth) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
        pcall(function() entity:SetAttribute("MinecraftHealth", hp) end)
        pcall(function() entity:SetAttribute("MinecraftMaxHealth", maxHp) end)
        pcall(function() targetHumanoid:SetAttribute("MinecraftHealth", hp) end)
        pcall(function() targetHumanoid:SetAttribute("MinecraftMaxHealth", maxHp) end)
end
F.getEntityState = function(entity, targetHumanoid)
        local state = F.entityStates[entity]
        if not state then
                state = {
                        health = math.max(0, targetHumanoid.Health / S.ENTITY_HEALTH_SCALE),
                        maxHealth = math.max(0.2, targetHumanoid.MaxHealth / S.ENTITY_HEALTH_SCALE),
                        nativeHealth = targetHumanoid.Health,
                        nativeMaxHealth = targetHumanoid.MaxHealth,
                        dead = false,
                        deathStarted = false,
                        lastHitBy = nil,
                        lastHitAt = -math.huge,
                }
                F.entityStates[entity] = state
        else
                if not state.dead then
                        local currentNativeHealth = targetHumanoid.Health
                        if currentNativeHealth ~= state.nativeHealth then
                                state.health = math.clamp(state.health + (currentNativeHealth - state.nativeHealth) / S.ENTITY_HEALTH_SCALE, 0, state.maxHealth)
                                state.nativeHealth = currentNativeHealth
                        end
                        local currentNativeMax = targetHumanoid.MaxHealth
                        if currentNativeMax ~= state.nativeMaxHealth then
                                state.maxHealth = math.max(0.2, currentNativeMax / S.ENTITY_HEALTH_SCALE)
                                state.health = math.min(state.health, state.maxHealth)
                                state.nativeMaxHealth = currentNativeMax
                        end
                end
        end
        F.writeEntityHealth(entity, targetHumanoid, state)
        return state
end
F.makeEntityHighlight = function(entity)
        local highlightEffect = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlightEffect.Name = "MinecraftEntityHitHighlight"
        highlightEffect.Adornee = entity
        highlightEffect.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        highlightEffect.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        highlightEffect.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        highlightEffect.FillTransparency = 0.7
        highlightEffect.OutlineTransparency = 0.7
        highlightEffect.Parent = entity
        return highlightEffect
end
F.beginEntityDeath = function(entity, targetHumanoid, state, hitHighlight)
        if not entity or not entity.Parent or state.deathStarted then return end
        state.dead = true
        state.deathStarted = true
        pcall(function() targetHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
        state.health = 0
        F.writeEntityHealth(entity, targetHumanoid, state)
        pcall(function() targetHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
        local deathHighlight = hitHighlight
        if not (deathHighlight and deathHighlight.Parent) then deathHighlight = F.makeEntityHighlight(entity) end
        deathHighlight:SetAttribute("MCPersistentDeathHighlight", true)
        local entityName = F.getEntityName(entity, targetHumanoid)
        local deathMessage = entityName .. " was killed"
        state.deathMessage = deathMessage
        F.appendChatLine(deathMessage)
        local ok, startingPivot = pcall(function() return entity:GetPivot() end)
        if not ok then
                if deathHighlight and deathHighlight.Parent then deathHighlight:Destroy() end
                return
        end
        task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function() targetHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
                local _, size = pcall(function() return entity:GetExtentsSize() end)
                local entityHeight = (typeof(size) == "Vector3") and size.Y or (BLOCK * 2)
                local startedAt = os.clock()
                local duration = S.ENTITY_DEATH_TICKS * TICK
                while entity.Parent do
                        local progress = math.clamp((os.clock() - startedAt) / duration, 0, 1)
                        -- Java 1.12 computes the corpse roll with sqrt(deathTime * 1.6).
                        -- Render each frame, interpolate continuously, and lower the body as it falls.
            local rotationProgress = math.sqrt(math.clamp(progress * 1.6, 0, 1))
            local downProgress = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
            local downwardOffset = math.min(entityHeight * 0.58, BLOCK * 1.65) * downProgress
                        local targetPivot = startingPivot * CFrame.new(0, -downwardOffset, 0)
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90) * rotationProgress)
                        pcall(function() entity:PivotTo(targetPivot) end)
                        if progress >= 1 then break end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                -- Remove the dead NPC/player model after its death pose, rather than leaving
                -- an invisible humanoid or an empty model behind in this client's world.
                if entity and entity.Parent then pcall(function() entity:Destroy() end) end
                if deathHighlight and deathHighlight.Parent then pcall(function() deathHighlight:Destroy() end) end
        end)
end
F.attackEntity = function(entity, targetHumanoid)
        if F.playerDead or not (entity and entity.Parent and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent) then return false end
        if F.entityAttackCooldown > 0 then return false end
        local state = F.getEntityState(entity, targetHumanoid)
        if state.dead or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 or state.health <= 0 then
                if not state.dead and state.health <= 0 then F.beginEntityDeath(entity, targetHumanoid, state, nil) end
                return false
        end
        local hitHighlight = F.makeEntityHighlight(entity)
        local targetStack = slots[36 + selected]
        local heldId = targetStack and targetStack.id or nil
        local damageByItem = {
                diamond_sword = 7,
                diamond_axe = 6,
                diamond_pickaxe = 5,
                diamond_shovel = 4,
                stick = 1,
        }
        local damage = damageByItem[heldId] or 1
        state.health = math.max(0, state.health - damage)
        state.lastHitBy = tostring(lp.DisplayName or lp.Name)
        state.lastHitAt = os.clock()
        F.entityAttackCooldown = 6
        -- Mirror the translated Minecraft health back to this client's Humanoid copy.
        -- Set nativeHealth first so HealthChanged does not count our own write twice.
        state.nativeHealth = math.clamp(state.health * S.ENTITY_HEALTH_SCALE, 0, targetHumanoid.MaxHealth)
        if state.health <= 0 then
                F.beginEntityDeath(entity, targetHumanoid, state, hitHighlight)
                pcall(function() targetHumanoid.Health = 0 end)
        else
                pcall(function() targetHumanoid.Health = state.nativeHealth end)
                F.writeEntityHealth(entity, targetHumanoid, state)
                task.delay(TICK, function()
                        if hitHighlight and hitHighlight.Parent and not hitHighlight:GetAttribute("MCPersistentDeathHighlight") then
                                hitHighlight:Destroy()
                        end
                end)
        end
        return true
end
F.observeHumanoid = function(targetHumanoid)
        if not targetHumanoid or F.observedHumanoids[targetHumanoid] then return end
        F.observedHumanoids[targetHumanoid] = true
        pcall(function() targetHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
        local initialEntity = targetHumanoid.Parent
        if initialEntity and initialEntity:IsA("Model")
                and initialEntity ~= char and initialEntity ~= S.model
                and not (dropFolder and initialEntity:IsDescendantOf(dropFolder))
                and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(initialEntity) ~= lp then
                F.getEntityState(initialEntity, targetHumanoid)
        end
        F.track(targetHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                local entity = targetHumanoid.Parent
                if not (entity and entity:IsA("Model")) then return end
                local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(entity)
                if targetPlayer == lp or entity == char then
                        F.beginPlayerDeath(F.pendingPlayerDeathMessage or (tostring(lp.Name) .. " was killed"))
                        return
                end
                local state = F.getEntityState(entity, targetHumanoid)
                if not state.deathStarted then F.beginEntityDeath(entity, targetHumanoid, state, nil) end
        end))
        F.track(targetHumanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
                local entity = targetHumanoid.Parent
                if entity and entity:IsA("Model") then
                        local state = F.entityStates[entity]
                        if state and not state.dead then F.getEntityState(entity, targetHumanoid) end
                end
        end))
        F.track(targetHumanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(function()
                local entity = targetHumanoid.Parent
                if entity and entity:IsA("Model") then
                        local state = F.entityStates[entity]
                        if state and not state.dead then F.getEntityState(entity, targetHumanoid) end
                end
        end))
end
-- One initial scan, then only observe Humanoids newly added to Workspace.
for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then F.observeHumanoid(descendant) end
end
F.track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
        if descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then F.observeHumanoid(descendant) end
end))

S.lastW = -math.huge
F.wrap = function(a) return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi end
S.controls = nil
pcall(function()
        S.controls = require(lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 5)):GetControls()
end)
S.recalcTouchMove = function()
        local x, z = 0, 0
        if S.mobileHeldDirections.Left then x -= 1 end
        if S.mobileHeldDirections.Right then x += 1 end
        if S.mobileHeldDirections.Forward then z -= 1 end
        if S.mobileHeldDirections.Back then z += 1 end
        S.mobileMoveVector = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
        if S.mobileMoveVector.Magnitude > 1 then S.mobileMoveVector = S.mobileMoveVector.Unit end
end
F.getMove = function()
        local move = Vector3.zero
        if S.controls then
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return S.controls:GetMoveVector() end)
                if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" then move = v end
        end
        if move.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                local x = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) and 1 or 0)
                local z = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) and 1 or 0)
                move = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
        end
        move += S.mobileMoveVector
        move = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
        if move.Magnitude > 1 then move = move.Unit end
        return move
end
F.hideOneAvatarObject = function(d)
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        elseif d:IsA("Decal") then d.Transparency = 1 end
end
F.hideCharacterLocally = function(c)
        F.hiddenAvatarObjects = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then
                        F.hiddenAvatarObjects[#F.hiddenAvatarObjects + 1] = d
                        F.hideOneAvatarObject(d)
                end
        end
        F.track(c.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if char ~= c then return end
                if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then
                        F.hiddenAvatarObjects[#F.hiddenAvatarObjects + 1] = d
                        F.hideOneAvatarObject(d)
                end
        end))
end
F.bind = function(c)
        F.hideDeathScreen()
        char = c
        hum = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        F.observeHumanoid(hum)
        F.oldCameraOffset = hum.CameraOffset
        S.cameraEyeH = 1.62
        eyeH = 1.62
        hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
        hrp = c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if UIS.TouchEnabled and S.controls then pcall(function() S.controls:Disable() end) end
        local off = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and 3 or (hrp.Size.Y / 2 + hum.HipHeight)
        S.rootVisualOffset = off
        pos = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, off, 0) + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
        prevPos, S.spawnPos, vel = pos, pos, Vector3.zero
        onGround = false
        yaw = math.atan2(-hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, -hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
        bodyYaw, prevBodyYaw = yaw, yaw
        hrp.Anchored = false
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        hum.WalkSpeed = 0
        hum.AutoRotate = false
        hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, S.model }
        F.rpPick.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, S.model }
        F.hideCharacterLocally(c)
        if F.applyCameraMode then F.applyCameraMode() end
end
F.applyCameraMode = function()
        camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
        if not camera then return end
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        if hum and hum.Parent then camera.CameraSubject = hum end
        local uiOpen = invOpen or chatOpen
        if uiOpen then
                -- Keep the native camera, but unlock the cursor while an interface is open.
                lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMinZoom
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMaxZoom
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
                UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
        elseif viewMode == 0 then
                lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMinZoom
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMaxZoom
        else
                lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
                -- Keep both third-person views at one fixed native-camera distance.
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = 12
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 12
        end
        if S.cameraViewButton then
                S.cameraViewButton.Text = ({[0] = "1ST", [1] = "3RD BACK", [2] = "3RD FRONT"})[viewMode] or "1ST"
        end
end
local W = 0.6 * BLOCK
S.STEP_HEIGHT = 0.6 * BLOCK
S.COLLISION_SKIN = 0.025
F.cast = function(p, h, d)
        local size = Vector3.new(W - 0.02, h * BLOCK - 0.02, W - 0.02)
        return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, h * BLOCK / 2, 0)), size, d, rp)
end
F.moveAxis = function(p, axis, amount, h)
        if math.abs(amount) <= 1e-5 then return p, false end
        local d = axis * amount
        local hit = F.cast(p, h, d)
        if hit then
                local travel = math.max(0, hit.Distance - S.COLLISION_SKIN)
                return p + d.Unit * travel, true
        end
        return p + d, false
end
F.tryStep = function(fromPosition, axis, amount, h)
        local upPosition, upHit = F.moveAxis(fromPosition, Vector3.yAxis, S.STEP_HEIGHT, h)
        if upHit then return fromPosition, false end
        local acrossPosition, acrossHit = F.moveAxis(upPosition, axis, amount, h)
        if acrossHit and (acrossPosition - upPosition).Magnitude < math.abs(amount) * 0.5 then
                return fromPosition, false
        end
        local downPosition, downHit = F.moveAxis(acrossPosition, Vector3.yAxis, -S.STEP_HEIGHT - S.COLLISION_SKIN * 2, h)
        if not downHit then return fromPosition, false end
        return downPosition, (downPosition - fromPosition).Magnitude > 0.001
end
F.moveHorizontalAxis = function(p, axis, amount, h, grounded)
        local directPosition, hit = F.moveAxis(p, axis, amount, h)
        if not hit or not grounded then return directPosition, hit end
        local steppedPosition, stepped = F.tryStep(p, axis, amount, h)
        if stepped and (steppedPosition - p).Magnitude > math.abs(amount) * 0.5 then
                return steppedPosition, false
        end
        return directPosition, true
end
F.horizontal = function(p, dx, dz, h, grounded)
        local hx, hz = false, false
        if math.abs(dx) >= math.abs(dz) then
                p, hx = F.moveHorizontalAxis(p, Vector3.xAxis, dx, h, grounded)
                p, hz = F.moveHorizontalAxis(p, Vector3.zAxis, dz, h, grounded)
        else
                p, hz = F.moveHorizontalAxis(p, Vector3.zAxis, dz, h, grounded)
                p, hx = F.moveHorizontalAxis(p, Vector3.xAxis, dx, h, grounded)
        end
        return p, hx, hz
end
F.hasGroundAt = function(p, h)
        -- Use the original controller's short ground probe. A distant lower floor must
        -- not count as grounding, or the feet can stop above the baseplate.
        return F.cast(p, h, Vector3.new(0, -0.16, 0)) ~= nil
end
F.edgeClamp = function(p, dx, dz, h)
        local inc = 0.05 * BLOCK
        local function shrink(v) if math.abs(v) <= inc then return 0 end return v - math.sign(v) * inc end
        for _ = 1, 40 do if dx ~= 0 and not F.hasGroundAt(p + Vector3.new(dx, 0, 0), h) then dx = shrink(dx) else break end end
        for _ = 1, 40 do if dz ~= 0 and not F.hasGroundAt(p + Vector3.new(0, 0, dz), h) then dz = shrink(dz) else break end end
        for _ = 1, 40 do
                if dx ~= 0 and dz ~= 0 and not F.hasGroundAt(p + Vector3.new(dx, 0, dz), h) then dx = shrink(dx) dz = shrink(dz) else break end
        end
        return dx, dz
end
F.moveEntity = function(dx, dy, dz)
        local h = sneaking and 1.5 or 1.8
        local startGround = onGround
        local p = pos
        if sneaking and startGround and dy <= 0 then dx, dz = F.edgeClamp(p, dx, dz, h) end
        -- Match the mechanics controller: resolve horizontal movement first, then fall.
        -- This lets the player leave an upper platform before ground contact is tested.
        local hx, hz
        p, hx, hz = F.horizontal(p, dx, dz, h, startGround)
        local hitY
        p, hitY = F.moveAxis(p, Vector3.yAxis, dy, h)
        local landed = hitY and dy < 0
        pos = p
        onGround = landed or false
        if hitY then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) end
        if hx then vel = Vector3.new(0, vel.Y, vel.Z) end
        if hz then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y, 0) end
        return hx or hz
end
F.snapToNearbyGround = function(p, h, maxDistance)
        -- A short probe may find a nearby lower floor. Snap down to its exact surface
        -- instead of declaring grounded while leaving the player floating above it.
        local hit = F.cast(p, h, Vector3.new(0, -(maxDistance or 0.42), 0))
        if not hit then return p, false end
        local settle = math.max(0, hit.Distance - S.COLLISION_SKIN)
        if settle > 0 then p -= Vector3.yAxis * settle end
        return p, true
end
local H = (function()
local rectsOf, paintFaceOf, FACES, BLOCKFACES, getBlockAt = MCB.rects, MCB.paintFace, MCB.FACES, MCB.BLOCKFACES, MCB.get
local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local climbOP = OverlapParams.new()
climbOP.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
climbOP.RespectCanCollide = false
local handsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
handsFolder.Name = "MCHands"
handsFolder.Parent = workspace
local function isOnClimbable()
        local b = getBlockAt(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0))
        if b and b:GetAttribute("MCClimb") then return true end
        climbOP.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, S.model, handsFolder }
        local box = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * BLOCK, 0)), Vector3.new(0.6 * BLOCK + 0.6, 1.7 * BLOCK, 0.6 * BLOCK + 0.6), climbOP)
        for _, p in ipairs(box) do
                if p:IsA("TrussPart") or p:GetAttribute("Climbable") == true or p:GetAttribute("MCClimb") == true
                        or CS:HasTag(p, "Climbable") or (p.Parent and p.Parent:GetAttribute("Climbable") == true) then
                        return true
                end
        end
        return false
end
local Mcf = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi)
local rad = math.rad
local HANDHELD = { diamond_sword = true, diamond_pickaxe = true, diamond_axe = true, diamond_shovel = true, stick = true }
local DISPLAY = {
        -- Non-block item transforms follow the Java 1.12.x item-model display settings.
        -- Generated items (food, ingots, gems, etc.) use generated.json's third-person pose;
        -- tools and swords use handheld.json's angled third-person pose. Block transforms
        -- are intentionally untouched.
        generated = { fp = { r = { 0, -90, 25 }, t = { 1.13, 3.2, 1.13 }, s = 0.68 }, tp = { r = { 0, 0, 0 }, t = { 0, 3, 1 }, s = 0.48 } },
        handheld = { fp = { r = { 0, -90, 25 }, t = { 1.13, 3.2, 1.13 }, s = 0.68 }, tp = { r = { 0, -90, 55 }, t = { 0, 4, 0.5 }, s = 0.68 } },
        block = { fp = { r = { 0, 45, 0 }, t = { 0, 0, 0 }, s = 0.41 }, tp = { r = { 75, 45, 0 }, t = { 0, 2.5, 0 }, s = 0.375 } },
}
local function itemKind(id)
        if BLOCKFACES[id] then return "block" end
        return HANDHELD[id] and "handheld" or "generated"
end
local function isBlockItem(id)
        return BLOCKFACES[id] ~= nil or (ITEMS[id] ~= nil and ITEMS[id].placeable == true)
end
local function dispCF(d, kind)
        local translation = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(d.t[1], d.t[2], d.t[3]) / 16 * BLOCK)
        if kind == "block" then
                -- Preserve the existing block-item transform path, per the requested scope.
                return translation
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(d.r[3]))
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(d.r[2]), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(rad(d.r[1]), 0, 0)
        end
        -- Java 1.12 ItemTransformVec3f JSON display transforms are composed X, Y, Z.
        return translation
                * CFrame.Angles(rad(d.r[1]), 0, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(d.r[2]), 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(d.r[3]))
end
local function basePart(size, color)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Size = size
        p.Color = color
        p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        return p
end
local itemModels = {}
local function getItemModel(id, scale)
        local key = id .. "@" .. scale
        local m = itemModels[key]
        if m then return m end
        m = Instance.new("Model")
        m.Name = key
        if itemKind(id) == "block" then
                local cube = basePart(Vector3.new(BLOCK, BLOCK, BLOCK) * scale, S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))
                cube.Parent = m
                m.PrimaryPart = cube
                for _, f in ipairs(FACES) do paintFaceOf(cube, f[1], id) end
        elseif F.toolInfo[id] then
                local tinfo = F.toolInfo[id]
                local plate = basePart(Vector3.new(16, 16, 1) * PX * scale, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                plate.Transparency = 1
                plate.Parent = m
                m.PrimaryPart = plate
                for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }) do
                        local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                        sg.Face = face
                        sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
                        sg.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(64, 64)
                        sg.LightInfluence = 0
                        sg.Adornee = plate
                        sg.Parent = plate
                        if tinfo.image and tinfo.image ~= "" then
                                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                                img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                                img.Image = tinfo.image
                                img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                                img.Parent = sg
                        else
                                local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                                t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                                t.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
                                t.TextScaled = true
                                t.TextWrapped = true
                                t.Text = tinfo.name
                                t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                                t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                                t.Parent = sg
                        end
                end
        else
                local a = basePart(Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                a.Transparency = 1
                a.Parent = m
                m.PrimaryPart = a
                local tex = S.ICON[id]
                if tex then
                        if not tex.px then tex.px = F.decodeRLE(tex.d) end
                        for _, r in ipairs(rectsOf(tex.px, tex.w, tex.h)) do
                                local v = basePart(Vector3.new(r.w, r.h, 1) * PX * scale, r.c)
                                v.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(r.x + r.w / 2 - 8, 8 - r.y - r.h / 2, 0) * PX * scale)
                                v.Parent = m
                        end
                end
        end
        itemModels[key] = m
        return m
end
local FIRST_PERSON_ARM_SCALE = 1.12
local fpArm = basePart(Vector3.new(4, 12, 4) * PX * FIRST_PERSON_ARM_SCALE, Color3.fromRGB(176, 125, 96))
fpArm.Name = "FPArm"
F.paintBox(fpArm, 40, 16, 4, 12, 4)
local curModel = nil
local function showModel(m, cf)
        if curModel ~= m then
                if curModel then curModel.Parent = nil end
                curModel = m
                m.Parent = handsFolder
        end
        m:PivotTo(cf)
end
local function hideItem()
        if curModel then curModel.Parent = nil curModel = nil end
end
local function hideFP()
        fpArm.Parent = nil
        hideItem()
end
local attackPrev, attackCur = 0, 0
local handHeight, handHeightPrev = 0, 0
local shownId = nil
-- Hand sway: the held item lags behind camera rotation (xBob/yBob chase the view angles each tick).
local xBob, yBob, xBobO, yBobO, bobInit = 0, 0, 0, 0, false
local function wrapDeg(a) return (a + 180) % 360 - 180 end
local function handTick()
        attackPrev = attackCur
        if S.swinging then
                S.swingTime += 1
                if S.swingTime >= 6 then
                        -- End this six-tick swing at the wrapped zero phase. Render interpolation
                        -- treats the 5/6 -> 0 boundary as 5/6 -> 1, matching Minecraft's partial-tick
                        -- swing interpolation without playing the attack curve backward.
                        S.swingTime = 0
                        if S.swingQueued then
                                S.swingQueued = false
                                S.swinging = true
                        else
                                S.swinging = false
                        end
                        attackCur = 0
                else
                        attackCur = math.clamp(S.swingTime / 6, 0, 1)
                end
        else
                attackCur = 0
        end
        F.swingProgress = attackCur
        local held = slots[36 + selected]
        local id = held and held.id or nil
        handHeightPrev = handHeight
        handHeight += math.clamp((id == shownId and 1 or 0) - handHeight, -0.4, 0.4)
        if handHeight < 0.1 and id ~= shownId then shownId = id end
        xBobO, yBobO = xBob, yBob
        local mx, my = -math.deg(pitch), -math.deg(yaw)
        if not bobInit then
                xBob, yBob, xBobO, yBobO, bobInit = mx, my, mx, my, true
        else
                xBob += (mx - xBob) * 0.5
                yBob += wrapDeg(my - yBob) * 0.5
        end
end
local function attackAnim(alpha)
        -- Interpolate like Minecraft's partial-tick swing value. The end transition
        -- from a high phase back to zero wraps forward to phase 1, rather than swinging
        -- the arm backward or snapping at the final frame.
        local d = attackCur - attackPrev
        if d < -0.5 then d += 1 end
        return math.clamp(attackPrev + d * math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1), 0, 1)
end
local function updateFirstPerson(camCF, alpha)
        local atk = attackAnim(alpha)
        local inv = 1 - (handHeightPrev + (handHeight - handHeightPrev) * alpha)
        local s = math.sqrt(atk)
        local id = shownId
        -- Hand sway: tilt the hand/item by how far the view has turned since the lagging xBob/yBob values.
        local sway = CFrame.Angles(rad((-math.deg(pitch) - (xBobO + (xBob - xBobO) * alpha)) * 0.1), 0, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(wrapDeg(-math.deg(yaw) - (yBobO + (yBob - yBobO) * alpha)) * 0.1), 0)
        camCF = camCF * sway
        if id == nil then
                hideItem()
                local chain = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(
                                -0.3 * math.sin(s * math.pi) + 0.64000005,
                                0.4 * math.sin(s * 2 * math.pi) - 0.6 + inv * -0.6,
                                -0.4 * math.sin(atk * math.pi) - 0.71999997) * BLOCK)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(45), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(math.sin(s * math.pi) * 70), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(math.sin(atk * atk * math.pi) * -20))
                        * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-1, 3.6, 3.5) * BLOCK)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(120)) * CFrame.Angles(rad(200), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-135), 0)
                        * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(5.6, 0, 0) * BLOCK)
                if slots[36 + selected] == nil then
                        fpArm.CFrame = camCF * chain * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-6, 6, 0) / 16 * BLOCK) * Mcf
                        fpArm.Parent = handsFolder
                else
                        fpArm.Parent = nil
                end
        else
                local kind = itemKind(id)
                local d = DISPLAY[kind].fp
                local eatBlend = math.clamp(F.eatAnimationBlend or (F.eating and 1 or 0), 0, 1)
                local eatElapsed = math.clamp(F.renderEatTime or F.eatTime or 0, 0, 32)
                local eatRemaining = 1 - eatElapsed / 32
                local eatPull = 1 - eatRemaining ^ 27
                local eatBob = 0
                if eatRemaining < 0.8 then
                        eatBob = math.abs(math.cos((32 - eatElapsed) / 4 * math.pi) * 0.1)
                end
                local chain = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0.56, -0.52 + inv * -0.6, -0.72) * BLOCK)
                        * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-0.4 * math.sin(s * math.pi), 0.2 * math.sin(s * 2 * math.pi), -0.2 * math.sin(atk * math.pi)) * BLOCK)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(45 + math.sin(atk * atk * math.pi) * -20), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(math.sin(s * math.pi) * -20))
                        * CFrame.Angles(rad(math.sin(s * math.pi) * -80), 0, 0)
        -- Restored from the previous block-item pose: the final -45 degree Y rotation
        -- belongs to the shared hand chain. Item A keeps its current non-block display
        -- transform separately in dispCF; the block display transform remains independent.
        chain = chain * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-45), 0)
                local eatTransform = CFrame.identity
                if kind ~= "block" and eatBlend > 0.001 then
                        local amount = eatPull * eatBlend
                        eatTransform = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(amount * 0.6, amount * -0.5 + eatBob * eatBlend, 0) * BLOCK)
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(amount * 90), 0)
                                * CFrame.Angles(rad(amount * 10), 0, 0)
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(amount * 30))
                end
                -- Block item rotation intentionally stays on its existing transform path.
                fpArm.Parent = nil
                showModel(getItemModel(id, d.s), camCF * chain * eatTransform * dispCF(d, kind))
        end
end
local function updateThirdPerson(root, armP, armX, bobZ, armY, armSwingZ)
        fpArm.Parent = nil
        local held = slots[36 + selected]
        if not held then hideItem() return end
        local kind = itemKind(held.id)
        local d = DISPLAY[kind].tp
        local cf = root * Mcf
                * CFrame.new(armP / 16 * BLOCK)
                * CFrame.Angles(armX, armY or 0, bobZ + (armSwingZ or 0))
        local handOffset = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(1 / 16, 0.125, -0.625) * BLOCK)
        -- The pixel-art models are authored in an XY plane. Align that plane to the
        -- third-person hand first, then apply the independent display transform for this
        -- item kind. This fixes Item A without sharing its transform with block items.
        cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(rad(-90), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(180), 0) * handOffset
        local eatBlend = math.clamp(F.eatAnimationBlend or (F.eating and 1 or 0), 0, 1)
        if kind ~= "block" and eatBlend > 0.001 then
                local elapsed = math.clamp(F.renderEatTime or F.eatTime or 0, 0, 32)
                local remaining = 1 - elapsed / 32
                local amount = (1 - remaining ^ 27) * eatBlend
                local bob = remaining < 0.8 and math.abs(math.cos((32 - elapsed) / 4 * math.pi) * 0.1) or 0
                -- The hand/item moves together, smoothly approaching the mouth while held.
                cf = cf * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(amount * 0.13, amount * 0.10 + bob * eatBlend, 0) * BLOCK)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(amount * 35), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(rad(amount * 10), 0, 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(amount * 18))
        end
        cf = cf * dispCF(d, kind)
        showModel(getItemModel(held.id, d.s), cf)
end
local function createDropVisual(id, count, position)
        local visual = getItemModel(id, 0.22):Clone()
        visual.Name = "DroppedItem_" .. id
        for _, node in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
                if node:IsA("BasePart") then
                        node.Anchored = true
                        node.CanCollide = false
                        node.CanTouch = false
                        node.CanQuery = false
                        node.CastShadow = true
                end
        end
        visual.Parent = dropFolder
        visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
        local primary = visual.PrimaryPart
        local visiblePartCount = 0
        for _, node in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
                if node:IsA("BasePart") and node ~= primary and node.Transparency < 1 then visiblePartCount += 1 end
        end
        if primary and visiblePartCount == 0 and itemKind(id) ~= "block" then
                primary.Transparency = 0
                primary.Size = Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28)
                primary.Color = (S.BLOCK_COLORS[id] or Color3.fromRGB(190, 170, 90))
        end
        -- Dropped stacks are represented only by their item models. Do not create
        -- a floating count label; the number of visible models communicates the stack.
        return visual, nil
end
return {
        isOnClimbable = isOnClimbable, handsFolder = handsFolder, handTick = handTick,
        updateFirstPerson = updateFirstPerson, updateThirdPerson = updateThirdPerson,
        swingAt = attackAnim,
        createDropVisual = createDropVisual,
}
end)()
local droppedItems = {}
S.dropRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
S.dropRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
S.dropRayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
-- A ladder needs a solid part behind it; when that support disappears the ladder breaks and drops.
F.checkLadders = function()
        local set = F.ladderSet
        if not set then return end
        for part in pairs(set) do
                if not part.Parent then
                        set[part] = nil
                else
                        local n, cell = part:GetAttribute("MCLadderN"), part:GetAttribute("MCCell")
                        if typeof(n) == "Vector3" and typeof(cell) == "Vector3" and not workspace:Raycast(cell, -n * (BLOCK * 0.6), rp) then
                                set[part] = nil
                                removeBlock(part)
                                if not abilities.instabuild and ITEMS.ladder then
                                        F.spawnBlockDrop("ladder", cell)
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
end
-- Item entities use 20 TPS physics, gravity 0.04 and drag 0.98 per tick,
-- 0.6 * 0.98 ground friction, a 0.25-block hitbox, pickup delay in ticks (10 for block drops,
-- 40 for thrown items), and 6000-tick (5 minute) despawn. Separate dropped entities never merge;
-- copies are added only when a single dropped entity already contains a multi-item stack.
-- The pickup box of the player is expanded by 1 / 0.5 / 1 blocks.
-- position is in studs, velocity in blocks per tick.
F.spawnDropEntity = function(id, count, position, velocity, pickupDelay)
        count = math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0)
        if not id or count <= 0 or not ITEMS[id] or not H.createDropVisual then return nil end
        local visual = H.createDropVisual(id, count, position)
        local item = {
                id = id, count = count, visual = visual,
                position = position, prevPosition = position, velocity = velocity or Vector3.zero,
                onGround = false, age = 0, pickupDelay = pickupDelay or 10,
                hoverStart = math.random() * math.pi * 2, extras = {}, offsets = {}, collect = nil,
        }
        droppedItems[#droppedItems + 1] = item
        F.syncDropCopies(item)
        return item
end
-- Stacks render as several copies (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 for 1, <=16, <=32, <=48, more).
F.syncDropCopies = function(item)
        local n = item.count
        local copies = n <= 1 and 1 or (n <= 16 and 2 or (n <= 32 and 3 or (n <= 48 and 4 or 5)))
        while #item.extras < copies - 1 do
                local c = item.visual:Clone()
                c.Parent = dropFolder
                item.extras[#item.extras + 1] = c
                item.offsets[#item.extras] = Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.1, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15) * BLOCK
        end
        while #item.extras > copies - 1 do
                local c = table.remove(item.extras)
                table.remove(item.offsets)
                if c then c:Destroy() end
        end
end
F.destroyDrop = function(item)
        if item.visual then item.visual:Destroy() end
        for _, c in ipairs(item.extras) do c:Destroy() end
        item.extras = {}
end
F.spawnItemDrop = function(id, count)
        count = math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0)
        if not id or count <= 0 or not ITEMS[id] or not H.createDropVisual then return false end
        local look = (CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch or 0, 0, 0)).LookVector
        local spawnAt = (pos or Vector3.zero) + Vector3.new(0, ((eyeH or 1.62) - 0.3) * BLOCK, 0)

        -- Every player drop starts from the same hand/eye-relative position.
        -- Do not move later drops sideways to make artificial parking slots; keep each
        -- drop as its own entity while allowing its normal throw velocity and physics.
        local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.random() * 0.02
        local vel = look * 0.3 + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0.1 + (math.random() - math.random()) * 0.1, math.sin(a) * r)
        return F.spawnDropEntity(id, count, spawnAt, vel, 40) ~= nil
end
-- Block drops pop out of the broken block with a small random hop and a 10 tick pickup delay.
F.spawnBlockDrop = function(id, cell)
        local o = Vector3.new(math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25, math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25 - 0.125, math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25) * BLOCK
        local vel = Vector3.new(math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1, 0.2, math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1)
        return F.spawnDropEntity(id, 1, cell + o, vel, 10)
end
F.dropInventorySelection = function(dropAll)
        local stack, sourceIndex
        if carried then
                stack = carried
                sourceIndex = "carried"
        elseif ((S.panel and S.panel.Visible) or (F.cWin and F.cWin.Visible)) and S.hover ~= nil and slots[S.hover] then
                stack = slots[S.hover]
                sourceIndex = S.hover
        else
                sourceIndex = 36 + selected
                stack = slots[sourceIndex]
        end
        if not stack or not stack.id or stack.n <= 0 then return end
        local count = dropAll and stack.n or 1
        if F.toolInfo[stack.id] then
                if not F.dropRobloxTool(stack.id) then return end
                count = 1
        elseif not F.spawnItemDrop(stack.id, count) then
                return
        end
        stack.n -= count
        if stack.n <= 0 then
                if sourceIndex == "carried" then carried = nil else slots[sourceIndex] = nil end
        end
        F.updateCraft()
        refresh()
end
-- Roblox Tools are mirrored into the Minecraft inventory: every Tool in the Backpack / Character
-- becomes a one-item stack (its image as icon, or its name), the Roblox backpack UI is hidden, and
-- the Minecraft hotbar selection equips / unequips the real Tool.
local toolIds, toolCounter = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), 0
function S.toolOwned(tool)
        if not tool or not tool.Parent then return false end
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        local bp = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        return (bp ~= nil and tool.Parent == bp) or (char ~= nil and tool.Parent == char)
end
F.refreshAllViews = function()
        for _, store in ipairs({ S.views, F.cViews, S.hudViews }) do
                for _, v in pairs(store) do v.id = nil end
        end
        if S.carriedView then S.carriedView.id = nil end
        refresh()
end
F.registerTool = function(tool)
        local id = toolIds[tool]
        if id then return id end
        toolCounter += 1
        id = "rbx_tool_" .. toolCounter
        toolIds[tool] = id
        local info = { tool = tool, name = tool.Name, image = tool.TextureId }
        F.toolInfo[id] = info
        ITEMS[id] = { name = tool.Name, max = 1, robloxTool = true }
        F.track(tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextureId"):Connect(function()
                info.image = tool.TextureId
                F.clearIconCache(id)
                F.refreshAllViews()
        end))
        F.track(tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
                info.name = tool.Name
                ITEMS[id].name = tool.Name
                F.clearIconCache(id)
                F.refreshAllViews()
        end))
        return id
end
function S.listTools()
        local out = {}
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        local bp = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then
                for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                        if t:IsA("Tool") then out[#out + 1] = t end
                end
        end
        if char then
                for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                        if t:IsA("Tool") then out[#out + 1] = t end
                end
        end
        return out
end
F.syncRobloxTools = function()
        local present, changed = {}, false
        for _, tool in ipairs(S.listTools()) do
                local id = F.registerTool(tool)
                present[id] = true
                local have = carried ~= nil and carried.id == id
                if not have then
                        for i = 1, 45 do
                                if slots[i] and slots[i].id == id then have = true break end
                        end
                end
                if not have then
                        local st = { id = id, n = 1 }
                        F.insertStack(st, 36, 44)
                        if st.n > 0 then F.insertStack(st, 9, 35) end
                        changed = true
                end
        end
        for i = 1, 45 do
                local st = slots[i]
                if st and F.toolInfo[st.id] and not present[st.id] then
                        slots[i] = nil
                        changed = true
                end
        end
        if carried and F.toolInfo[carried.id] and not present[carried.id] then
                carried = nil
                changed = true
        end
        if changed then
                F.updateCraft()
                refresh()
        end
end
F.heldTool = function()
        local st = slots[36 + selected]
        local info = st and F.toolInfo[st.id]
        return info and info.tool or nil
end
F.heldIsTool = function() return F.heldTool() ~= nil end
F.syncToolEquip = function()
        if F.playerDead or not char or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        local want = F.heldTool()
        local cur = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if want and S.toolOwned(want) then
                if cur ~= want then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(want) end) end
        elseif cur then
                pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
        end
        -- In first person the Minecraft-style plate replaces the real handle.
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
                local hide = (viewMode == 0) and 1 or 0
                for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hide end
                end
        end
end
F.dropRobloxTool = function(id)
        local info = F.toolInfo[id]
        local tool = info and info.tool
        if not tool or not tool.Parent or not tool.CanBeDropped then return false end
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local look = (CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch or 0, 0, 0)).LookVector
        local from = (pos or Vector3.zero) + Vector3.new(0, ((eyeH or 1.62) - 0.3) * BLOCK, 0)
        handle.CanTouch = false
        tool.Parent = workspace
        handle.CFrame = CFrame.new(from + look * BLOCK)
        handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = look * (0.3 * BLOCK * 20) + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * BLOCK * 20, 0)
        task.delay(2, function()
                if handle.Parent then handle.CanTouch = true end
        end)
        task.defer(F.syncRobloxTools)
        return true
end
task.spawn(function()
        local sg = game:GetService("StarterGui")
        for _ = 1, 20 do
                if pcall(function() sg:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end) then break end
                task.wait(0.5)
        end
end)
do
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        local function hookBackpack(bp)
                F.track(bp.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(F.syncRobloxTools) end))
                F.track(bp.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() task.defer(F.syncRobloxTools) end))
        end
        local bp = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then hookBackpack(bp) end
        if lp then
                F.track(lp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                        if c:IsA("Backpack") then hookBackpack(c) task.defer(F.syncRobloxTools) end
                end))
        end
        task.defer(F.syncRobloxTools)
end

-- F3 debug screen modelled on Java 1.20; values come from the real game state where possible.
local dbgFrames, dbgLastFps, dbgFps, dbgLastUpdate, dbgHeights, dbgHeightT = 0, os.clock(), 60, 0, { 0, 0, 0, 0 }, 0
function S.dbgSetLines(colName, lines, container)
        local pool = F.debugLabels[colName]
        local right = colName == "Right"
        for i, text in ipairs(lines) do
                local l = pool[i]
                if not l then
                        l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        l.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        l.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
                        l.TextSize = 11
                        l.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        l.TextXAlignment = right and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                        l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                        l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 13)
                        l.LayoutOrder = i
                        l.ZIndex = 17
                        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
                        pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 2), UDim.new(0, 2)
                        pad.Parent = l
                        l.Parent = container
                        pool[i] = l
                end
                l.Visible = true
                l.Text = text
                l.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                l.BackgroundTransparency = text == "" and 1 or 0.44
        end
        for i = #lines + 1, #pool do pool[i].Visible = false end
end
S.FACING = {
        [0] = "south (Towards positive Z)", [1] = "west (Towards negative X)",
        [2] = "north (Towards negative Z)", [3] = "east (Towards positive X)",
}
F.updateDebugScreen = function()
        dbgFrames += 1
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - dbgLastFps >= 0.5 then
                dbgFps = dbgFrames / (now - dbgLastFps)
                dbgFrames, dbgLastFps = 0, now
        end
        if now - dbgLastUpdate < 0.1 then return end
        dbgLastUpdate = now
        local p = pos or Vector3.zero
        local bx, by, bz = p.X / BLOCK, p.Y / BLOCK, p.Z / BLOCK
        local ix, iy, iz = math.floor(bx + 0.5), math.floor(by + 0.5), math.floor(bz + 0.5)
        local cx, cy, cz = math.floor(ix / 16), math.floor(iy / 16), math.floor(iz / 16)
        local mcYaw = ((180 - math.deg(yaw or 0)) + 180) % 360 - 180
        local mcPitch = -math.deg(pitch or 0)
        local facing = S.FACING[math.floor(mcYaw / 90 + 0.5) % 4]
        -- Heightmaps: the highest solid surface above the player's column.
        if now - dbgHeightT > 0.5 then
                dbgHeightT = now
                local res = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 600, p.Z), Vector3.new(0, -1200, 0), rp)
                local h = res and math.floor(res.Position.Y / BLOCK + 0.5) or 0
                dbgHeights = { h, h, h, h }
        end
        local clock = game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime
        local skyLight = (clock >= 6 and clock < 18) and 15 or 4
        local blocks = blockFolder and #blockFolder:GetChildren() or 0
        local ents = #droppedItems
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function() ping = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
        local mem = 0
        pcall(function() mem = game:GetService("Stats"):GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(0, 0)
        local day = math.floor((F.dayTime or age or 0) / 24000)
        local left = {
                "Minecraft PI3 (PI3/vanilla)",
                string.format("%d fps T: inf vsync fancy-clouds B: 2", math.floor(dbgFps + 0.5)),
                string.format("Integrated server @ %d ms tick, 0 tx, 0 rx", math.floor(ping + 0.5)),
                string.format("C: %d/%d (s) D: 12, pC: 000, pU: 00, aB: 12", blocks, blocks),
                string.format("E: %d/%d, SD: 12", ents, ents + 1),
                string.format("P: 0. T: %d", ents + 1),
                "Client Chunk Cache: 625, 441",
                "ServerChunkCache: 2209",
                "minecraft:overworld FC: 0",
                "",
                string.format("XYZ: %.3f / %.5f / %.3f", bx, by, bz),
                string.format("Block: %d %d %d", ix, iy, iz),
                string.format("Chunk: %d %d %d in %d %d %d", ix % 16, iy % 16, iz % 16, cx, cy, cz),
                string.format("Facing: %s (%.1f / %.1f)", facing, mcYaw, mcPitch),
                string.format("Client Light: %d (%d sky, 0 block)", skyLight, skyLight),
                string.format("CH S: %d M: %d", dbgHeights[1], dbgHeights[2]),
                string.format("SH S: %d O: %d M: %d ML: %d", dbgHeights[1], dbgHeights[2], dbgHeights[3], dbgHeights[4]),
                "Biome: minecraft:plains",
                string.format("Local Difficulty: 0.75 // 0.00 (Day %d)", day),
                "Sounds: 0/247 + 0/8 (Mood 0%)",
        }
        local right = {
                "Java: Luau (Roblox) 64bit",
                string.format("Mem: %d%% %d/4096MB", math.floor(mem / 4096 * 100), math.floor(mem)),
                string.format("Allocated: %d%% %dMB", math.floor(mem / 4096 * 100), math.floor(mem)),
                "CPU: Roblox client",
                "",
                string.format("Display: %dx%d (Roblox)", vp.X, vp.Y),
                "Roblox " .. (type(version) == "function" and version() or "unknown"),
                "",
        }
        if not invOpen then
                local part, hitPos, hitNormal = F.pickBlock()
                if part and hitPos and hitNormal then
                        local cell
                        local bid = part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId")
                        if bid then
                                cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell")
                        elseif F.getGridCellCenter then
                                cell = F.getGridCellCenter(part, hitPos, hitNormal)
                        end
                        cell = typeof(cell) == "Vector3" and cell or hitPos
                        right[#right + 1] = string.format("Targeted Block: %d, %d, %d",
                                math.floor(cell.X / BLOCK + 0.5), math.floor(cell.Y / BLOCK + 0.5), math.floor(cell.Z / BLOCK + 0.5))
                        right[#right + 1] = bid and ("minecraft:" .. bid) or ("roblox:" .. string.lower((part.Name:gsub("%s+", "_"))))
                end
        end
        S.dbgSetLines("Left", left, F.debugLeft)
        S.dbgSetLines("Right", right, F.debugRight)
end
S.DROP_TICK = 0.05
S.dropAcc = 0
function S.stepDrop(item)
        local R = 0.125 * BLOCK
        item.prevPosition = item.position
        if item.collect then
                item.collect += 1
                return item.collect >= 3
        end
        if item.pickupDelay > 0 then item.pickupDelay -= 1 end
        item.age += 1
        if item.age >= 6000 then return true end
        local v = item.velocity
        v = Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y - 0.04, v.Z)
        local p = item.position
        local onGround = false
        local d = v * BLOCK
        if d.Y ~= 0 then
                local sgn = d.Y > 0 and 1 or -1
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(p, Vector3.new(0, d.Y + sgn * R, 0), S.dropRayParams)
                if hit then
                        p = Vector3.new(p.X, hit.Position.Y - sgn * R, p.Z)
                        if sgn < 0 then onGround = true end
                        v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
                else
                        p += Vector3.new(0, d.Y, 0)
                end
        end
        for _, axis in ipairs({ "X", "Z" }) do
                local dv = axis == "X" and d.X or d.Z
                if dv ~= 0 then
                        local sgn = dv > 0 and 1 or -1
                        local dir = axis == "X" and Vector3.new(dv + sgn * R, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, dv + sgn * R)
                        local hit = workspace:Raycast(p, dir, S.dropRayParams)
                        if hit then
                                local hp = axis == "X" and hit.Position.X or hit.Position.Z
                                p = axis == "X" and Vector3.new(hp - sgn * R, p.Y, p.Z) or Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y, hp - sgn * R)
                                v = axis == "X" and Vector3.new(0, v.Y, v.Z) or Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y, 0)
                        else
                                p += axis == "X" and Vector3.new(dv, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, dv)
                        end
                end
        end
        local fr = onGround and (0.6 * 0.98) or 0.98
        v = Vector3.new(v.X * fr, v.Y * 0.98, v.Z * fr)
        if onGround and v.Y < 0 then v = Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y * -0.5, v.Z) end
        item.position, item.velocity, item.onGround = p, v, onGround
        if p.Y < workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight then return true end
        -- Deliberately do not merge this entity with nearby dropped items. Each drop
        -- remains its own entity; stack copies above are based only on this entity's count.
        -- Pickup: the player's box inflated by 1 / 0.5 / 1 blocks must touch the item's box.
        if item.pickupDelay <= 0 and pos and not F.playerDead then
                local rx = (0.3 + 1.0 + 0.125) * BLOCK
                if math.abs(p.X - pos.X) <= rx and math.abs(p.Z - pos.Z) <= rx
                        and p.Y - R <= pos.Y + 2.3 * BLOCK and p.Y + R >= pos.Y - 0.5 * BLOCK then
                        local pending = { id = item.id, n = item.count }
                        F.insertStack(pending, 36, 44)
                        if pending.n > 0 then F.insertStack(pending, 9, 35) end
                        if pending.n < item.count then
                                F.pickupDirty = true
                                item.count = pending.n
                                if item.count <= 0 then
                                        item.collect = 0
                                        item.collectFrom = p
                                else
                                        F.syncDropCopies(item)
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
        return false
end
F.updateDroppedItems = function(dt)
        S.dropRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, S.model, H.handsFolder, dropFolder }
        S.dropAcc += math.clamp(dt or 0, 0, 0.25)
        local steps = 0
        while S.dropAcc >= S.DROP_TICK and steps < 6 do
                S.dropAcc -= S.DROP_TICK
                steps += 1
                for i = #droppedItems, 1, -1 do
                        local item = droppedItems[i]
                        if not item.visual or not item.visual.Parent or S.stepDrop(item) then
                                F.destroyDrop(item)
                                table.remove(droppedItems, i)
                        end
                end
        end
        if F.pickupDirty then
                F.pickupDirty = false
                F.updateCraft()
                refresh()
        end
        -- Render with interpolation between ticks, plus Minecraft's bob and spin.
        local alpha = S.dropAcc / S.DROP_TICK
        local target = (pos or Vector3.zero) + Vector3.new(0, (eyeH or 1.62) * 0.5 * BLOCK, 0)
        for _, item in ipairs(droppedItems) do
                if item.visual and item.visual.Parent then
                        local t = item.age + alpha
                        local ip = item.prevPosition:Lerp(item.position, alpha)
                        local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, t / 20 + item.hoverStart, 0)
                        if item.collect then
                                local k = ((item.collect + alpha) / 3) ^ 2
                                ip = (item.collectFrom or ip):Lerp(target, math.clamp(k, 0, 1))
                                item.visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ip) * rot)
                                for i, c in ipairs(item.extras) do
                                        c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ip + item.offsets[i]) * rot)
                                end
                        else
                                local bob = (math.sin(t / 10 + item.hoverStart) * 0.1 + 0.1) * BLOCK
                                local base = CFrame.new(ip + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)) * rot
                                item.visual:PivotTo(base)
                                for i, c in ipairs(item.extras) do
                                        c:PivotTo(base * CFrame.new(item.offsets[i]))
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
end

S.wasJumping = false
F.tick = function()
        if F.playerDead then return end
        prevPos, prevBodyYaw, prevWalkSpeed = pos, bodyYaw, walkSpeed
        age += 1
        H.handTick()
        if age % 10 == 0 then F.checkLadders() end
        F.syncToolEquip()
        if age % 10 == 5 then F.syncRobloxTools() end
        F.eatTimePrev = F.eatTime or 0
        if F.eating then
                F.eatTime = (F.eatTime or 0) + 1
                if F.eatTime >= 32 then
                        if not creative then
                                local foodStack = slots[36 + selected]
                                if foodStack and foodStack.id == F.eatItemId then
                                        local foodInfo = ITEMS[F.eatItemId]
                                        if hum and foodInfo and (foodInfo.food or 0) > 0 then
                        hum.Health = math.min(hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health + math.max(1, (foodInfo.food or 1) * 0.5))
                        F.foodLevel = math.clamp((F.foodLevel or 20) + math.max(1, foodInfo.food or 1), 0, 20)
                    end
                                        foodStack.n -= 1
                                        if foodStack.n <= 0 then slots[36 + selected] = nil end
                                end
                        end
                        F.eating = false
                        F.eatTime = 32
                        F.eatItemId = nil
                        S.rightClickDelay = 0
                        refresh()
                end
        end
        if S.jumpDelay > 0 then S.jumpDelay -= 1 end
        if S.jumpTriggerTime > 0 then S.jumpTriggerTime -= 1 end
        if S.rightClickDelay > 0 then S.rightClickDelay -= 1 end
        if S.missTime > 0 then S.missTime -= 1 end

        local blockedByUI = invOpen or chatOpen or (chatInput ~= nil and chatInput:IsFocused())
        local mv, jumpReq = Vector3.zero, false
        if not blockedByUI then
                mv = F.getMove()
                jumpReq = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or touchJumpHeld or (hum ~= nil and hum.Jump)
                if hum and hum.Jump then hum.Jump = false end
        end

        local inputForward = -mv.Z
        -- Sprint uses the original input; camera-relative movement below handles front-view inversion.

        sneaking = (not blockedByUI) and (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) or sneakToggle) and not abilities.flying
        if inputForward < 0.8 then S.sprintLatch = false end
        sprinting = (not blockedByUI) and (not sneaking) and inputForward >= 0.8 and (
                UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl) or sprintToggle or S.sprintLatch
        )

        local justToggledFlight = false
        if abilities.mayfly and not blockedByUI then
                if jumpReq and not S.wasJumping then
                        if S.jumpTriggerTime == 0 then
                                S.jumpTriggerTime = 7
                        else
                                abilities.flying = not abilities.flying
                                if abilities.flying and onGround then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) end
                                justToggledFlight = true
                                S.jumpTriggerTime = 0
                        end
                end
        end
        S.wasJumping = jumpReq
        if blockedByUI then
                vel = Vector3.zero
                walkSpeed += (0 - walkSpeed) * 0.4
                walkPos += walkSpeed
                F.continueAttack(false)
                return
        end

        local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
        local worldDirection = Vector3.zero
        if cameraNow then
                local cameraMove = mv
                if viewMode == 2 then cameraMove = Vector3.new(-mv.X, 0, -mv.Z) end
                local look = cameraNow.CFrame.LookVector
                local right = cameraNow.CFrame.RightVector
                local forwardFlat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                local rightFlat = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
                if forwardFlat.Magnitude > 1e-5 then forwardFlat = forwardFlat.Unit end
                if rightFlat.Magnitude > 1e-5 then rightFlat = rightFlat.Unit end
                worldDirection = rightFlat * cameraMove.X + forwardFlat * -cameraMove.Z
                if worldDirection.Magnitude > 1 then worldDirection = worldDirection.Unit end
        end

        local onClimb = (not abilities.flying) and H.isOnClimbable()
        local horizontalSpeed
        if abilities.flying then
                horizontalSpeed = sprinting and S.FLY_SPRINT_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND or S.FLY_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND
        elseif sneaking then
                horizontalSpeed = S.SNEAK_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND
        elseif sprinting then
                horizontalSpeed = S.SPRINT_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND
        else
                horizontalSpeed = S.WALK_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND
        end

        -- Match the companion controller: horizontal velocity is measured in blocks/tick,
        -- approaches the target speed using Minecraft's friction factor, and uses the same
        -- 20 TPS collision movement below. Default ground slipperiness is 0.6 (0.546 friction).
        local slipperiness = S.GROUND_SLIPPERINESS
        if onGround then
                local groundRay = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.04, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.18, 0), rp)
                if groundRay and groundRay.Instance and groundRay.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local tagged = groundRay.Instance:GetAttribute("MCSlipperiness")
                        if typeof(tagged) == "number" then
                                slipperiness = math.clamp(tagged, 0.1, 1.0)
                        elseif groundRay.Instance.Material == Enum.Material.Ice then
                                slipperiness = 0.98
                        end
                end
        end
        local friction = onGround and math.clamp(slipperiness * 0.91, 0.1, 0.99) or 0.91
        local targetPerTick = horizontalSpeed / 20
        local accel = (1 - friction) * targetPerTick
        local hv = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * friction
        if worldDirection.Magnitude > 0.001 and not blockedByUI then
                hv += worldDirection * accel
        end
        vel = Vector3.new(hv.X, vel.Y, hv.Z)

        if abilities.flying then
                local verticalInput = 0
                if jumpReq and not justToggledFlight then verticalInput += 1 end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) or sneakToggle then verticalInput -= 1 end
                local targetVertical = verticalInput * 0.12
                vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y * 0.55 + targetVertical * 0.45, vel.Z)
                F.moveEntity(vel.X * BLOCK, vel.Y * BLOCK, vel.Z * BLOCK)
                if onGround and vel.Y < 0 then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) end
        else
                if jumpReq then
                        if onGround and S.jumpDelay == 0 and not blockedByUI then
                                local newY = 0.42
                                -- Keep sprint-jumping at normal ground sprint speed. The previous
                                -- extra horizontal impulse made a regular jump feel like flight sprint.
                                vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, newY, vel.Z)
                                S.jumpDelay = 10
                        end
                else
                        S.jumpDelay = 0
                end

                local climbY = 0
                if onClimb then
                        S.fallDistance = 0
                        local fwdInput = -mv.Z
                        if jumpReq or fwdInput > 0.1 then climbY = 0.2
                        elseif fwdInput < -0.1 and not sneaking then climbY = -0.2
                        else climbY = 0 end
                        vel = Vector3.new(math.clamp(vel.X, -0.15, 0.15), climbY, math.clamp(vel.Z, -0.15, 0.15))
                end

                local hit = F.moveEntity(vel.X * BLOCK, vel.Y * BLOCK, vel.Z * BLOCK)
                if hit then S.sprintLatch = false end
                if onClimb then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, climbY, vel.Z) end

                local heightBlocks = sneaking and 1.5 or 1.8
                local groundedNow = false
                if vel.Y <= 0 then
                        local groundedPosition
                        groundedPosition, groundedNow = F.snapToNearbyGround(pos, heightBlocks, 0.42)
                        if groundedNow then pos = groundedPosition end
                end
                if groundedNow then
                        onGround = true
                        vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
                else
                        onGround = false
                        if not onClimb then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, (vel.Y - 0.08) * 0.98, vel.Z) end
                end

                if not onClimb then
                        if not onGround then
                                S.fallDistance = (S.fallDistance or 0) + math.max(0, -vel.Y)
                        else
                                if (S.fallDistance or 0) > 3 and not abilities.invulnerable then
                                        local dmg = math.floor(S.fallDistance - 3)
                                        if dmg > 0 and hum then
                                                local nextHealth = math.max(0, hum.Health - dmg * 2)
                                                if nextHealth <= 0 then
                                                        F.pendingPlayerDeathMessage = tostring(lp.Name) .. " was killed"
                                                end
                                                hum.Health = nextHealth
                                                if nextHealth <= 0 then
                                                        F.beginPlayerDeath(F.pendingPlayerDeathMessage)
                                                        return
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                                S.fallDistance = 0
                        end
                end
        end

        if math.abs(vel.X) < 0.003 then vel = Vector3.new(0, vel.Y, vel.Z) end
        if math.abs(vel.Z) < 0.003 then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y, 0) end
        if math.abs(vel.Y) < 0.003 then vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) end

        local dxz = Vector3.new(pos.X - prevPos.X, 0, pos.Z - prevPos.Z).Magnitude / BLOCK
        local gaitTarget = math.min(dxz * 4, 1)
        -- Creative flight moves faster than walking, but vanilla-style limb animation
        -- continues at a regular walking cadence instead of becoming a rapid run cycle.
        if abilities.flying then
                gaitTarget = math.min(dxz, S.WALK_BLOCKS_PER_SECOND / 20) * 4
        end
        walkSpeed += (gaitTarget - walkSpeed) * 0.4
        walkPos += walkSpeed

        -- Smooth body turning rather than snapping the body to yaw every simulation tick.
        local yawDelta = F.wrap(yaw - bodyYaw)
        if dxz > 0.0025 or viewMode == 2 then
                local amount = 1 - math.exp(-S.BODY_MOVE_TURN_RESPONSE * TICK)
                bodyYaw = F.wrap(bodyYaw + yawDelta * amount)
                if math.abs(yawDelta) < math.rad(0.25) then bodyYaw = yaw end
        else
                local excess = math.abs(yawDelta) - S.MAX_HEAD_YAW
                if excess > 0 then
                        local catchup = excess - math.min(excess, S.BODY_TURN_DEADZONE)
                        local amount = 1 - math.exp(-S.BODY_TURN_RESPONSE * TICK)
                        bodyYaw = F.wrap(bodyYaw + math.sign(yawDelta) * catchup * amount)
                end
        end

        if F.entityAttackCooldown > 0 then F.entityAttackCooldown -= 1 end
        F.continueAttack(S.attackHeld and not blockedByUI)
        if S.useHeld and S.rightClickDelay == 0 and not blockedByUI then F.startUseItem() end
        if pos.Y < workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 50 then pos, prevPos, vel = S.spawnPos, S.spawnPos, Vector3.zero end
end

        [Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1, [Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2, [Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3, [Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4,
        [Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5, [Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6, [Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7, [Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8,
