local ptr = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
F.isOverHotbar = function(pos2d)
        local objs = playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos2d.X, pos2d.Y)
        for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                if o:IsDescendantOf(S.hotbar) or o == S.dropInventoryButton or o:IsDescendantOf(S.dropInventoryButton) then return true end
        end
        return false
end
F.track(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        local t = input.UserInputType
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                ptr = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                return
        end
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and not invOpen and not chatOpen and not (chatInput and chatInput:IsFocused()) then
                local mp = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                if F.isOverHotbar(mp) then return end
                if not gpe then
                        S.attackHeld = true
                        F.startAttack()
                end
                return
        end
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not invOpen and not chatOpen and not (chatInput and chatInput:IsFocused()) then
                local mp = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                if F.isOverHotbar(mp) then return end
                if not gpe then
                        S.useHeld = true
                        F.startUseItem()
                end
                return
        end
        if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        if F.playerDead then return end
        local k = input.KeyCode
        if k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and S.containerGui then
        S.closeContainer()
        return
    end
    if k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and F.isFurnaceOpen and F.isFurnaceOpen() then
        F.closeFurnace()
        return
    end
        if k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and chatOpen then
                F.setChatOpen(false, false)
                return
        end
        if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if k == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
                hudVisible = not hudVisible
                F.updateHudVisibility()
                return
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.F3 then
                F.toggleDebug()
                return
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.E then
                F.setInventory(not invOpen)
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.W then
                if os.clock() - S.lastW < 0.3 then S.sprintLatch = true end
                S.lastW = os.clock()
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.F5 or k == Enum.KeyCode.V then
                viewMode = (viewMode + 1) % 3
                F.applyCameraMode()
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.F4 then
                local nextMode = ({creative = "survival", survival = "adventure", adventure = "creative"})[S.gameModeName] or "creative"
                F.setGameMode(nextMode)
                if creativeBtn then creativeBtn.Text = S.gameModeName:upper(); F.paintToggle(creativeBtn, creative) end
                if flyBtn then flyBtn.Visible = creative; F.paintToggle(flyBtn, abilities.flying) end
                S.nameLabel.Text = S.gameModeName:sub(1,1):upper() .. S.gameModeName:sub(2) .. " Mode"
                nameUntil = os.clock() + 2
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Q and not invOpen then
                local all = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
                local s = slots[36 + selected]
                if s then
                        local count = all and s.n or 1
                        if F.spawnItemDrop(s.id, count) then
                                s.n -= count
                                if s.n <= 0 then slots[36 + selected] = nil end
                                refresh()
                        end
                end
        elseif S.NUM[k] then
                local n = S.NUM[k]
                if invOpen and S.hover ~= nil and S.hover ~= 0 then
                        local a, b = slots[S.hover], slots[35 + n]
                        if (b == nil or F.canPlace(S.hover, b)) and (a == nil or F.canPlace(35 + n, a)) then
                                slots[S.hover], slots[35 + n] = b, a
                                F.updateCraft()
                                refresh()
                        end
                else
                        F.selectHotbar(n - 1)
                end
        end
end))
F.track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        local t = input.UserInputType
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                ptr = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                if invOpen and F.activeTouchSlot ~= nil and F.touchDragStartPos and F.touchDragCanPick and not F.touchDragging then
                        local moved = (ptr - F.touchDragStartPos).Magnitude
                        if moved >= 12 then
                                F.touchDragging = true
                                F.clickSlot(F.activeTouchSlot, 1, false)
                        end
                end
        elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and not invOpen and not chatOpen and not (chatInput and chatInput:IsFocused()) then
                local dir = math.sign(input.Position.Z)
                if dir ~= 0 then F.selectHotbar((selected - dir) % 9) end
        end
end))

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                S.attackHeld = false

                                                slots[S.hover], slots[35 + i] = b, a

                        return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
                end, false, 3000, keys[i], keys[i + 9])
        end
        ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("MCSteveScrollHotbar", function(_, state, input)
                if state == Enum.UserInputState.Change and not invOpen and input then
                        local dir = math.sign(input.Position.Z)

        end, false, 3000, Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel)
end
local accum = 0
S.renderState = { alpha = 0, ipos = pos, ibody = bodyYaw }
F.update = function(dt)
        camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
        if not camera or F.playerDead then return end
        if not (char and char.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent) then return end
        accum += dt
        local n = 0
        while accum >= TICK and n < 5 and not F.playerDead do
                accum -= TICK
                F.tick()
                n += 1
        end
        if F.playerDead then accum = 0 return end
        if n == 5 then accum = 0 end
        local alpha = accum / TICK
        if debugPanel and debugPanel.Visible and F.updateDebugScreen then F.updateDebugScreen() end
        local ipos = prevPos:Lerp(pos, alpha)
        local ibody = prevBodyYaw + F.wrap(bodyYaw - prevBodyYaw) * alpha
        S.renderState.alpha, S.renderState.ipos, S.renderState.ibody = alpha, ipos, ibody
        -- Keep the real character root synchronized before Roblox's native camera step.
        -- Viewmodel and Steve limbs are rendered separately after the camera updates.
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(ipos + Vector3.new(0, S.rootVisualOffset, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, ibody, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if not invOpen then
                -- Hover/selection is read-only. Outline the shared-grid cell that the
                -- union-cut operation would remove; never replace or voxelize the target.
                local hitPart, hitPos, hitNormal = F.pickBlock()
                if F.isBreakableTarget(hitPart) and hitPos and hitNormal then
                        if hitPart:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") == "ladder" then
                                -- Ladders have a thin plate hitbox, so outline the plate itself.
                                S.selectBox.Adornee = hitPart
                        else
                                local cellCenter = F.getGridCellCenter(hitPart, hitPos, hitNormal)
                                S.selectionProxy.CFrame = CFrame.new(cellCenter)
                                S.selectBox.Adornee = S.selectionProxy
                        end
                else
                        S.selectBox.Adornee = nil
                end
        else
                S.selectBox.Adornee = nil
        end
        if S.selFrame and S.selFrame.Parent then
        selected = math.clamp(math.floor(selected or 0), 0, 8)
        S.selFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((-1 + selected * 20) * S.GS, -1 * S.GS)
    end
        S.crosshair.Visible = (not invOpen) and viewMode ~= 2
        if selected ~= lastSel then
                lastSel = selected
                local s = slots[36 + selected]
                S.nameLabel.Text = s and ITEMS[s.id].name or ""
                nameUntil = os.clock() + 2
        end
        S.nameLabel.Visible = os.clock() < nameUntil and not invOpen
        if invOpen or chatOpen then
                -- The attachment camera must not recapture the cursor over interface controls.
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
                UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
        end
        if invOpen then
                local mp = UIS.MouseEnabled and UIS:GetMouseLocation() or ptr
                S.carriedView.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mp.X - 8 * S.GS, mp.Y - 8 * S.GS)
                S.tooltip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mp.X + 8 * S.GS, mp.Y - 14 * S.GS)
        end
end
F.smoothedHeadYaw = F.smoothedHeadYaw or 0
F.smoothedHeadPitch = F.smoothedHeadPitch or 0
F.renderVisuals = function(renderDt)
        camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
        if not camera then return end
        if F.playerDead then
                H.updateFirstPerson(camera.CFrame, 0)
                if viewMode ~= 0 then
                        S.model.Parent = workspace
                        if F.deathModelPivot then
                                local elapsed = math.max(0, os.clock() - (F.deathStartedAt or os.clock()))
                                local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / 1.0, 0, 1)
                local rotationProgress = math.sqrt(math.clamp(progress * 1.6, 0, 1))
                local downProgress = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
                local modelHeight = F.deathModelHeight or (BLOCK * 2)
                local downwardOffset = math.min(modelHeight * 0.58, BLOCK * 1.65) * downProgress
                                local corpsePivot = F.deathModelPivot * CFrame.new(0, -downwardOffset, 0)
                                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90) * rotationProgress)
                                pcall(function() S.model:PivotTo(corpsePivot) end)
                        end
                else
                        S.model.Parent = nil
                end
                return
        end
        if not (char and char.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent) then return end
        -- Keep sprint FOV separate from movement speed so Creative flight cannot trigger it.
        if F.fovCamera ~= camera then
                F.fovCamera = camera
                F.baseMovementFOV = 74
                camera.FieldOfView = 74
        end
        local baseFOV = F.baseMovementFOV or 74
        -- Only an explicit ground sprint changes the FOV. Do not infer sprinting from
        -- horizontal velocity, because Creative flight is naturally much faster.
        local sprintFOVActive = sprinting and not abilities.flying and not sneaking
        local targetFOV = baseFOV - (sprintFOVActive and 0.3 or 0)
        local fovBlend = 1 - math.exp(-7 * math.clamp(renderDt or (1 / 60), 0, 0.1))
        camera.FieldOfView += (targetFOV - camera.FieldOfView) * fovBlend
        local alpha = S.renderState.alpha
        local eatPrev = F.eatTimePrev or F.eatTime or 0
        local eatNow = F.eatTime or 0
        F.renderEatTime = eatPrev + (eatNow - eatPrev) * alpha
        local renderAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-18 * math.clamp(renderDt or (1 / 60), 0, 0.1))
        local eatBlendTarget = F.eating and 1 or 0
        F.eatAnimationBlend = (F.eatAnimationBlend or 0) + (eatBlendTarget - (F.eatAnimationBlend or 0)) * renderAlpha
        local ipos = S.renderState.ipos
        local ibody = S.renderState.ibody
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        if viewMode == 2 then
                local facing = camera.CFrame.Position - hrp.Position
                if facing.Magnitude > 1e-5 then yaw = math.atan2(-facing.X, -facing.Z) end
                pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(-look.Y, -1, 1))
        else
                yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
                pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1))
        end
        if viewMode == 0 then
                S.model.Parent = nil
                H.updateFirstPerson(camera.CFrame, alpha)
        else
                S.model.Parent = workspace
                local root = CFrame.new(ipos) * CFrame.Angles(0, ibody, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 24 * PX, 0)
                local ispeed = prevWalkSpeed + (walkSpeed - prevWalkSpeed) * alpha
                local targetHeadYaw = math.clamp(F.wrap(yaw - ibody), -math.rad(38), math.rad(38))
                local targetHeadPitch = math.clamp(pitch, -math.rad(50), math.rad(50))
                local smoothAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-14 * math.clamp(renderDt or (1 / 60), 0, 0.1))
                F.smoothedHeadYaw = F.wrap(F.smoothedHeadYaw + F.wrap(targetHeadYaw - F.smoothedHeadYaw) * smoothAlpha)
                F.smoothedHeadPitch += (targetHeadPitch - F.smoothedHeadPitch) * smoothAlpha
                local interpolatedSwing = H.swingAt(alpha)
                local held = slots[36 + selected]
                local aP, aX, aZ, aY, aSwingZ = F.poseSteve(root, F.smoothedHeadPitch, F.smoothedHeadYaw,
                        walkPos - walkSpeed * (1 - alpha), ispeed, age + alpha, sneaking, held ~= nil, interpolatedSwing)
                H.updateThirdPerson(root, aP, aX, aZ, aY, aSwingZ)
        end
end

        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve") end)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_DeathCamera") end)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_SmoothSneakCamera") end)

        for i = 1, 9 do pcall(function() ContextActionService:UnbindAction("MCSteveHotbar" .. i) end) end

        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end

        pcall(function() if S.selectionProxy then S.selectionProxy:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() S.model:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() if S.mobileDpad then S.mobileDpad:Destroy() end end)

        pcall(function() if H.handsFolder then H.handsFolder:Destroy() end end)

        pcall(function() if F.localMobsFolder then F.localMobsFolder:Destroy() end end)

        pcall(function() if F.remoteSteveFolder then F.remoteSteveFolder:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if F.modBrowserFrame then F.modBrowserFrame:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if F.hungerGui then F.hungerGui:Destroy() end end)
        for _, info in ipairs(F.baseplateOriginals or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                        local part = info.part
                        if part and part.Parent then
                                part.LocalTransparencyModifier = info.localTransparencyModifier or 0
                                part.CanCollide = info.canCollide
                                part.CanQuery = info.canQuery
                                part.CanTouch = info.canTouch
                        end
                end)
        end
        for _, info in ipairs(F.voxelOriginals or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                        local part = info.part
                        if part and part.Parent then
                                part.LocalTransparencyModifier = info.localTransparencyModifier or 0
                                part.CanCollide = info.canCollide
                                part.CanQuery = info.canQuery
                                part.CanTouch = info.canTouch
                        end
                end)
        end
        pcall(function()
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
                UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
                camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                lp.CameraMode = S.oldCameraMode
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMinZoom
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.oldCameraMaxZoom
                if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
                if hum then
                        hum.WalkSpeed = 16
                        hum.AutoRotate = true
                        hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer
                        hum.CameraOffset = F.oldCameraOffset or Vector3.zero
                        camera.CameraSubject = hum
                end
                if char then
                        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                                if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                                elseif d:IsA("Decal") then d.Transparency = 0 end
                        end
                end
        end)
        S._shared.__MCSteveStop = nil
end

F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    local survivalActive = not creative and (S.gameModeName == "survival" or S.gameModeName == "adventure") and not F.playerDead
    S.hungerGui.Enabled = survivalActive
    if not survivalActive then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    local moving = vel and vel.Magnitude > 1.2 or false
    if moving then F.hungerExhaustion = (F.hungerExhaustion or 0) + math.max(0, dt) * 0.018 end
    if now >= (F.hungerTickAt or now + 35) then
        F.hungerTickAt = now + (moving and 28 or 42)
        if (F.foodLevel or 20) > 0 then F.foodLevel = math.max(0, F.foodLevel - 1) end
    end
    if (F.foodLevel or 20) <= 0 and now >= (F.starveTickAt or 0) then
        F.starveTickAt = now + 4
        if hum and hum.Health > 1 then hum:TakeDamage(1) end
    end
    local hungerRatio = math.clamp((F.foodLevel or 20) / 20, 0, 1)
    S.hungerFill.Size = UDim2.new(hungerRatio, -4 * hungerRatio, 1, -4)
    S.hungerFill.BackgroundColor3 = (F.foodLevel or 20) <= 5 and Color3.fromRGB(166, 53, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(185, 111, 43)
    S.hungerText.Text = string.format("HUNGER %02d/20", math.floor(F.foodLevel or 20))
end))

-- Automatic terrain generation deliberately omitted: the Minecraft block folder starts empty.

-- Procedural voxel mobs: the selected spawn egg creates a local mob with a health target,
-- a recognizable color silhouette, obstacle-aware steering, and local projectile attacks.
local localMobsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("MCLocalMobs")
if localMobsFolder then localMobsFolder:Destroy() end
localMobsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
localMobsFolder.Name = "MCLocalMobs"
localMobsFolder.Parent = workspace
F.localMobsFolder = localMobsFolder
local localMobs = {}
F.localMobs = localMobs

local function mobPart(parent, name, size, color, localCF, transparency)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name, part.Size, part.Color = name, size, color
    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, true
    part.CastShadow = false
    part.Transparency = transparency or 0
    part.CFrame = localCF or CFrame.identity
    part.Parent = parent
    return part
end
local function applyModMobTexture(part, mobId)
    -- The bundled mob_<id> entries are tiny color-preview swatches, NOT the
    -- real Minecraft entity UV atlas. Rendering them on the front of a head
    -- made each mob look mismatched, so use the mob-specific palette instead.
    -- Full Bedrock entity PNGs need their original UV layout and are handled
    -- separately when real image assets are available.
    return
end

-- Bedrock UV renderer (v24): reads the processed asset bundle from the executor filesystem.
-- Extract Minecraft_MobUV_Python_Output.zip into workspace/MinecraftMobUV/ so that
-- workspace/MinecraftMobUV/textures and /geometry exist. Textures are loaded through
-- getcustomasset/getsynasset; no image pixels are expanded into thousands of UI objects.
local MC_MOB_UV_ROOT = "workspace/MinecraftMobUV"
-- v24.1 FIX: the UV renderer referenced a bare global `HttpService`, which does not exist in
-- Roblox (the only real one was a local inside the mod-loader block far above). `not HttpService`
-- was therefore always true and buildBedrockUVMob ALWAYS bailed out on line 1 — the whole v24
-- Bedrock UV path never ran, even with the asset bundle installed. Resolve the service properly.
local MC_UV_HTTP = (function()
    local okSvc, svc = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService") end)
    -- NOTE: use nil-check, not type() — type() returns "table" for Instances in Roblox.
    if okSvc and svc ~= nil then return svc end
    return nil
end)()
local function mcMobAsset(path)
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
        if not ok or not exists then return nil end
    end
    local uri
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then uri = result end
    end
    if not uri and type(getsynasset) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(getsynasset, path)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then uri = result end
    end
    return uri
end
local function mcMobGeometryPath(mobId)
    local direct = MC_MOB_UV_ROOT .. "/geometry/" .. mobId .. ".geo.json"
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, direct)
        if ok and exists then return direct end
        -- common vanilla names which differ from the spawn-egg id
        local aliases = { zombie_piglin="zombie_pigman", zombified_piglin="zombie_pigman", snow_golem="snow_golem", mooshroom="mooshroom", cave_spider="spider", wither_skeleton="wither_skeleton", zombie_villager="zombie_villager" }
        local alias = aliases[mobId]
        if alias then
            local path = MC_MOB_UV_ROOT .. "/geometry/" .. alias .. ".geo.json"
            local ok2, exists2 = pcall(isfile, path)
            if ok2 and exists2 then return path end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function mcMobFaceGui(part, face, imageUri, rect, textureW, textureH)
    if not rect or rect[3] < 1 or rect[4] < 1 then return end
    if rect[1] < 0 or rect[2] < 0 or rect[1] + rect[3] > textureW or rect[2] + rect[4] > textureH then return end
    local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
    gui.Name = "BedrockUV_" .. face.Name
    gui.Face = face
    gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
    gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(math.clamp(rect[3] * 2, 16, 256), math.clamp(rect[4] * 2, 16, 256))
    gui.LightInfluence = 0
    gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
    gui.Parent = part
    local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    image.Name = "UVAtlasCrop"
    image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    image.BorderSizePixel = 0
    image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    image.Image = imageUri
    image.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(rect[1], rect[2])
    image.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(rect[3], rect[4])
    image.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
    image.Parent = gui
end
local function buildBedrockUVMob(model, mobId, rootCF, rootPart)
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" or not MC_UV_HTTP then return false end
    local texturePath = MC_MOB_UV_ROOT .. "/textures/" .. mobId .. ".png"
    local geometryPath = mcMobGeometryPath(mobId)
    if not geometryPath then return false end
    local textureUri = mcMobAsset(texturePath)
    if not textureUri then return false end
    local okRead, raw = pcall(readfile, geometryPath)
    if not okRead or type(raw) ~= "string" then return false end
    local okJson, data = pcall(function() return MC_UV_HTTP:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    local keys = {}
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
        if type(key) == "string" and key:match("^geometry%.") and type(value) == "table" and type(value.bones) == "table" then
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        end
    end
    if #keys == 0 then return false end
    table.sort(keys)
    local geomKey = keys[1]
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if not key:find("charged", 1, true) and not key:find("baby", 1, true) then geomKey = key break end
    end
    local geom = data[geomKey]
    local texW = tonumber(geom.texturewidth) or 64
    local texH = tonumber(geom.textureheight) or 32
    local cubes = {}
    for _, bone in ipairs(geom.bones) do
        if type(bone.cubes) == "table" then
            for _, cube in ipairs(bone.cubes) do
                if type(cube.origin) == "table" and type(cube.size) == "table" and type(cube.uv) == "table" and type(cube.uv[1]) == "number" then
                    cubes[#cubes + 1] = { bone = bone, cube = cube }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #cubes == 0 or #cubes > 100 then return false end
    -- We only replace the rough placeholder after confirming both assets and geometry exist.
    for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= rootPart then child:Destroy() end
    end
    for index, entry in ipairs(cubes) do
        local cube, bone = entry.cube, entry.bone
        local o, sz, uv = cube.origin, cube.size, cube.uv
        local x, y, z = tonumber(o[1]) or 0, tonumber(o[2]) or 0, tonumber(o[3]) or 0
        local sx, sy, szd = tonumber(sz[1]) or 1, tonumber(sz[2]) or 1, tonumber(sz[3]) or 1
        local inflate = tonumber(cube.inflate) or 0
        local partSize = Vector3.new(math.max(0.025, sx / 16 + inflate / 8), math.max(0.025, sy / 16 + inflate / 8), math.max(0.025, szd / 16 + inflate / 8))
        local px, py, pz = x + sx / 2, y + sy / 2, z + szd / 2
        local bonePivot = type(bone.pivot) == "table" and bone.pivot or {0,0,0}
        local boneRot = type(bone.rotation) == "table" and bone.rotation or {0,0,0}
        local rel = Vector3.new(px / 16, py / 16 - 1, -pz / 16)
        local rot = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tonumber(boneRot[1]) or 0), math.rad(-(tonumber(boneRot[2]) or 0)), math.rad(-(tonumber(boneRot[3]) or 0)))
        local pivotRel = Vector3.new((tonumber(bonePivot[1]) or 0)/16, (tonumber(bonePivot[2]) or 0)/16 - 1, -(tonumber(bonePivot[3]) or 0)/16)
        local cf = rootCF * CFrame.new(pivotRel) * rot * CFrame.new(rel - pivotRel)
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = tostring(bone.name or "Cube") .. "_UV" .. index
        part.Size = partSize
        part.CFrame = cf
        part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
        part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        part.Color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        part.CastShadow = false
        part.TopSurface, part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        part.Parent = model
        local u, v = tonumber(uv[1]) or 0, tonumber(uv[2]) or 0
        local w, h, d = sx, sy, szd
        -- Bedrock box UV net: top/bottom, west/north/east/south.
        local down = {u+d, v, w, d}
        local up = {u+d+w, v, w, d}
        local west = {u, v+d, d, h}
        local north = {u+d, v+d, w, h}
        local east = {u+d+w, v+d, d, h}
        local south = {u+d+w+d, v+d, w, h}
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Top, textureUri, up, texW, texH)
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, textureUri, down, texW, texH)
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Left, textureUri, west, texW, texH)
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Front, textureUri, north, texW, texH)
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Right, textureUri, east, texW, texH)
        mcMobFaceGui(part, Enum.NormalId.Back, textureUri, south, texW, texH)
    end
    model:SetAttribute("MCBedrockUVRendered", true)
    model:SetAttribute("MCBedrockUVCubeCount", #cubes)
    return true
end

F.spawnLocalMob = function(mobId, requestedPosition)
    -- Hard cap prevents rapid spawn-egg use from creating unbounded Parts, pixel UI,
    -- raycasts, pathfinding jobs, and per-frame AI work on mobile clients.
    local MAX_LOCAL_MOBS = UIS.TouchEnabled and 12 or 24
    for i = #localMobs, 1, -1 do
        local existing = localMobs[i]
        if not existing or not existing.model or not existing.model.Parent then
            table.remove(localMobs, i)
        end
    end
    if #localMobs >= MAX_LOCAL_MOBS then
        if F.appendChatLine then F.appendChatLine("Mob limit reached (" .. MAX_LOCAL_MOBS .. "). Remove mobs before spawning more.") end
        return nil
    end
    mobId = tostring(mobId or "pig"):lower():gsub("[^%w_]", "")
    local modDef = F.MOD_MOB_DEFS and F.MOD_MOB_DEFS[mobId]
    local tint = (modDef and F.hexColor and F.hexColor(modDef.color or modDef.hex, MOB_COLORS[mobId] or Color3.fromRGB(125,120,115))) or MOB_COLORS[mobId] or Color3.fromRGB(125, 120, 115)
    local hostile = (modDef and modDef.hostile == true) or ({zombie=true,zombie_villager=true,husk=true,drowned=true,skeleton=true,stray=true,bogged=true,wither_skeleton=true,creeper=true,spider=true,cave_spider=true,enderman=true,silverfish=true,endermite=true,witch=true,pillager=true,vindicator=true,evoker=true,ravager=true,vex=true,phantom=true,slime=true,magma_cube=true,blaze=true,ghast=true,piglin=true,piglin_brute=true,zombified_piglin=true,hoglin=true,zoglin=true,shulker=true,guardian=true,elder_guardian=true,warden=true,breeze=true,wither=true,ender_dragon=true,creaking=true,parched=true})[mobId] == true
    if modDef and modDef.hostile ~= nil then hostile = modDef.hostile == true end
    local forward = camera and Vector3.new(camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z) or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
    if forward.Magnitude < 0.01 then forward = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) else forward = forward.Unit end
    local candidate = requestedPosition or (pos + forward * (BLOCK * 4))
    local ground = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidate.X, candidate.Y + BLOCK * 12, candidate.Z), Vector3.new(0, -BLOCK * 24, 0), rp)
    local groundY = ground and (ground.Position.Y + 0.05) or candidate.Y
    local rootCF = CFrame.new(candidate.X, groundY + 1.0, candidate.Z)
    local m = Instance.new("Model")
    m.Name = "MC_" .. mobId
    m:SetAttribute("MCMobType", mobId)
    m:SetAttribute("MCHostile", hostile)
    m.Parent = localMobsFolder
    local root = mobPart(m, "HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(0.25,0.25,0.25), tint, rootCF, 1)
    root.CanQuery = false
    local quadruped = ({pig=true,cow=true,sheep=true,mooshroom=true,goat=true,fox=true,wolf=true,cat=true,ocelot=true,horse=true,donkey=true,mule=true,llama=true,trader_llama=true,camel=true,polar_bear=true,panda=true,rabbit=true,hoglin=true,zoglin=true})[mobId] == true
    local torsoSize = mobId == "creeper" and Vector3.new(1.0,1.7,0.85)
        or (mobId == "spider" or mobId == "cave_spider") and Vector3.new(1.5,0.55,1.2)
        or quadruped and Vector3.new(1.25,0.75,1.65)
        or mobId == "chicken" and Vector3.new(0.55,0.65,0.65)
        or mobId == "ghast" and Vector3.new(2.0,2.0,2.0)
        or mobId == "slime" and Vector3.new(1.1,1.1,1.1)
        or Vector3.new(1.15,1.0,0.7)
    local torsoOffset = (mobId == "spider" or mobId == "cave_spider") and Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        or quadruped and Vector3.new(0,-0.25,0.05) or Vector3.new(0,0.1,0)
    local body = mobPart(m, "Body", torsoSize, tint, rootCF * CFrame.new(torsoOffset))
    m.PrimaryPart = root
    local headSize = (mobId == "ghast") and Vector3.new(0.8,0.8,0.8)
        or (mobId == "ender_dragon") and Vector3.new(1.25,1.0,1.25)
        or (mobId == "chicken" or mobId == "tadpole" or mobId == "rabbit") and Vector3.new(0.45,0.45,0.45)
        or quadruped and Vector3.new(0.65,0.6,0.65)
        or (mobId == "slime" or mobId == "magma_cube") and Vector3.new(0.5,0.5,0.5)
        or Vector3.new(0.75,0.75,0.75)
    local headColor = (mobId == "skeleton" or mobId == "stray" or mobId == "wither_skeleton") and Color3.fromRGB(224,221,204) or tint
    local headOffset = quadruped and Vector3.new(0,0.45,-0.85) or Vector3.new(0, mobId == "spider" and 0.15 or 0.9, -0.45)
    local mobHead = mobPart(m, "Head", headSize, headColor, rootCF * CFrame.new(headOffset))
    applyModMobTexture(mobHead, mobId)
    applyModMobTexture(body, mobId)
    if mobId == "creeper" then
        mobPart(m,"FaceLeft",Vector3.new(0.14,0.14,0.06),Color3.new(0.05,0.09,0.04),rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.17,1.0,-0.84))
        mobPart(m,"FaceRight",Vector3.new(0.14,0.14,0.06),Color3.new(0.05,0.09,0.04),rootCF * CFrame.new(0.17,1.0,-0.84))
        mobPart(m,"Mouth",Vector3.new(0.35,0.28,0.06),Color3.new(0.05,0.09,0.04),rootCF * CFrame.new(0,0.78,-0.84))
    elseif mobId == "enderman" then
        mobPart(m,"EyeLeft",Vector3.new(0.11,0.07,0.04),Color3.fromRGB(196,69,211),rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.2,1.0,-0.84))
        mobPart(m,"EyeRight",Vector3.new(0.11,0.07,0.04),Color3.fromRGB(196,69,211),rootCF * CFrame.new(0.2,1.0,-0.84))
    end
    local limbColor = (mobId == "skeleton" or mobId == "stray" or mobId == "wither_skeleton") and Color3.fromRGB(214,211,194) or tint
    if mobId == "spider" or mobId == "cave_spider" then
        for i = 1, 8 do
            local side = i <= 4 and -1 or 1
            local step = (i - 1) % 4
            local limb = mobPart(m, "Leg"..i, Vector3.new(0.75,0.12,0.12), limbColor, rootCF * CFrame.new(side * (0.65 + step*0.06), -0.08, (step-1.5)*0.32) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.25, side * 0.18))
        end
    else
        if quadruped then
            for _, x in ipairs({-0.4,0.4}) do
                for _, z in ipairs({-0.48,0.48}) do
                    mobPart(m, "Leg" .. (x < 0 and "L" or "R") .. (z < 0 and "F" or "B"), Vector3.new(0.22,0.48,0.22), limbColor, rootCF * CFrame.new(x,-0.72,z))
                end
            end
        else
            for _, side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                local armSize = (mobId == "creeper") and Vector3.new(0.28,0.55,0.28) or Vector3.new(0.32,0.9,0.32)
                mobPart(m, side < 0 and "ArmL" or "ArmR", armSize, limbColor, rootCF * CFrame.new(side*0.78,0.05,-0.02))
                mobPart(m, side < 0 and "LegL" or "LegR", Vector3.new(0.35,0.75,0.35), limbColor, rootCF * CFrame.new(side*0.32,-0.78,0.03))
            end
        end
        if mobId == "chicken" then mobPart(m,"Beak",Vector3.new(0.22,0.14,0.18),Color3.fromRGB(223,157,44),rootCF * CFrame.new(0,0.82,-0.83)) end
        if mobId == "pig" then mobPart(m,"Snout",Vector3.new(0.3,0.22,0.17),Color3.fromRGB(248,179,184),rootCF * CFrame.new(0,0.42,-1.18)) end
        if mobId == "cow" or mobId == "mooshroom" then
            mobPart(m,"Muzzle",Vector3.new(0.36,0.28,0.22),Color3.fromRGB(190,145,127),rootCF * CFrame.new(0,0.38,-1.18))
            mobPart(m,"HornL",Vector3.new(0.1,0.22,0.1),Color3.fromRGB(224,216,184),rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.22,0.82,-0.82))
            mobPart(m,"HornR",Vector3.new(0.1,0.22,0.1),Color3.fromRGB(224,216,184),rootCF * CFrame.new(0.22,0.82,-0.82))
        end
    end
    -- Replace placeholder geometry with true Bedrock UV cubes when the local bundle is installed.
    -- If assets are missing, keep the original lightweight placeholder mob intact.
    local uvOk, uvRendered = pcall(buildBedrockUVMob, m, mobId, rootCF, root)
    if not uvOk then warn("[Minecraft Replica] UV renderer fallback for " .. mobId .. ": " .. tostring(uvRendered)) end
    local humObj = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humObj.Name = "Humanoid"
    humObj.MaxHealth = math.clamp(tonumber(modDef and modDef.health) or ((mobId == "warden" or mobId == "ender_dragon" or mobId == "wither") and 200 or (hostile and 20 or 10)), 1, 10000)
    humObj.Health = humObj.MaxHealth
    humObj.WalkSpeed = 0
    humObj.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
    humObj.Parent = m
    pcall(function() F.observeHumanoid(humObj) end)
    local mob = { model = m, root = root, humanoid = humObj, mobId = mobId, hostile = hostile, position = rootCF.Position, target = nil, wanderAt = 0, heading = math.random() * math.pi * 2, alive = true, state = "idle", fuse = 0, nextAttack = 0, nextHop = 0, path = nil, pathIndex = 1, pathAt = 0, pathTarget = nil, pathPending = false, pathToken = 0 }
    localMobs[#localMobs + 1] = mob
    F.appendChatLine("Spawned local " .. F.prettyId(mobId) .. ".")
    return m
end
-- Entity brain layer: per-mob-family state machines. This is a local approximation,
-- not Mojang's Java/Bedrock entity-goal scheduler; texture/model assets can be supplied separately.
local MOB_BRAIN = {
    zombie={kind="melee", follow=32, speed=3.1, damage=2, cooldown=1.0}, husk={kind="melee", follow=32, speed=3.1, damage=2, cooldown=1.0}, drowned={kind="melee", follow=28, speed=2.7, damage=2, cooldown=1.2},
    skeleton={kind="ranged", follow=40, speed=2.4, damage=1.5, cooldown=2.0}, stray={kind="ranged", follow=40, speed=2.4, damage=1.5, cooldown=2.0}, bogged={kind="ranged", follow=40, speed=2.4, damage=1.5, cooldown=2.0},
    creeper={kind="creeper", follow=28, speed=2.8, damage=0, cooldown=0}, enderman={kind="enderman", follow=40, speed=3.5, damage=4, cooldown=0.8}, spider={kind="melee", follow=32, speed=3.8, damage=2, cooldown=1.0}, cave_spider={kind="melee", follow=32, speed=3.8, damage=1.5, cooldown=1.0},
    wolf={kind="pack", follow=24, speed=3.2, damage=2, cooldown=1.0}, fox={kind="skittish", follow=0, speed=3.0}, sheep={kind="grazer", follow=0, speed=1.3}, cow={kind="grazer", follow=0, speed=1.1}, pig={kind="grazer", follow=0, speed=1.2}, chicken={kind="grazer", follow=0, speed=1.4}, rabbit={kind="skittish", follow=0, speed=2.1},

    slime={kind="hopper", follow=24, speed=2.2, damage=1, cooldown=1.0}, magma_cube={kind="hopper", follow=24, speed=2.2, damage=2, cooldown=1.0}, phantom={kind="flyer", follow=48, speed=4.0, damage=2, cooldown=1.5},
}
local function getBrain(mob)
    local modDef = F.MOD_MOB_DEFS and F.MOD_MOB_DEFS[mob.mobId]
    if modDef then
        return {
            kind = tostring(modDef.ai or modDef.kind or (mob.hostile and "melee" or "grazer")),
            follow = math.clamp(tonumber(modDef.follow) or (mob.hostile and 28 or 0), 0, 512),
            speed = math.clamp(tonumber(modDef.speed) or (mob.hostile and 2.4 or 1.0), 0, 100),
            damage = math.clamp(tonumber(modDef.damage) or (mob.hostile and 1.5 or 0), 0, 10000),
            cooldown = math.clamp(tonumber(modDef.cooldown) or 1.2, 0.1, 120),
        }
    end
    if MOB_BRAIN[mob.mobId] then return MOB_BRAIN[mob.mobId] end
    if mob.hostile then return {kind="melee",follow=28,speed=2.4,damage=1.5,cooldown=1.2} end
    return {kind="grazer",follow=0,speed=1.0}
end
local function spawnMobArrow(mob, brain)
    -- A small, moving local projectile. It checks each travelled segment so walls can block shots.
    local origin = mob.position + Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.72, 0)
    local targetRoot = hrp
    if not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then return end
    local target = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)
    local direction = target - origin
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
    local velocity = direction.Unit * (BLOCK * 17)
    local arrow = Instance.new("Part")
    arrow.Name = "MCLocalArrow"
    arrow.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 0.42)
    arrow.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    arrow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(151, 123, 84)
    arrow.Anchored, arrow.CanCollide, arrow.CanTouch, arrow.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
    arrow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + velocity)
    arrow.Parent = localMobsFolder
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localMobsFolder, mob.model, lp.Character}
    rayParams.RespectCanCollide = false
    task.spawn(function()
        local previous = origin
        local born = os.clock()
        while arrow.Parent and os.clock() - born < 2.5 do
            local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if not arrow.Parent then break end
            local step = velocity * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.08)
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(previous, step, rayParams)
            if hit then
                arrow:Destroy()
                return
            end
            previous += step
            if (targetRoot and targetRoot.Parent and (previous - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude < 1.8) then
                local currentHum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if currentHum and currentHum.Health > 0 and not creative and not F.playerDead then
                    currentHum:TakeDamage(brain.damage or 1)
                end
                arrow:Destroy()
                return
            end
            arrow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(previous, previous + velocity)
        end
        if arrow.Parent then arrow:Destroy() end
    end)
end
local function brainDamagePlayer(mob, brain, distance)
    local now = os.clock()
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or F.playerDead or creative then return end
    if brain.kind == "ranged" then
        if distance > BLOCK * 18 or now < (mob.nextAttack or 0) then return end
        -- A solid block between the mob and player blocks line of sight and prevents firing.
        local origin = mob.position + Vector3.new(0, BLOCK * 0.72, 0)
        local target = (hrp and hrp.Position or pos) + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)
        local delta = target - origin
        if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
        local sightParams = RaycastParams.new()
        sightParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        sightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localMobsFolder, mob.model, lp.Character}
        sightParams.RespectCanCollide = true
        if workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, sightParams) then return end
        mob.nextAttack = now + (brain.cooldown or 2)
        spawnMobArrow(mob, brain)
        return
    end
    if distance > BLOCK * 2.1 or now < (mob.nextAttack or 0) then return end
    mob.nextAttack = now + (brain.cooldown or 1)
    if brain.kind ~= "creeper" then hum:TakeDamage(brain.damage or 1) end
end
-- Asynchronous waypoint pathfinding for grounded mobs. A generation token prevents stale
-- ComputeAsync results from replacing a newer route when the target moves.
local function requestMobPath(mob, goal, now)
    if mob.pathPending or now < (mob.pathAt or 0) then return end
    if mob.pathTarget and (goal - mob.pathTarget).Magnitude < BLOCK * 2.5 and mob.path and mob.pathIndex <= #mob.path then return end
    mob.pathPending = true
    mob.pathAt = now + 1.1
    mob.pathTarget = goal
    mob.pathToken = (mob.pathToken or 0) + 1
    local token = mob.pathToken
    local start = mob.position
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, waypoints = pcall(function()
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 1.0, AgentHeight = 3.0, AgentCanJump = true, AgentCanClimb = true, WaypointSpacing = BLOCK * 1.4})
            path:ComputeAsync(start, goal)
            if path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then return nil end
            return path:GetWaypoints()
        end)
        if not mob.model or not mob.model.Parent or mob.pathToken ~= token then return end
        mob.pathPending = false
        if ok and waypoints and #waypoints > 0 then
            mob.path = waypoints
            mob.pathIndex = math.min(2, #waypoints)
        else
            mob.path = nil
            mob.pathIndex = 1
        end
    end)
end
local function getMobWaypoint(mob, targetPos, now)
    requestMobPath(mob, targetPos, now)
    local points = mob.path
    if not points or #points == 0 then return nil end
    local index = math.clamp(mob.pathIndex or 1, 1, #points)
    local waypoint = points[index]
    while waypoint and (Vector3.new(waypoint.Position.X, mob.position.Y, waypoint.Position.Z) - mob.position).Magnitude < BLOCK * 0.65 and index < #points do
        index += 1
        waypoint = points[index]
    end
    mob.pathIndex = index
    if waypoint and waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then mob.hopY = math.max(mob.hopY or 0, 1.4) end
    return waypoint and Vector3.new(waypoint.Position.X, waypoint.Position.Y, waypoint.Position.Z) or nil
end

local function steerAroundObstacle(mob, targetPos)
    local offset = targetPos - mob.position
    local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then return targetPos end
    local direction = flat.Unit
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localMobsFolder, mob.model, lp.Character}
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    local origin = mob.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.65, 0)
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * (BLOCK * 1.15), params)
    if not hit then return targetPos end
    -- Try both sides and choose the clearest short route. This is local steering, not full voxel A*.
    local left = Vector3.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X)
    local right = -left
    local leftHit = workspace:Raycast(origin, (direction + left * 0.9).Unit * BLOCK * 1.35, params)
    local rightHit = workspace:Raycast(origin, (direction + right * 0.9).Unit * BLOCK * 1.35, params)
    local chosen
    if not leftHit and rightHit then chosen = left
    elseif not rightHit and leftHit then chosen = right
    elseif not leftHit and not rightHit then chosen = (math.random() < 0.5) and left or right
    else chosen = (math.random() < 0.5) and left or right end
    return mob.position + chosen * BLOCK * 2
end
F.updateLocalMobs = function(dt)
    dt = math.clamp(dt or 0, 0, 0.1)
    local now = os.clock()
    for i = #localMobs, 1, -1 do
        local mob = localMobs[i]
        if not mob.model or not mob.model.Parent or not mob.humanoid or mob.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            if mob.model and mob.model.Parent then mob.model:Destroy() end
            table.remove(localMobs, i)
        else
            local brain = getBrain(mob)
            local delta = (pos and Vector3.new(pos.X-mob.position.X,0,pos.Z-mob.position.Z)) or Vector3.zero
            local distance = delta.Magnitude
            local canAggro = mob.hostile and not creative and not F.playerDead and pos and distance <= BLOCK * (brain.follow or 24)
            local targetPos = nil
            local speed = brain.speed or 1.0
            if brain.kind == "creeper" and canAggro and distance < BLOCK * 3.2 then
                mob.fuse = (mob.fuse or 0) + dt
                mob.state = "fusing"
                speed = 0
                if mob.fuse >= 1.5 then
                    -- Local blast: damages nearby player and breaks only this script's tagged MC blocks.
                    if hum and distance < BLOCK * 5 then hum:TakeDamage(math.max(0, 18 * (1-distance/(BLOCK*5)))) end
                    local center = mob.position
                    for _, part in ipairs(blockFolder:GetChildren()) do
                        local cell = part:GetAttribute("MCCell")
                        if typeof(cell)=="Vector3" and (cell-center).Magnitude < BLOCK*3.2 then
                            if part:GetAttribute("MCBlockId") and part.Parent then part:Destroy() end
                        end
                    end
                    mob.humanoid.Health = 0
                end
            elseif brain.kind == "creeper" then
                mob.fuse = math.max(0,(mob.fuse or 0)-dt*2)
                mob.state = canAggro and "approach" or "idle"
                if canAggro and distance > BLOCK*2.6 then targetPos = Vector3.new(pos.X,mob.position.Y,pos.Z) end
            elseif brain.kind == "enderman" then
                local lookToward = canAggro and distance < BLOCK*24 and camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot((mob.position - camera.CFrame.Position).Unit) > 0.965
                if lookToward then mob.angered = true; mob.state = "angered" end
                if canAggro and mob.angered then
                    targetPos = Vector3.new(pos.X,mob.position.Y,pos.Z)
                    if distance < BLOCK*4 then brainDamagePlayer(mob,brain,distance) end
                else
                    mob.state = "neutral"
                end
            elseif canAggro and (brain.kind == "melee" or brain.kind == "ranged" or brain.kind == "defender" or brain.kind == "pack" or brain.kind == "hopper" or brain.kind == "flyer") then
                mob.state = "chase"
                if brain.kind == "ranged" and distance < BLOCK*10 then
                    -- Ranged mobs hold a loose firing distance instead of walking into the player.
                    if distance < BLOCK*6 then targetPos = mob.position - delta.Unit * BLOCK
                    elseif distance > BLOCK*8 then targetPos = Vector3.new(pos.X,mob.position.Y,pos.Z) end
                    if distance < BLOCK*18 then brainDamagePlayer(mob,brain,distance) end
                else
                    targetPos = Vector3.new(pos.X,mob.position.Y,pos.Z)
                    if brain.kind == "hopper" and now >= (mob.nextHop or 0) then mob.nextHop=now+0.9; mob.hopY=1.2 end
                    if brain.kind == "flyer" then targetPos = Vector3.new(pos.X,pos.Y+BLOCK*1.5,pos.Z) end
                    brainDamagePlayer(mob,brain,distance)
                end
            elseif brain.kind == "skittish" and pos and distance < BLOCK*6 then
                mob.state = "flee"
                if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then targetPos = mob.position - delta.Unit * BLOCK * 8 end
            else
                mob.state = "idle"
                if now >= (mob.wanderAt or 0) then
                    mob.heading = math.random()*math.pi*2
                    mob.wanderAt = now + math.random(2,6)
                    if brain.kind == "grazer" and math.random() < 0.18 then mob.state="grazing" end
                end
                targetPos = mob.position + Vector3.new(math.cos(mob.heading),0,math.sin(mob.heading))*BLOCK*2
            end
            if targetPos then
                -- Grounded mobs follow computed waypoint routes; local steering remains a fallback
                -- when pathfinding cannot produce a route or while the asynchronous request runs.
                if brain.kind ~= "flyer" and speed > 0 then
                    local waypointTarget = getMobWaypoint(mob, targetPos, now)
                    if waypointTarget then targetPos = waypointTarget else targetPos = steerAroundObstacle(mob, targetPos) end
                end
                local move = targetPos - mob.position
                if move.Magnitude > 0.01 then mob.position += move.Unit * math.min(move.Magnitude, speed * BLOCK * dt) end
            end
            if brain.kind == "hopper" and mob.hopY and mob.hopY > 0 then mob.position += Vector3.new(0,mob.hopY*BLOCK*dt,0); mob.hopY=math.max(0,mob.hopY-dt*3) end
            local top = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(mob.position.X,mob.position.Y+BLOCK*4,mob.position.Z),Vector3.new(0,-BLOCK*8,0),rp)
            if top and brain.kind ~= "flyer" then mob.position=Vector3.new(mob.position.X,top.Position.Y+1.0,mob.position.Z) end
            local direction = targetPos and (targetPos-mob.position) or Vector3.new(math.cos(mob.heading),0,math.sin(mob.heading))
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then mob.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(mob.position,mob.position+direction.Unit)) end
        end
    end
end
F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if F.updateLocalMobs then
        local ok, err = pcall(F.updateLocalMobs, math.min(math.max(dt or 0, 0), 0.1))
        if not ok and not F._mobUpdateWarned then
            F._mobUpdateWarned = true
            warn("[Minecraft Replica] Mob update paused after error: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end
end))

-- Client-only Steve proxies for other Roblox players. These are local visuals and cannot
-- prove who is executing the script; every other visible player is represented as Steve.
local remoteSteveFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
remoteSteveFolder.Name = "MCOtherSteves"
remoteSteveFolder.Parent = workspace
F.remoteSteveFolder = remoteSteveFolder
local remoteSteves = {}
F.remoteSteves = remoteSteves
local function setRemoteCharacterHidden(character, hidden)
    if not character then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0
        elseif d:IsA("Decal") then d.Transparency = hidden and 1 or 0 end
    end
end
local function newRemoteSteve(player)
    if player == lp then return end
    local entry = remoteSteves[player]
    if entry and entry.model and entry.model.Parent then return end
    local character = player.Character
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (character and rootPart) then return end
    setRemoteCharacterHidden(character, true)
    local modelObj = Instance.new("Model")
    modelObj.Name = "Steve_" .. player.Name
    modelObj.Parent = remoteSteveFolder
    local root = mobPart(modelObj,"ProxyRoot",Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1),Color3.new(1,1,1),rootPart.CFrame,1)
    root.CanQuery = false
    modelObj.PrimaryPart = root
    local skin = Color3.fromRGB(176,125,96)
    mobPart(modelObj,"Head",Vector3.new(1.15,1.15,1.15),skin,CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)),0)
    mobPart(modelObj,"Body",Vector3.new(1.0,1.45,0.55),Color3.fromRGB(54,112,164),CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0,0.25,0)),0)
    mobPart(modelObj,"LeftArm",Vector3.new(0.38,1.4,0.42),skin,CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(-0.72,0.2,0)),0)
    mobPart(modelObj,"RightArm",Vector3.new(0.38,1.4,0.42),skin,CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0.72,0.2,0)),0)
    mobPart(modelObj,"LeftLeg",Vector3.new(0.43,1.45,0.46),Color3.fromRGB(49,58,112),CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(-0.27,-1.15,0)),0)
    mobPart(modelObj,"RightLeg",Vector3.new(0.43,1.45,0.46),Color3.fromRGB(49,58,112),CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0.27,-1.15,0)),0)
    remoteSteves[player] = { model = modelObj, character = character, old = {}, rootPart = rootPart }
    local function hideAdded(d)
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 elseif d:IsA("Decal") then d.Transparency = 1 end
    end
    local signal = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(hideAdded)
    F.track(signal)
    remoteSteves[player].hideConnection = signal
end
local function removeRemoteSteve(player)
    local entry = remoteSteves[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if entry.hideConnection then pcall(function() entry.hideConnection:Disconnect() end) end
    setRemoteCharacterHidden(entry.character, false)
    if entry.model then entry.model:Destroy() end
    remoteSteves[player] = nil
end
local function refreshRemoteSteves()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= lp then
            if not remoteSteves[player] or remoteSteves[player].character ~= player.Character then
                removeRemoteSteve(player)
                newRemoteSteve(player)
            end
        end
    end
end
F.restoreRemoteSteves = function()
    for player, entry in pairs(remoteSteves) do
        pcall(function() if entry.hideConnection then entry.hideConnection:Disconnect() end end)
        pcall(function() setRemoteCharacterHidden(entry.character, false) end)
        pcall(function() if entry.model then entry.model:Destroy() end end)
        remoteSteves[player] = nil
    end
end
F.track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    if player ~= lp then
        F.track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            removeRemoteSteve(player)
            newRemoteSteve(player)
        end))
        task.defer(function() newRemoteSteve(player) end)
    end
end))
F.track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeRemoteSteve))
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player ~= lp then newRemoteSteve(player) end end
F.track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    for player, entry in pairs(remoteSteves) do
        local character = player.Character
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (rootPart and entry.model and entry.model.Parent) then
            removeRemoteSteve(player)
        else
            local cf = rootPart.CFrame
            local base = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-cf.LookVector.X, -cf.LookVector.Z), 0)
            for _, part in ipairs(entry.model:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local offset = part.Name == "Head" and Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)
                        or part.Name == "Body" and Vector3.new(0,0.25,0)
                        or part.Name == "LeftArm" and Vector3.new(-0.72,0.2,0)
                        or part.Name == "RightArm" and Vector3.new(0.72,0.2,0)
                        or part.Name == "LeftLeg" and Vector3.new(-0.27,-1.15,0)
                        or part.Name == "RightLeg" and Vector3.new(0.27,-1.15,0) or Vector3.zero
                    part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(offset)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end))

    local info = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    info.Text = string.format("Registry: %d blocks/items | Loaded mod files: %d\nPlace JSON .txt files in executor workspace or workspace/MinecraftMods.", 0, #F.MODS_LOADED)
    info.ZIndex = 101; info.Parent = frame
    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,88); list.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-140)

        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56,56,56); row.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,34)

        row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; row.TextWrapped = true; row.Text = "  " .. textValue
        row.ZIndex = 102; row.Parent = list
    end
    local itemCount = 0
    for _ in pairs(ITEMS) do itemCount += 1 end
    info.Text = string.format("Registry: %d item/block entries | Loaded mod files: %d\nMods are local to your client; native Java/Bedrock archives are not executable here.", itemCount, #F.MODS_LOADED)
    if #F.MODS_LOADED == 0 then addLine("No local mods loaded. Read the example MCMod_Example.txt file format.") end
    for _, mod in ipairs(F.MODS_LOADED) do addLine(string.format("%s  |  +%d blocks  +%d items\n%s", mod.name, mod.blocks, mod.items, mod.path)) end
    local reload = Instance.new("TextButton")
    reload.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,1,-42); reload.Size = UDim2.new(0.64,-12,0,32)
    reload.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(66,104,61); reload.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade; reload.TextSize = 12; reload.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    reload.Text = "RESCAN WORKSPACE TXT FILES"; reload.ZIndex = 102; reload.Parent = frame
    reload.Activated:Connect(function()
        local nLoaded, nPaths, errs = F.scanModFiles()
        if F.refreshCatalogFromItems then F.refreshCatalogFromItems() end
        if F.decorateModBlock and blockFolder then
            for _, existingBlock in ipairs(blockFolder:GetChildren()) do F.decorateModBlock(existingBlock) end
        end
        frame:Destroy(); F.modBrowserFrame = nil
        openModBrowser()
        F.appendChatLine(string.format("Mod scan: %d new file(s) loaded from %d TXT file(s).", nLoaded, nPaths))
        if #errs > 0 then F.appendChatLine("Some mod files could not be loaded; check valid JSON and item IDs.") end
    end)
    local close2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
    close2.Position = UDim2.new(0.66,0,1,-42); close2.Size = UDim2.new(0.34,-10,0,32)
    close2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80); close2.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade; close2.TextSize = 12; close2.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    close2.Text = "CLOSE"; close2.ZIndex = 102; close2.Parent = frame
    close2.Activated:Connect(function() frame:Destroy(); F.modBrowserFrame = nil end)
end
F.makePojavTopButton("MODS", 306, 54, openModBrowser, true)
-- No server-authoritative state, native MC world, or mod runtime is available from a client-only executor.
end -- local mob state machines, multiplayer visuals and mod-browser implementation

RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_ResetPreviousCameraTransforms")
RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_ThirdPersonFrontView")
local lastFrontCamera, lastFrontTransform = nil, CFrame.identity
RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_SmoothSneakCamera")
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_SmoothSneakCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 2, function(dt)
        if not hum or not hum.Parent then return end
        local uiBlocking = invOpen or chatOpen
        local sneakInput = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) or sneakToggle
        local targetEyeH = (sneakInput and not uiBlocking and not abilities.flying) and 1.27 or 1.62
        local smoothAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-16 * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.1))
        S.cameraEyeH += (targetEyeH - S.cameraEyeH) * smoothAlpha
        eyeH = S.cameraEyeH
        hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, (S.cameraEyeH - 1.62) * BLOCK, 0)
end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_ResetPreviousCameraTransforms", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then lastFrontCamera = nil; lastFrontTransform = CFrame.identity; return end
        if lastFrontCamera == cam then cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * lastFrontTransform:Inverse() end
        lastFrontCamera = cam
        lastFrontTransform = CFrame.identity
end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_ThirdPersonFrontView", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        if viewMode ~= 2 or invOpen or chatOpen then
                lastFrontCamera = cam
                lastFrontTransform = CFrame.identity
                return
        end
        local base = cam.CFrame
        local focus = cam.Focus.Position
        if hrp and hrp.Parent and (focus - hrp.Position).Magnitude > BLOCK * 8 then
                focus = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, S.rootVisualOffset * 0.1, 0)
        end
        local relative = base.Position - focus
        local frontPosition = focus + Vector3.new(-relative.X, relative.Y, -relative.Z)
        local front = CFrame.lookAt(frontPosition, focus)
        lastFrontTransform = base:ToObjectSpace(front)
        cam.CFrame = front
end)
RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_HideLocalAvatar")
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_HideLocalAvatar", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
        if char and char.Parent then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(F.hiddenAvatarObjects or {}) do
                        if descendant and descendant.Parent then F.hideOneAvatarObject(descendant) end
                end
        end
end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_CharacterAndHands", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
        if F.renderVisuals then F.renderVisuals(dt) end
end)
RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MCSteve_DroppedItems")
RunService:BindToRenderStep("MCSteve_DroppedItems", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function(dt)
        if F.updateDroppedItems then F.updateDroppedItems(dt) end
end)
F.updateCameraViewButton = function()
        if S.cameraViewButton then
                S.cameraViewButton.Text = ({[0] = "1ST", [1] = "3RD BACK", [2] = "3RD FRONT"})[viewMode] or "1ST"
        end
end
F.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if F.update then
        local ok, err = pcall(F.update, math.min(math.max(dt or 0, 0), 0.1))
        if not ok and not F._mainUpdateWarned then
            F._mainUpdateWarned = true
            warn("[Minecraft Replica] Main update error (reported once): " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end
end))
print("Minecraft-style client recreation v13 | Java Edition target | no generated terrain | startup diagnostics enabled | 3x3 crafting table | stair silhouettes | local furnace smelting")

-- Protected startup boundary (v13): report full error + line instead of silent failure
print("[Minecraft Replica v13] Calling __RunMinecraftClient via pcall...")
local ok, err = pcall(__RunMinecraftClient)
if not ok then
        local msg = "[Minecraft Replica v13] Startup failed: " .. tostring(err)
        print(msg)
        warn(msg)
        if type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.traceback) == "function" then
                local tb = debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2)
                print(tb)
                warn(tb)
        end
else
        print("[Minecraft Replica v13] Startup pcall returned successfully")
end
